title: I Came By
overview: A rebellious young graffiti artist, who targets the homes of the wealthy elite, discovers a shocking secret that leads him on a journey endangering himself and those closest to him.
plot:
I Came By is a 2022 British crime thriller written, co-produced and directed by British-Iranian filmmaker Babak Anvari. It stars George MacKay, Percelle Ascott, Kelly Macdonald and Hugh Bonneville.

Toby Nealey is a 23-year-old graffiti artist with strong political views. He breaks into the homes of the upper classes and leaves the tag "I CAME BY" on their walls. His next target is Sir Hector Blake, a retired High Court judge whom Toby considers a hypocrite despite his liberal public image. Inside, Toby finds a pottery studio and a man held captive in the basement. His former partner-in-crime Jay, preoccupied with his pregnant girlfriend Naz, does not take him seriously, and an anonymous tip leads police to search the house without finding anything. After a row with his widowed mother, Lizzie, Toby goes back to free the prisoner. Blake kills him with a cricket bat, burns the body in his kiln and flushes the ashes away.

Jay plants a letter pointing to Blake in Toby's room. Police find the hidden cell, which Blake claims is a panic room, but his connections get him released quickly. Lizzie begins following him herself. She watches him bring home Omid, a gay Iranian asylum seeker he has promised to help. Flashbacks show Blake's history: his father's affair with an Indo-Persian man, his mother's suicide and his teenage attack on his father's lover. Omid escapes but is afraid to go to the police, and Blake later hunts him down and kills him. Jay refuses to help Lizzie, so she breaks into Blake's house alone and is murdered too. Wracked with guilt, Jay drifts away from Naz. Some time later, he follows Blake from an anniversary celebration at Birlstone School to a country estate. He overpowers him, finds and frees another captive, calls the police and leaves the judge tied up beneath a fresh "I CAME BY" tag.

The film opened in British cinemas on August 19, 2022, and began streaming on Netflix on August 31. Reviews were mixed. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said the film fell short of its Hitchcockian ambitions but benefited greatly from Bonneville's excellent performance against type. Empire praised Bonneville but found the political messaging blunt and the result messy. The Los Angeles Times said the shifts between characters kept the story unpredictable, but at some cost to tension. RogerEbert.com said it crammed a TV season's worth of ideas into one film.

title: Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles
original_title: Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles
tagline: A Billie Eilish Concert Experience.
overview: Fresh off the heels of her brand-new album, "Happier Than Ever," this cinematic concert experience features an intimate performance of every song in the album's sequential order – for the first and only time – from the stage of the legendary Hollywood Bowl.
plot:
The film begins by showing a two-dimensional, animated version of American singer-songwriter Billie Eilish in a recording studio. Picking up a microphone, she leaves the place and drives a Porsche to visit landmarks around Los Angeles. Meanwhile, her live-action self performs the tracks from her second studio album, Happier Than Ever (2021), at the Hollywood Bowl.
Eilish starts with the song "Getting Older", covered in blue lighting as the camera spins around her. The lights switch to a red-orange color for "I Didn't Change My Number". A symphony orchestra accompanies her during the next two performances, the first of which is "Billie Bossa Nova". While Eilish sings the next song, "My Future", a wide shot depicts her animated counterpart on the rooftop of the Roosevelt Hotel, looking across the Los Angeles skyline and contemplating. The animated version returns to her Porsche to drive around the city at high speed.
Back at the Hollywood Bowl, the live-action Eilish prepares for a performance of "Oxytocin". As she sings the song, red lights pulsate in the background; the screen turns to black and white during two verses, and she belts some of the closing lines. Nighttime passes, and the next morning, the animated Eilish awakes to find herself among the clouds, about to sprout angel wings. For "Goldwing", a children's chorus performs its first verse, an excerpt from a religious hymn. They act as backing vocals for Eilish during the rest of the number, and the orchestra reappears to provide accompaniment to go with electronic music. The choir and orchestra are gone once the next song, "Lost Cause", begins. Eilish's performance is interspersed with shots of the Porsche as it travels through Los Angeles at night.
During "Halley's Comet", Eilish returns with the orchestra for another number, and she looks up to see the eponymous comet pass through the sky. Her animated version, sitting in an empty restaurant, also notices the comet. Eilish delivers a spoken-word interlude with "Not My Responsibility" and monologues about the public's obsession with her physical appearance. Shown as a silhouette against a black and red background, her animated self slowly takes her clothes off, is picked apart into bifurcated clones, and submerges herself in water. She rises from the water then levitates, after which the camera transitions back to her live-action self, about to perform "Overheated" with red lights and smoke around her. With "Everybody Dies", the animated Eilish visits a cemetery, and the orchestra helps with the instrumentals.
For "Your Power", Eilish duets with her brother Finneas O'Connell, who plays the acoustic guitar. Her animated counterpart arrives at the Palladium theater, after which paparazzi gather around the entrance to take pictures. Close-up shots of Eilish's face repeatedly flash on the screen as she sings "NDA" with distorted vocals, and the orchestra appears one final time for "Therefore I Am".

title: As in Heaven
overview: One day at the end of the 1800s, 14-year-old Lise’s life is changed forever. She is the eldest of her siblings, the first in her family to go to school and full of hope and confidence in life. But when her mother goes into labour, it quickly appears that something is wrong. As night falls and the labour progresses, Lise begins to understand that a day that began in childhood might end with her becoming the woman of the house.
plot:
As in Heaven (original Danish title Du som er i himlen) is a Danish period drama from 2021 written and directed by Tea Lindeburg, a television director making her feature debut, and adapted from Marie Bregendahl's 1912 novel En dødsnat (A Night of Dying). Flora Ofelia Hofmann Lindahl stars as Lise, with Ida Cæcilie Rasmussen as her mother Anna, Thure Lindhardt as her father Anders, Palma Lindeburg Leth as her cousin Elsbet, Albert Rudbeck Lindhardt as the stablehand Jens Peter, Emil Hornemann Juel as Kristian, and Kirsten Olesen. Marcel Zyskind photographed it, and Kristian Leth wrote the music.

On a prosperous farm in rural Denmark at the end of the 19th century, 14-year-old Lise, the eldest of many children, wakes full of hope. Her mother has overcome her father's objections and won her the chance to go away to school. She borrows her mother's silver hair clip, packs her suitcase and spends a summer day of play, although her father scolds her for behaving like a child, Kristian, a neighbour's son abandoned to work the land, turns on her, and Jens Peter, a boy her mother took in, flirts with her in the hay, where she loses the clip. An ominous dream of blood-red rain has already hinted at what is coming.

Anna, heavily pregnant again, goes into labour, and it soon becomes clear that something is wrong. She has dreamed that the birth would be hard and that the presence of a doctor would mean death, so when the bleeding begins, the wise woman and Anders's mother refuse the midwife's pleas to send for one. The younger children are sent away, but Lise and Elsbet are too old to sleep elsewhere and too young to understand fully what they witness. As night falls and a storm breaks, Lise's childish fantasies give way to desperate bargaining with God and fear that her own wish to better herself is being punished. When the doctor is finally called, it is too late, and a day that began in childhood ends with Lise facing the prospect of becoming the woman of the house.

The film premiered at the 2021 Toronto International Film Festival and competed at the San Sebastián International Film Festival, where Lindeburg won the Silver Shell for best director and Hofmann Lindahl the award for best leading performance. Screen Daily called it an ambitious, technically accomplished debut with a breakthrough lead performance, though its sparse screenplay lets some scenes run long, and The Film Stage praised its beautiful portrait of the danger of religious superstition.

title: Prey
overview: A hiking trip into the wild turns into a desperate bid for survival for five friends on the run from a mysterious shooter.
plot:
Prey is a 2021 German film directed by Thomas Sieben, who wrote the screenplay with Sonja Ewers. It stars David Kross, Hanno Koffler and Maria Ehrich and was released by Netflix on September 10, 2021.

Five friends, Roman, his brother Albert, Peter, Vincent and Stefan, are on a canoeing trip through the forest when they stop for a campfire and hear gunshots in the distance, which they assume mark the start of hunting season. Albert finds a toy unicorn on a hike and pockets it. When another shot wounds Vincent in the hand and further bullets shred their car's tire and windows, they realize a sharpshooter is hunting them. They flee into the trees toward a road, and Albert sprains his ankle in a hole. Calling for help to a woman by a lake, they watch her raise a rifle and kill Stefan: she is the hunter. At a forest information center, a clerk tries to call the emergency services for them, but the gunwoman, Eva, kills both the clerk and Vincent through the window.

Only Peter, Roman and Albert remain. Eva lets them walk away once, and in an abandoned settlement with children's playgrounds Roman finds a laptop video revealing that Eva's baby was once shot by accident, a loss that has driven her to hunt unarmed men. Tensions within the group surface when Peter presses Albert about Lisa, Roman's girlfriend. Peter is soon shot down and executed as he pleads for his life, and Eva wounds Albert but lets Roman drag him away.

Using Albert's fingerprint to unlock his phone, Roman discovers nude photographs of Lisa and realizes his brother has betrayed him. Albert apologizes, but Roman strikes him and hides him in a cave that holds the bodies of other men Eva has shot. Roman climbs out with the unicorn toy and sneaks up behind her; she shoots him in the foot, but when he shows her the toy and she reaches for it, he wrestles away her rifle and throws it aside. Disarmed, Eva throws herself from a cliff, leaving Roman to sit down in exhausted relief.

Kross plays Roman and Koffler plays Albert, with Ehrich as the hunter Eva, Robert Finster as Peter, Yung Ngo as Vincent, Klaus Steinbacher as Stefan, Livia Matthes as Lisa and Nellie Thalbach as Jenny.

title: Till
tagline: Witness the power of a mother’s love.
overview: The true story of Mamie Till Mobley’s relentless pursuit of justice for her 14 year old son, Emmett Till, who, in 1955, was lynched while visiting his cousins in Mississippi.
plot:
Till is a 2022 American biographical drama directed by Chinonye Chukwu, who co-wrote the screenplay with Michael Reilly and Keith Beauchamp. It tells the true story of Mamie Till-Mobley, an educator and activist who pursued justice after the 1955 lynching of her 14-year-old son, Emmett. Danielle Deadwyler stars as Mamie and Jalyn Hall as Emmett, with Frankie Faison, Haley Bennett, Jayme Lawson, Tosin Cole, Sean Patrick Thomas, John Douglas Thompson, Roger Guenveur Smith and Whoopi Goldberg, who also produced the film, in supporting roles.

In August 1955, Mamie, a widowed mother working for the Air Force in Chicago, reluctantly allows her cheerful, outgoing son Emmett, known as Bo, to visit relatives in Money, Mississippi. Fearful of the dangers of the Jim Crow South, she warns him to be careful and deferential around white people. While visiting a local store, Emmett whistles at the white shopkeeper Carolyn Bryant. Days later, her husband and his half-brother abduct Emmett from his great-uncle's home in the middle of the night. His mutilated body is later pulled from the Tallahatchie River.

Devastated, Mamie insists that her son's body be returned to Chicago and makes the courageous decision to hold an open-casket funeral so the world can see what was done to him. Photographs of Emmett's body published in Jet magazine provoke national outrage. Mamie then travels to Mississippi to testify at the murder trial, enduring hostility and threats in a segregated courtroom, and she works with civil rights activists including Medgar and Myrlie Evers. Despite the evidence, an all-white jury acquits the two men. Mamie channels her grief into activism, speaking across the country and helping to galvanize the civil rights movement. Closing titles note the 2022 passage of the Emmett Till Antilynching Act.

Announced in August 2020, the film was shot in Georgia in late 2021. It premiered at the New York Film Festival on October 1, 2022, and was released in the United States by United Artists Releasing on October 14, 2022, coinciding with the unveiling of a statue of Emmett Till in Greenwood, Mississippi. It received critical acclaim, particularly for Deadwyler's performance, which earned BAFTA, Critics' Choice and SAG nominations. Her omission from the Academy Award nominations was widely considered a snub. The National Board of Review named it one of the year's best films.

title: Sundown
overview: When a distant emergency disrupts a vacation in Acapulco, simmering tensions rise to the fore between scions of a wealthy British family.
plot:
Sundown is a 2021 drama film written and directed by the Mexican filmmaker Michel Franco. It stars Tim Roth as Neil Bennett, a wealthy Englishman who abandons his family while on holiday in Mexico after his mother's death, with Charlotte Gainsbourg as his sister Alice, Iazua Larios as Berenice, Henry Goodman as the family lawyer Richard, and Albertine Kotting McMillan and Samuel Bottomley as Alice's children.

Neil, a reserved Londoner, is vacationing at a luxury resort in Acapulco with Alice and her teenage children, Colin and Alexa; the family's fortune comes from the meat-processing business. Neil seems detached from the endless leisure activities. When Alice learns that their mother is in hospital, the family heads for the airport, and on the way news comes that she has died. Alice breaks down while Neil remains calm. At the airport he claims to have left his passport at the hotel and lets the others fly home without him. He moves into a modest hotel recommended by a taxi driver, Jorge, spends his days on the beach and in cheap restaurants, ignores Alice's pleas to return, and begins a relationship with a local woman, Berenice. He reacts with indifference when his belongings are stolen and when he witnesses a shooting.

Alice returns to confront him for deserting her, and Neil signs papers in front of Richard giving up his share of the family assets. Soon afterward Alice is shot dead by criminals driven by Jorge, and police arrest Neil on suspicion of ordering the killing. Only on learning of her death does he break into tears. Released through Richard, he learns that the company is now his, but after a furious confrontation in which Alexa hits him with a bottle, he signs the business over to his niece and nephew in exchange for a monthly pension. He returns to Berenice, but after a fall, a hospital examination reveals that he has brain cancer. Leaving her asleep at his bedside, he walks alone through Mexico City at night, and the film ends on a sunlit beach where his clothes sit empty on a chair.

Franco wrote the screenplay quickly during a personal crisis, and the film was shot in Acapulco and Mexico City. It premiered at the Venice Film Festival on 5 September 2021 and was released in the United States by Bleecker Street in January 2022. Reviews were generally positive, with 77% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 70; critics found its muted tone demanding but praised Roth's strong central performance.

title: Next-Door Nightmare
overview: When young couple Sarah and Kyle move next door to Helen, a charismatic older woman, they have no idea she's a deeply disturbed psychopath who will stop at nothing to become Sarah's surrogate mother, and grandmother to the child she is expecting. Julia Borsellino, Mark Taylor, Deborah Grover, Marium Carvell star. (2021)
plot:
Next-Door Nightmare is a 2021 Canadian thriller television film directed by Gordon Yang and written by Stephen Romano, produced by NB Thrilling Films with Reel One Entertainment for Lifetime, which premiered it in July 2021. It stars Julia Borsellino as Sarah Collins, Mark Taylor as her husband Kyle and Deborah Grover as their neighbor Helen Henderson, with Marium Carvell as Kyle's mother Judith, Michelle Chiu as Sarah's best friend Jennifer, Cait Alexander as Kyle's ex Angela, Deanna Jarvis as the social worker Grace and Ash Catherwood as her colleague David. It runs 86 minutes.

In a snowy prologue, the wealthy widow Helen hounds Kelly, a pregnant young woman whom she insists is her daughter. Fleeing Helen's house, Kelly is killed when she loses control of her car while answering her phone, and when the police come to question Helen she stabs an officer and is committed to a mental hospital. Some nine months later Helen is back in the same house, and Sarah and Kyle, a young couple, move in next door. Helen's own daughter took her life years before, and since then Helen has fixated on young women in troubled marriages who are about to have children, trying to recast them as her family. Sarah, who grew up in a group home with Jennifer and was never adopted, is drawn to Helen's warmth, confiding that Kyle once had an affair, and when she learns she is pregnant Helen celebrates with her like a mother. When Grace, the social worker monitoring her, discovers Helen's shrine to her past obsessions, Helen stabs her and buries her in the snow, and she later kills Judith, who has grown suspicious and found out about Helen's past online. With Kyle often away on business, Helen bribes Angela to set him up in compromising photographs, and Sarah, believing he is cheating again, leaves him. Helen then takes her to a remote country house she has bought, drugs her and holds her captive, intending to raise Sarah and the baby as an all-female family. Jennifer finds the property's address in Helen's trash and Grace's buried body, and Kyle races to rescue his wife as Helen opens fire with a gun.

Mark Gabrish Conlan of Movie Magg considered it better done than most Lifetime films of its type, praising Romano's quick, economical setup, Yang's suspenseful direction and Grover's deliciously unsubtle, full-throated performance. Patrick Serrano of Lifetime Uncorked recapped it with enthusiasm, lamenting the death of Judith.

title: Indemnity
tagline: You Can't Outrun Your Self.
overview: An ex-fireman with PTSD goes on the run when accused of a crime he doesn't even remember committing, leading him down a rabbit hole of conspiracy to the highest degree.
plot:
Indemnity is a 2021 South African action thriller film written and directed by Travis Taute in his feature debut. Produced by Benjamin Overmeyer and Bradley Joshua for Gambit Films, in association with M-Net Films and the National Film and Video Foundation, it stars Jarrid Geduld as a traumatised Cape Town firefighter on the run, with Gail Mabalane, André Jacobs, Nicole Fortuin, Abduragman Adams and Louw Venter. Shot by Zenn van Zyl with music by Kyle Shepherd, and in Afrikaans and English, the film premiered at the Fantasia International Film Festival in August 2021, where it was nominated for the Cheval Noir award, and was released in the United States by Magnet Releasing on 11 February 2022. It runs 124 minutes.

A prologue shows firefighter Theo Abrams (Geduld) and his colleagues battling a catastrophic blaze in a Cape Flats township, where he defies protocol to rescue a baby from a burning home, with tragic consequences that later return to him in flashbacks. Months afterwards he is suspended from his job, suffering from severe post-traumatic stress disorder and dulling it with alcohol rather than through his mandatory therapy sessions. His relationship with his wife Angela (Fortuin), a journalist, is strained, and she has warned him, after a tip from a mysterious informant, that he is in danger. One morning, after an argument, Theo wakes up to find her strangled beside him, with no memory of what happened and the evidence pointing to him. Disbelieved by police detective Rene Williamson (Mabalane) and pursued by deputy police chief Alan Shard, who is determined to catch him before he retires, he escapes when a police van crashes and, while on the run, investigates a conspiracy linked to the shadowy defence contractor M-Tech, which appears to be targeting a list of seemingly unconnected people.

Reviews were generally favourable about the action and less so about the script. Variety praised the sharp fight choreography and stunt work, including an extended hotel-room escape, and Geduld's charismatic performance in moments of panic and rage, but found the dialogue flat and declarative, likened the plot to The Fugitive, The Bourne Identity and The Manchurian Candidate, and felt the late turn into light science fiction strained the budget. Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times wrote that the weight of exposition dragged down a strong premise, while the German critic Christopher Diekhaus singled out Geduld's intensely physical performance.

title: Schumacher
tagline: Rise and shine of the Red Baron
overview: Through exclusive interviews and archival footage, this documentary traces an intimate portrait of seven-time Formula 1 champion Michael Schumacher.
plot:
Schumacher is a 2021 German biographical documentary film about the seven-time Formula One world champion Michael Schumacher, directed by Hanns-Bruno Kammertöns, Vanessa Nöcker and Michael Wech and produced by Nöcker and Benjamin Seikel for B14 Film. Made in cooperation with Schumacher's family, it combines private home videos, Formula One archive footage and new interviews, and was released on Netflix on 15 September 2021, thirty years after his debut at the 1991 Belgian Grand Prix. It runs 112 minutes, in German and English.

The film traces Schumacher's path from karting to the top of motorsport. It shows the modest family restaurant beside his father Rolf's kart track in Kerpen and reveals that the young Michael raced on worn tyres fished out of the bins of better-off rivals, while his brother Ralf recalls the two boys driving on slicks in the rain. Rolf describes the moment his son received his first professional contract from manager Willi Weber. Schumacher's reaction to the death of Ayrton Senna in 1994 is explored through an interview in which he admits he was sleeping perhaps three hours a night. The film covers his collision with Jacques Villeneuve in the 1997 title decider at Jerez and his crash with David Coulthard in 1998, and his years at Ferrari, where Jean Todt admits that management once wondered whether Mika Häkkinen would be the better driver, before Ferrari's run of drivers' titles from 2000 to 2004. Corinna and Todt portray a man who was shy, self-doubting and suspicious of strangers behind his public image, but also a man who loved a party.

The final part turns to the skiing accident in Méribel in December 2013. The family reveals that he had briefly considered going skydiving in Dubai instead. Without disclosing details of his condition, Corinna says he is still there, different but there, receiving therapy at home, and Mick, now himself a Formula One driver, says he would give up everything to be able to talk motorsport with his father. Other interviewees include his daughter Gina-Maria, Sebastian Vettel, Damon Hill, Bernie Ecclestone and Flavio Briatore.

Reception was mixed, with about 60% of 15 critics' reviews positive on Rotten Tomatoes. The Guardian found that Corinna offered singular insight into his private life but judged the film light on detail and somewhat sterile, while the Lexikon des internationalen Films praised the family's moving contributions but faulted the omission of the negative sides of his driving.

title: LEGO Star Wars Terrifying Tales
tagline: Rest in pieces.
overview: Poe Dameron and BB-8 must face the greedy crime boss Graballa the Hutt, who has purchased Darth Vader’s castle and is renovating it into the galaxy’s first all-inclusive Sith-inspired luxury hotel.
plot:
Lego Star Wars: Terrifying Tales is a 2021 animated special based on the Star Wars franchise, produced by Lucasfilm Animation and The Lego Group with Atomic Cartoons. Like The Lego Star Wars Holiday Special, it was directed by Ken Cunningham from a script by David Shayne, and it serves as a stand-alone sequel to the Star Wars sequel trilogy. The voice cast includes Jake Green, Raphael Alejandro, Dana Snyder, Tony Hale and Christian Slater.

Long before the events of the original trilogy, Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader leave Vader's loyal servant Vaneé in charge of Castle Vader on the volcanic planet Mustafar. After the events of The Rise of Skywalker, Resistance pilot Poe Dameron and his droid BB-8 make an emergency landing on Mustafar, where they meet the crime boss Graballa the Hutt, who has bought the castle and is turning it into the galaxy's first all-inclusive Sith-themed luxury hotel. Poe befriends Graballa's young mechanic Dean, who dreams of becoming a pilot, and agrees to record a promotional video for the hotel in exchange for Dean repairing his X-wing. While they wait, the castle's caretaker Vaneé and his assistant droid lead the visitors on a tour, telling three eerie tales tied to ancient artifacts and famous villains from across the saga. The first, told with the helmet of Ren, shows how the young Ben Solo was drawn to the dark side by the leader of the Knights of Ren. The second, centered on the ancient Sith lightsaber known as the Saber of Scardont, follows Maul and General Grievous as they compete for the weapon to win Palpatine's favor. The third, a twist on the classic story "The Monkey's Paw", imagines Luke Skywalker granted wishes by a Wookiee's paw that send him to the dark side alongside his father. All the while, Vaneé is manipulating the Force-sensitive Dean into unlocking the castle's vaults and the Temple of Mustafar, and Poe begins to suspect that the caretaker has sinister plans for the Sith relics he is gathering, leading to a battle for the boy's future.

The special was released exclusively on Disney+ on October 1, 2021. All five critics' reviews counted by the aggregator Rotten Tomatoes were positive.

title: Photocopier
overview: When photos of her at a party cause her to lose a scholarship, a student investigates whether something devastating happened to her that night.
plot:
Photocopier (Indonesian: Penyalin Cahaya) is a 2021 Indonesian crime mystery drama film co-written and directed by Wregas Bhanuteja in his feature debut. It stars Shenina Cinnamon as Suryani, a university student who investigates what happened to her during a night she cannot remember, with Chicco Kurniawan, Lutesha, Jerome Kurnia and Giulio Parengkuan.

Suryani, known as Sur, is a computer science student who builds the website for her campus theater troupe, Mata Hari. When its production of Medusa is chosen for a festival in Kyoto, she goes to a celebration at the home of the troupe's leader, Rama, despite warnings from her father and an older student, Farah, not to drink. She wakes up remembering almost nothing and learns that photos of her drunk have spread online. Her scholarship is revoked, and her father throws her out after she comes home late with an unknown man. Convinced she was drugged, Sur moves in with Amin, who runs a photocopy business, and begins investigating, but footage from Rama's house seems to clear Tariq, who had given her a drink, and others assume she posted the photos herself.

Sur discovers that Rama's art installation, presented as images of the Milky Way, actually consists of altered close-ups of human skin resembling her own birthmarks, and Amin confesses to secretly copying private photos from students' phones for Rama. When she takes her findings to the campus ethics board, they are leaked, and Rama's lawyer pressures her into a public apology. Her mother comes to believe her and hides her with an acquaintance, Siti. Farah and Tariq then admit that they too were drugged and appear in the artwork, and a taxi driver, Burhan, who drove several victims home, provides recordings showing Rama assaulting them, including Sur. Rama arrives with hired men disguised as fumigation workers and destroys the phone holding the evidence, but Sur and Farah print the remaining material on Amin's photocopier on the campus rooftop. Other victims join them, Rama is publicly exposed, and the survivors reveal their own faces.

Shot in twenty days in Jakarta during the COVID-19 pandemic after a year of research that included conversations with survivors, the film premiered in the New Currents competition at the 26th Busan International Film Festival and was released on Netflix in January 2022. It won twelve Citra Awards from seventeen nominations, including Best Picture and Best Director, a record for a single film.

title: Crazy Fist
overview: After an opponent dies mid-match, a prominent MMA champion swore never to fight again and retired to run his family's company. But when his best friend dies under suspicious circumstances, he has no choice but to step back in the ring.
plot:
Crazy Fist (疯狂的拳头) is a 2021 Chinese martial arts action film directed by Guo Qing, who also plays the lead role, and Li Dong-hao, who also wrote the screenplay. The cast includes Steve Yoo, Maya Lau, Wang Wei, Collin Chou, Huang Xiaoming, Zhu Gechengcheng and the former bodybuilder Kai Greene, with a cameo by Zhao Wei. Action choreography was by Wang Jiangyang and Yang Lei. The film was released in Chinese cinemas in spring 2021, screened in the market section of the Busan International Film Festival, and was distributed in North America by Well Go USA, which released it on digital platforms, DVD and Blu-ray on 14 September 2021 and on its Hi-YAH! streaming service.

Shang-hai (Guo), a celebrated mixed martial arts champion, swore never to fight again after an opponent died during one of his matches, and retired to run his family's international business. Mai Wen (Yoo), a rising fighter on his way to becoming a champion, must first defeat one of Shang-hai's students and Shang-hai's best friend, and he falls in love with Shang-hai's sister. Meanwhile Jessica (Zhu), a shady woman who turns out to be part of a drug-smuggling ring, approaches Mai Wen with her own plans. When the bout ends with the death of his friend under suspicious circumstances, Shang-hai has no choice but to step back into the ring, despite his sister's pleas, to uncover the truth. A much larger conspiracy centred on Jessica emerges, and Mai Wen is revealed to be an undercover police officer. The fights include an underground cage surrounded by crocodiles, and the story moves between brightly coloured seaside locations.

Reviews were largely negative. Panos Kotzathanasis of Asian Movie Pulse felt the film prized impression over substance to the point of losing all sense of measure, criticising a nonsensical script, the English dubbing of an already mediocre cast of bodybuilders and models, and choreography slowed by its bulky stars, though he admired its look and Zhu's femme fatale. Derrick Dunn of Reviews & Dunn gave it a D-, crediting only the opening fight between Guo and Greene and calling the rest a disjointed mess that wasted its notable supporting cast. Watch or Pass was kinder, recommending it as a rental for its intense opening, the crocodile ring, its imaginative locales and a comic undercover policeman fond of disguises, while finding the story hard to follow.

title: Catch the Bullet
tagline: The sun never sets on vengeance.
overview: U.S. marshal Britt MacMasters returns from a mission to find his father wounded and his son kidnapped by the outlaw Jed Blake. Hot on their trail, Britt forms a posse with a gunslinging deputy and a stoic Pawnee tracker. But Jed and Britt tread dangerously close to the Red Desert’s Sioux territory.
plot:
Catch the Bullet is a 2021 American Western action film directed by Michael Feifer and written by Jerry Robbins, produced by Feifer Worldwide and released by Lionsgate and Grindstone Entertainment Group. It stars Jay Pickett as U.S. Marshal Britt McMasters, Tom Skerritt as his father Dex, Mason McNulty as his son Chad, Gattlin Griffith as the outlaw Jed Blake, Callder Griffith as Deputy Clay Tucker, Cody Jones as the tracker Chaska and Peter Facinelli as Sheriff Wilkins. It was Pickett's last film, released after his death from a heart attack in July 2021, and is dedicated to him. It runs 88 minutes under the tagline "The sun never sets on vengeance."

In Buffalo, Wyoming, in the late nineteenth century, McMasters is a widowed marshal with a reputation for bringing outlaws back dead, whose long absences have left his twelve-year-old son Chad resentful and in the care of his grandfather Dex. While Britt is away for three months tracking a bank robber and his accomplices, Jed Blake, an escaped prisoner whom McMasters once sent to jail for bank robbery, rides up to the ranch with his gang looking for revenge. Finding the marshal absent, Jed shoots Dex, leaving him badly wounded on the porch, kills Chad's young friend Albert and kidnaps Chad, knowing that his father will follow. When Britt returns and learns what has happened, Sheriff Wilkins, a longtime friend, cannot join the pursuit and assigns his inexperienced deputy Clay Tucker to accompany him. Because Tucker lacks tracking skills, they enlist Chaska, a Pawnee tracker with a white missionary mother, whom the racist deputy refuses to trust. Hot on the gang's trail, the small posse follows Jed into the Red Desert and into Sioux territory, where war parties have left dead settlers in their wake, while Chad tries to escape his captors and Jed prepares to settle his old score with the marshal.

The film was released in select US cinemas and on digital platforms on 10 September 2021, and on DVD and Blu-ray days later. Reviews were mostly negative. Mark Franklin of Once Upon a Time in a Western found it not bad for a modern Western, praising the gritty performances of Pickett and Gattlin Griffith. Jim Morazzini of Nerdly gave it 2.5 out of 5, calling it predictable and flatly directed, and noting that Skerritt and Facinelli had little screen time. Carla Hay of Culture Mix dismissed it as an amateurish dud with cringeworthy dialogue.

title: Crush
tagline: Love is messy AF.
overview: When an aspiring young artist is forced to join her high school track team, she uses it as an opportunity to pursue the girl she's been harboring a long-time crush on. But she soon finds herself falling for an unexpected teammate and discovers what real love feels like.
plot:
Crush is a 2022 American coming-of-age romantic comedy directed by Sammi Cohen in their feature debut and written by Kirsten King and Casey Rackham, who drew on their own experiences to tell an LGBTQ story centered on queer joy rather than on coming out. Rowan Blanchard stars as Paige Evans and Auliʻi Cravalho as AJ Campos, with Isabella Ferreira as AJ's twin sister, Gabby, Tyler Alvarez, Teala Dunn, Aasif Mandvi, Michelle Buteau and Megan Mullally.

Paige, an art-loving student at Miller High School, hopes to attend a summer program at her dream school, CalArts, but struggles with its application prompt asking her to describe her happiest moment, and considers writing about her longtime unrequited crush on the popular Gabby. Meanwhile, an anonymous artist known as KingPun has been covering the school with pun-filled graffiti, and because of her interest in art, Paige is widely suspected. To avoid suspension she agrees to join the track team and to help uncover the real culprit. Lacking athletic talent, she is placed in the 4×100 relay with Gabby and AJ, and AJ is assigned to train her.

Paige enlists AJ's help in her investigation, including at a house party she thinks KingPun will attend. During a stakeout at the school, Paige and Gabby share an awkward first kiss, and Paige's friend Dillon suggests that her crush may simply have faded as she grows closer to AJ. On a team trip to a meet, a game of seven minutes in heaven pairs Paige with AJ and they kiss, which AJ believes is a first for both of them. That night Paige turns down Gabby's attempt to kiss her. After Miller High finishes second in the relay, Gabby apologizes to Paige and inadvertently reveals their earlier kiss, leaving AJ heartbroken; AJ then reveals that she is KingPun. Paige tries to take the blame, only to learn that AJ has already confessed and been suspended. With Gabby's help, Paige makes amends at a school assembly with a large mural of the moments she and AJ have shared, which she also submits to CalArts. AJ's suspension is lifted, and the two reconcile with another kiss.

Filmed in the Syracuse area of New York in the summer of 2021 under the working title Love in Color, Crush was released on Hulu on April 29, 2022, and was the third most-streamed film in the United States that week. It holds 83% on Rotten Tomatoes and 56 on Metacritic, and Variety praised the diversity of its cast and the leads' chemistry.

title: Last Man Down
tagline: They will pay.
overview: After civilization succumbs to a deadly pandemic and his wife is murdered, a special forces soldier abandons his duty and becomes a hermit in the Nordic wilderness. Years later, a wounded woman appears on his doorstep. She's escaped from a lab and her pursuers believe her blood is the key to a worldwide cure. He's hesitant to get involved, but all doubts are cast aside when he discovers her pursuer is none other than Commander Stone, the man that murdered his wife some years ago.
plot:
Last Man Down is a 2021 Swedish-British post-apocalyptic action film directed by Fansu Njie from a screenplay by Andreas Vasshaug, based on a story by Njie and its star Daniel Stisen, who also produced it with Njie through Daniel Stisen Productions and Fansu Film. Stisen, a Norwegian actor from Mandal previously seen in small background roles in films such as Edge of Tomorrow, Spectre and Justice League, plays the lead role, with Olga Kent, Daniel Nehme, Stanislav Yanevski, Madeleine Vall and Natassia Malthe in supporting roles. The film was released on digital and on-demand platforms in North America by Saban Films on 19 October 2021, and became available to buy and rent in Norway in February 2022.

The story is set in a dystopian Europe where most of the population has been wiped out by a deadly virus. John Wood (Stisen), a special forces soldier who is immune to the disease, deserts his armed unit after its commander, Stone (Nehme), takes him captive and murders his wife; Stone is convinced that controlling a cure will hand him an empire. Years later Wood lives as a brooding hermit in a cabin in the Nordic wilderness, spending his days chopping wood, until a badly wounded woman, Maria (Kent), stumbles out of the forest one night. She has escaped from a laboratory, and her pursuers believe her blood holds the key to a worldwide cure. Wood reluctantly nurses her back to health and slowly grows used to her company, but armed soldiers soon track them to the cabin and launch a series of deadly attacks. When he learns that the man hunting Maria is Stone, Wood casts aside his doubts and prepares for a final confrontation.

Critics noted the film's deliberate homage to 1980s muscle-bound action films. Birger Vestmo of NRK's Filmpolitiet gave it three out of six, describing it as an old-fashioned actioner of the kind once rented on VHS, plainly modelled on Commando, with the same awkward one-liners but plenty of cheerful violent drive, and judged that Stisen proved capable of far more than his earlier extra work. Lee B. Golden III of Film Combat Syndicate saw potential in Stisen but found much of the fight work more miss than hit, the timeline confusing and the villain's backstory a contrived twist. Emilie Black of Cinema Crazed praised a few well-executed fights but felt the familiar story lost the viewer's interest early and much of the acting was wooden.

title: Tyson's Run
tagline: With each step comes the determination to take another.
overview: When fifteen-year-old Tyson attends public school for the first time, his life is changed forever. While helping his father clean up after the football team, Tyson befriends champion marathon runner Aklilu. Never letting his autism hold him back, Tyson becomes determined to run his first marathon in hopes of winning his father's approval.  With the help of an unlikely friend and his parents, Tyson learns that with faith in yourself and the courage to take the first step, anything is possible.
plot:
Tyson's Run is a 2022 American sports drama written and directed by Kim Bass, starring Major Dodson as Tyson, an autistic teenager, Rory Cochrane as his father Bobby, a high school football coach, Amy Smart as his mother Eloise and Barkhad Abdi as Aklilu, a former champion marathon runner. The film tells the story of a boy who sets out to win a marathon and, in the process, transforms his relationship with his father.

Tyson has been homeschooled by his mother, but when she can no longer teach him algebra, he asks to attend the public high school where his father coaches football. Bobby, whose own hopes of a professional football career were ended by an injury, has never known how to connect with his son and reluctantly agrees. At school, Tyson is bullied by a student named Bradley but makes a friend in Shannon. Meanwhile, Eloise discovers that she is pregnant and worries that the baby may also be autistic.

Tyson meets Aklilu, a renowned marathon runner who now runs an athletic shoe store, and the two form a friendship. After being falsely blamed for a classmate's misconduct and overhearing his parents arguing about him, Tyson runs away into a violent storm and becomes trapped in a pond. Bobby finds him and, realizing he could lose his son, stays with him until help arrives. Afterward, Bobby resolves to be a better father, and when Tyson announces that he wants to train with Aklilu to run a marathon, Bobby must overcome his doubts, as well as the town's opposition and the controversy surrounding Aklilu's past, to support his son's dream.

The film explores autism, family and perseverance, and Bass was unaware when casting Dodson that the young actor is on the autism spectrum.

Tyson's Run was filmed in Atlanta, Marietta and Stockbridge, Georgia, beginning in July 2018, and released in select theaters in March 2022, earning about 212,800 dollars in its opening weekend. Reviews were mixed; Rotten Tomatoes recorded 60 percent approval from a small number of reviews, and KGET-TV found its pacing weak but praised its family elements.

title: Swim
tagline: If you can't run...
overview: A family gets trapped in their storm flooded vacation rental, tries to escape from a hungry shark that made it's way into the house.
plot:
Swim is a 2021 American shark horror film produced by The Asylum and directed by Jared Cohn, from a script credited to Anthony C. Ferrante, the director of the Sharknado franchise. Its cast includes Jennifer Field, Joey Lawrence, Andy Lauer, Brett Hargrave, Daniel Grogan, Rib Hillis, Addison Bowman, David Hutchison and Trevor B. Nagle. Like several of the studio's titles, it reworks the premise of a recent hit, in this case the survival thriller Crawl, moving the confined-space threat from alligators to a shark.

Lacey Samon (Field) heads to a beach rental house for a week by the sea with her two teenage children, played by Hargrave and Grogan, continuing a family tradition begun by her father Noah (Lauer), an ailing man who relies on an oxygen tank and joins them on the trip. Her husband (Lawrence) is supposed to follow by car from San Francisco. On arrival the family discovers that badly needed repairs on the house were never finished, leaving the basement flooded just as a powerful storm rolls in. What begins as a relaxing getaway turns into a nightmare when the rising floodwater carries a hungry shark into the house. Trapped by the storm, with the water climbing and injuries slowing them down, the family must fend off the predator inside the flooded rooms, improvising weapons from household objects while trying to stay above the waterline. Noah makes a sacrifice to protect the others, and the father finally arrives late in the film to join the fight for survival.

Swim premiered on the free streaming service Tubi on 13 August 2021. Much of it was filmed in a pool and on built sets, and it was shot in a widescreen 2.39:1 format that gave it a slightly more polished look than many comparable low-budget productions. Reviews were largely negative. Knockout Horror gave it one and a half stars out of five, acknowledging the cast's commitment under waterlogged shooting conditions and the film's relatively expensive appearance but criticizing its thin script, implausible casting of family members' ages, shark effects that kept changing scale, poor lighting and visible continuity errors. Cinematic Diversions was more forgiving, rating it six out of ten as an entertaining if clumsy entry in the genre, with decent shark effects and a story that was serviceable by the standards of shark movies, though it mocked the late appearance of top-billed Lawrence.

title: Catwoman: Hunted
tagline: Predator becomes prey.
overview: Catwoman's attempt to steal a priceless jewel puts her squarely in the crosshairs of both a powerful consortium of villains and the ever-resourceful Interpol, not to mention Batwoman.
plot:
Catwoman: Hunted is a 2022 American animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane. Produced by Warner Bros. Animation for DC Entertainment as the 48th entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line, it was directed by Shinsuke Terasawa from a screenplay by Greg Weisman, with animation in an anime style provided by the Japanese studio OLM. Elizabeth Gillies voices Catwoman and Stephanie Beatriz voices Batwoman, with Jonathan Banks, Steve Blum and Lauren Cohan among the supporting cast.

Catwoman slips into a costume party for criminals hosted by Barbara Minerva, believed to lead the secret criminal organization Leviathan, intending to steal the Cat's Eye Emerald from the Gotham City mobster Black Mask. She escapes a horde of gangsters only to be knocked out by Batwoman, while Minerva's associate Tobias Whale recovers the gem, and the furious Minerva puts a price on Catwoman's head. Catwoman wakes up on a plane to Shanghai in the custody of Batwoman and the Interpol agents Julia Pennyworth and King Faraday, who plan to use the emerald as a tracking device to find Leviathan's leadership. Promised a full pardon in return for her help, she agrees, while secretly keeping in touch with her friend Holly, who looks after a group of young girls in her care. At Leviathan's base, Catwoman and Batwoman fight the assassins Cheshire and Nosferata and several of the group's senior members, who are captured, but Minerva escapes.

Pardoned, Catwoman goes back to her life, but she is soon targeted by League of Assassins killers sent by Talia al Ghul, Leviathan's real leader. With Batwoman's help she fights them off, only for the pair to be ambushed by Solomon Grundy. After Catwoman defeats him, Minerva transforms into her monstrous Cheetah form and attacks. Badly wounded, Catwoman taunts her by revealing that she has secretly dismantled one of Leviathan's human trafficking rings and freed its captives. Their brutal fight ends with Batwoman rescuing Catwoman, and Interpol arrests Minerva and Grundy. Warning Faraday that Leviathan is still a threat, Catwoman reclaims the emerald and sets off to rob the Tower of London.

The film was released on Ultra HD Blu-ray, Blu-ray and DVD on February 8, 2022. Reviews were generally positive; IGN's Jesse Schedeen praised it as a fun, anime-flavored adventure among the best in the line.

title: Me Time
tagline: This is not what he had in mind.
overview: With his family away, a devoted stay-at-home dad enjoys his first me time in years by joining his hard-partying old friend on a wild birthday adventure.
plot:
Me Time is a 2022 American buddy comedy written and directed by John Hamburg. Kevin Hart stars as a devoted stay-at-home father and Mark Wahlberg as his free-spirited former best friend, with Regina Hall, Luis Gerardo Méndez and Jimmy O. Yang in supporting roles. Netflix released it on August 26, 2022.

Sonny and Huck were inseparable friends from high school, celebrating Huck's birthday together every year until a near-death experience during one of their adventures fifteen years earlier led Sonny to settle down. Now a stay-at-home dad devoted to his family, Sonny keeps turning down Huck's yearly invitations. When his successful architect wife, Maya, takes their children to visit her parents, Sonny finds himself with some "me time" for the first time in years. He quickly grows bored and lonely: his golf is terrible, a barbecue binge ends badly, his friends are busy and his children do not seem to miss him. He finally accepts Huck's invitation to an extravagant birthday weekend.

Huck's celebration starts with skinny-dipping and a chartered bus and continues in the desert, where the guests are expected to forage for their food. Sonny fends off a mountain lion with an EpiPen. Meanwhile he grows jealous of Armando, Maya's wealthy and charming client, who offers her a major project, and a phone call with his wife turns into a shouting match. When Huck's loan shark arrives demanding the $47,000 he is owed, his enforcer breaks Sonny's finger and burns the camp down. Left alone together, Huck admits that he has fallen on hard times and is lonely. On the way home, the pair break into Armando's house and play pranks that are caught on camera.

Sonny then offers his own house for the rest of Huck's party, which spirals out of control after it is advertised online, with the singer Seal joining Sonny for a jam session. Maya and the children return in the middle of the chaos, and she asks Sonny to move out for a while. During their separation, Sonny apologizes to Armando and reflects on his behavior. At his son's school talent show, he realizes that he has been controlling and selfish, and apologizes to his family. He reconciles with Maya, and persuades Huck to go into business with him as party planners.

Me Time received largely negative reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported only 7% approval, its consensus calling it a desperately unfunny comedy that wastes its stars, and Metacritic gave it 25 out of 100.

title: Bar Fight
tagline: Time to settle the score one drink at a time.
overview: Nina and Allen split everything in their lives 50/50 after their break-up to avoid any drama—everything, that is, except for their favorite local bar. Nina and Allen must compete in a ridiculous, tavern-style custody battle for their prized watering hole, in which lines will be drawn, sides will be chosen, and beers will be drunken.
plot:
Bar Fight! is a 2022 American romantic comedy written and directed by Jim Mahoney and released by IFC Films. Melissa Fumero and Luka Jones star as Nina and Allen, a Los Angeles couple who have just broken up, with Rachel Bloom as Nina's best friend Chelsea, Julian Gant as Allen's business partner Milan, Vik Sahay as the bar's manager Dick, Dot-Marie Jones as the cook Elena, Daniel Dorr and Shontae Saldana as bartenders, Patrick Byas as the bouncer and Hope Lauren as a new waitress, Autumn.

After five years together, Nina and Allen, a laid-back furniture maker, are going through the most amicable of separations, set during the holiday season. When we first meet them they are cheerfully running a yard sale in Venice, and they divide everything, from the furniture to the giant television, fifty-fifty without a single argument. The one thing they cannot split is their favorite local hangout, the Martinez Bar & Lounge. On their first night out as singles, Allen arrives with Milan and Nina with Chelsea, a married mother of two who lives vicariously through her newly unattached friend, and the two exes realise they cannot both remain regulars.

With the staff's loyalties divided, a tavern-style custody battle is devised: Nina and Allen must face each other in a series of bar challenges, and the loser will be banned from the Martinez for good. The contests include a tricycle race through the bar, blindfolded darts, human bowling and a race to collect the most phone numbers from strangers before closing time. Around the competition the film sketches the bar's regulars and employees: a pushover manager who cannot stop an older woman from stealing the copper Moscow Mule mugs, a charming bartender with no ambition, a fearsome cook and a customer who pretends to be an agent to cadge free drinks. In a more wistful final stretch, Allen's settled, stuck-in-place nature and Nina's restlessness come to the surface as the couple confront why they split.

The film was released in theaters, on demand and on AMC+ on 11 November 2022. Reviews were mostly negative, with under a fifth of critics positive on Rotten Tomatoes. The Guardian found the premise nifty but the challenges dull and the main characters underwritten, while Movie Nation felt the comedy ran out of steam after half an hour and that Bloom's manic sidekick was its funniest element; several critics noted the chemistry between Fumero and Jones.

title: Cloudy Mountain
tagline: When a catastrophe comes, no one should be left behind.
overview: The opening of the new tunnel, which took ten years to build, coincided with a series of serious cataclysms. The lives of 160,000 people depend on the actions of two people, a father and a son.
plot:
Cloudy Mountain (Chinese: 峰爆, Fēng bào, "Peak Explosion"; working title 无限深度, "Infinite Depth") is a 2021 Chinese disaster film directed by Li Jun, who co-wrote the screenplay with Sha Song. Produced and presented by China Film and framed as a tribute to China's "railway soldiers", the military corps that built and repaired lines in dangerous terrain, it stars Zhu Yilong, Huang Zhizhong, Chen Shu and Jiao Junyan, with Cheng Taishen and cameos by Zhang Guoli, Zhang Yi, Bai Ke and Li Guangjie. Shot in Guizhou province with action by Bruce Law and music by Guo Sida, it opened in China on 17 September 2021, ahead of the National Day holiday.

In fictional Yunjiang county in south-west China, a construction team is completing a tunnel through Yundang mountain for a high-speed railway after ten years of work, in a region of fragile karst rock destabilised by movement of the Indian Ocean plate. When a blast supervised by the young engineer Hong Yizhou (Zhu) floods the tunnel, he and his girlfriend, the radar technician Lu Xiaojin (Jiao), divert the water into a cavern, and project manager Ding Yajun (Chen) halts work, although her superiors insist the line must open on time. Abseiling down the mountain to place sensors, Yizhou finds abnormal rock activity. Meanwhile his gruff father, the retired railway soldier Hong Yunbing (Huang), arrives in town just as an earthquake strikes and a vast sinkhole swallows his coach. After helping rescue survivors, Yunbing disappears underground, where he leads a small group of survivors, including a stowaway boy, through the caves. Yizhou races to find him and takes over the group, but old tensions between father and son resurface. Ding plans to blast away part of the mountain to stop it collapsing onto the rail bridge, but the predicted landslide shifts towards Yunjiang, a town of 160,000 that cannot be evacuated in time, as a storm approaches. To save the town, the railway builders resolve to blow up the tunnel that cost them a decade of work; Yizhou proves himself to his father, overcoming a phobia from his youth, and a great sacrifice is made along the way.

The film grossed just under 440 million yuan in China. Sino-Cinema rated it 6/10, finding it a solid but by-the-book disaster movie that starts strongly but becomes increasingly cartoonish and implausible in its patriotic second half, and judging Huang a stronger presence than Zhu; Cheng Taishen stood out as a veteran chief engineer.

title: Emily the Criminal
tagline: High risks come with even higher rewards.
overview: Emily, who is saddled with student debt and locked out of the job market due to a minor criminal record, gets involved in a credit card scam that pulls her into the criminal underworld of Los Angeles, ultimately leading to deadly consequences.
plot:
Emily Benetto lives in Los Angeles and works as an independent contractor delivering food for a catering company. She is deeply in debt as she struggles to pay student loans. A felony conviction for aggravated assault prevents her from obtaining a well-paying job.
A co-worker connects Emily to a "dummy shopper" service that promises to make her $200 in one hour. The service is revealed to be a credit card fraud ring. Emily meets Youcef, one of its organizers, who instructs her to purchase a flat-screen TV using a fake card and ID. The next day, Emily is sent to purchase a car. However, the dealer discovers the scam, leading to a physical altercation and Emily being injured.
As Youcef tends to her wounds, they discuss their aspirations. Emily, an aspiring artist, wishes to visit South America, while Youcef plans to purchase a rental property. Emily asks for a bigger role in his operation, and Youcef teaches her how to make fake credit cards. He gives her a taser for protection and instructs her not to sell stolen goods at her home or scam the same store twice in a week. When Youcef's partner and cousin Khalil discovers them together, Youcef denies working with Emily. While Emily dogsits for her childhood friend Liz, a buyer finds her apartment and robs her earnings, taking the dog as well. She tases the buyer and reclaims both.
Emily invites Youcef to a party, which sparks a romance between them. When there is an opening at Liz's advertising agency, she gets Emily an interview with her boss Alice. However, at the interview, Emily discovers that the "job" is an unpaid internship and walks out.
At a dinner with Youcef's family, Khalil reveals that Emily has been caught hitting the same store twice within a week, prompting the store to post security footage of her online. This leads to a falling-out between Youcef and Khalil, who cuts him out of the fraud ring and refuses to pay him for his past work. Youcef decides to rob the fraud ring itself. He and Emily arrive at the ring's storage unit to find that Khalil has taken everything and emptied their shared business bank account. Emily then convinces Youcef to ambush Khalil at his safehouse.
Ambushing a guy on lookout and luring out the other ring members with a fake carjacking, they enter the safehouse, where Khalil severely injures Youcef before Emily can subdue him. Taking the ring's money and assisting Youcef to his car, she realizes they have lost his keys and cannot drive away. As police and ambulance sirens draw closer, Emily abandons Youcef in his car and flees with the money.
The police raid Emily's apartment and find it empty. Now living in South America, she returns to making art. She also establishes a credit card fraud ring of her own, recruiting dummy shoppers with the promise of making $200 in one hour.

title: A Day to Die
tagline: Only the savage survive.
overview: A disgraced parole officer is indebted to a local gang leader and forced to pull off a series of dangerous drug heists within twelve hours in order to pay the $2 million dollars he owes, rescue his kidnapped pregnant wife, and settle a score with the city's corrupt police chief, who is working with the gang leader and double-crossed him years ago.
plot:
A Day to Die is a 2022 American heist action thriller directed, co-written and co-produced by Wes Miller. It stars Kevin Dillon as Connor Connolly, Leon as the drug kingpin Tyrone Pettis, Frank Grillo as Brice Mason and Bruce Willis as the corrupt police official Alston, with Gianni Capaldi, Brooke Butler and Vernon Davis. It was one of the low-budget films Willis made in 2021, shortly before he retired from acting following the disclosure of his cognitive decline.

The film opens with a hostage rescue carried out by Connor, Mason and their elite team on the orders of police captain Alston, an operation that goes badly wrong and leads to the team's breakup. Eighteen months later, Connor is a disgraced but dedicated parole officer, while Alston has risen to police chief. After Connor is forced into killing one of Pettis's young enforcers, a death that leaves him in the kingpin's debt, Pettis kidnaps his pregnant wife Candice and gives him twelve hours to pull off a series of dangerous drug heists and deliver the two million dollars he supposedly owes. Desperate, Connor reunites his old crew, including his brother Tim, Mason, Dwayne and Steve. Pettis is secretly in an uneasy alliance with Alston, financing his political rise in return for protection, and the drug house he sends the team to rob belongs to his main rival. After the heists and a confrontation in which Candice is rescued, Connor and Pettis reach a mutual understanding and stage one final heist to disrupt Alston's criminal operations. Alston is caught on camera shooting a subordinate who was catching on to his schemes and is arrested, while Connor, Pettis and Candice flee the country.

Principal photography began in March 2021 in Jackson, Mississippi, the first feature shot in the city that year, and wrapped after six weeks in April, with final scenes filmed at Hawkins Field Airport. Vertical Entertainment acquired the rights in May 2021 and released it in select theaters and on video on demand on 4 March 2022. Against a five-million-dollar budget, it grossed under 100,000 dollars abroad. Critics found it generic. Decider advised viewers to skip it, faulting a choppy, confusing opening, awkward CGI blood and a muddled plot with a finale borrowed from Heat, while praising Leon's performance and Grillo's gravitas and noting that many of Willis's lines are delivered over the phone. Some action-focused outlets called it a serviceable, bullet-riddled time-waster with a strong final battle.

title: Mickey's Tale of Two Witches
overview: On Halloween, Mickey tells a tale of two witches-in-training, Minnie and Daisy, who must pass four tests to graduate from the With Academy in Happy Haunt Hills.
plot:
Mickey's Tale of Two Witches is a 2021 American animated Halloween television special produced by Disney Television Animation for Disney Junior. Directed by Jeff Gordon and written by Thomas Hart, it runs about 46 minutes and was the first special spun off from the series Mickey Mouse Mixed-Up Adventures, followed later in 2021 by Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas. It premiered on Disney Junior on 7 October 2021, was made available on DisneyNow, and began streaming on Disney+ the following day.

On Halloween, Mickey tells Pluto a story about two witches-in-training, Minnie the Wonderful and Daisy Doozy, who must pass four magical tests set by Witch Master Clarabelle in order to graduate from the Witch Academy in Happy Haunt Hills. Daisy doubts herself at every test. Their studies are disrupted when a mischievous ghost gets hold of the powerful Moo Wand, and the two apprentices join forces with Count Mickula and the rest of the gang, who appear in Halloween guises such as Franken-Goof, Mummy Donald and Werewolfy Pluto, to defeat him. Along the way Minnie and Daisy learn that working together makes both their magic and their friendship stronger.

The voice cast is led by Bret Iwan as Mickey and Count Mickula, Kaitlyn Robrock as Minnie, Tress MacNeille as Daisy and April Winchell as Clarabelle, with Bill Farmer as Goofy and Pluto, Daniel Ross as Donald, Jim Cummings as Pete the Ghost, Nika Futterman as Cuckoo-Loca and Frank Welker as Figaro and Butch the Bulldog. The special features four songs: "How to Witch", sung by the two witches and their teacher; "The Fright Stuff", performed by Pete the Ghost; "Spooky Side"; and the finale "Spooky Spirit".

Its first airing on Disney Junior drew about 350,000 viewers, and a Disney Channel rebroadcast the next morning about 300,000. Critics recommended it as Halloween viewing for young children: Kristy Ambrose of TheGamer named it one of the best Disney Halloween films, praising its sweetness and its message that magic works best when friendship is the main ingredient, Real Simple called it a "super sweet" choice for families, and Good Housekeeping and Romper highlighted its emphasis on teamwork and its songs and spells. It was nominated at the 2023 Kidscreen Awards, and in July 2023 Disney Publishing Worldwide released a tie-in book.

title: Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas
original_title: Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas
overview: After a series of mishaps, Mickey, Minnie and the gang are separated all over the world and must try to get back to Hot Dog Hills by Christmas Eve. A mysterious and jolly stranger shows up to tell them about The Wishing Star, which could be the secret to bringing everybody home in time to celebrate together.
plot:
Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas is a 2021 animated television special produced by Disney Television Animation, featuring the iconic characters from the Mickey Mouse universe. The story revolves around Mickey and Minnie's holiday season, filled with festive cheer, adventure, and heartwarming moments.

The special begins on a snowy winter evening in Toontown, where Mickey and Minnie are busy preparing for Christmas. They decorate their home, bake cookies, and sing festive tunes to get into the holiday spirit. However, things take an unexpected turn when Minnie's magical Christmas ornament goes missing.

As the night falls, Minnie becomes worried that she'll lose her special gift from Santa Claus. Mickey decides to help his beloved partner find the ornament, and they embark on a thrilling adventure through Toontown. Along the way, they meet various friends, including Pluto, Goofy, and Donald Duck, who join in the quest.

As they search for the missing ornament, Mickey and Minnie encounter a mischievous character named Pete, who's trying to ruin Christmas for everyone in Toontown. With the help of their friends, Mickey and Minnie outsmart Pete and his accomplices, leading them on a wild goose chase through the snowy streets.

Throughout their journey, Mickey and Minnie learn valuable lessons about the true meaning of Christmas: kindness, generosity, and the importance of spending quality time with loved ones. As they near the end of their quest, they discover that the missing ornament was hidden in a special place, where it would bring joy to all those who found it.

In the end, Mickey and Minnie successfully recover the ornament, and Christmas magic is restored to Toontown. The special concludes with a heartwarming scene of Mickey and Minnie sharing a romantic dinner, surrounded by their friends and family, as they celebrate the holiday season together.

Throughout the special, Disney Television Animation brings its signature charm and wit to the story, infusing it with humor, excitement, and warmth. The animation is vibrant and colorful, perfectly capturing the whimsical spirit of Toontown. Mickey and Minnie's chemistry shines through in their interactions, making their adventure a delightful treat for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas is a delightful holiday special that celebrates the joy, love, and magic of the season. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and festive atmosphere, it's sure to become a cherished tradition for families and Disney fans alike.

title: The Curse of Bridge Hollow
tagline: Halloween comes to life.
overview: A Halloween-hating dad reluctantly teams up with his teenage daughter when an evil spirit wreaks havoc by making their town's decorations come to life.
plot:
The Curse of Bridge Hollow is a 2022 American supernatural comedy horror film directed by Jeff Wadlow from a screenplay by Todd Berger and Robert Rugan. Marlon Wayans stars as a scientist who has no patience for Halloween, with Priah Ferguson as his daughter, Kelly Rowland as his wife, and John Michael Higgins, Lauren Lapkus, Rob Riggle and Nia Vardalos in supporting roles. Netflix released the film on October 14, 2022.

The Gordon family moves from Brooklyn to the small town of Bridge Hollow, which is obsessed with Halloween. Teenage Sydney, known as Syd, is delighted by the town's elaborate decorations and celebrations, while her father, Howard, a rational scientist who dismisses anything supernatural, finds them ridiculous. At her new school, Syd meets the members of the Paranormal Society, who tell her that the Gordons' new house is believed to be haunted. Her mother, Emily, tries to join in the community spirit by baking healthy, gluten-free and sugar-free treats for the town's Stingy Jack festival.

In the house, Syd finds an old jack-o'-lantern and lights it, unwittingly releasing the evil spirit of Stingy Jack. Jack brings the town's Halloween decorations to life, turning them into his menacing minions, and must claim a soul at midnight to take his place in the lantern. Syd and a reluctant Howard visit an elderly woman in a nursing home who explains the curse.

As the possessed decorations wreak havoc, Syd, Howard and the Paranormal Society search for a way to trap Jack again. They learn that a page from an old spell book containing the necessary incantation is held by their school principal, and later seek the words from the ghost of the book's original owner, who haunts the Gordons' house. While the others try to protect the town square from the rampaging decorations, Syd and Howard realize that Emily has gone home and is in danger.

Jack, mistaking Emily for the person who released him, tries to take her soul. Howard repeatedly attempts the incantation, but it works only when Syd reminds him that he must believe in it. Jack is trapped once more, and the decorations fall lifeless. Afterward, Howard embraces Halloween, Syd joins the Paranormal Society, and Emily abandons her healthy recipes. As Howard and Syd store the lantern, they discover a hidden room filled with more boxes of lanterns.

The film received mixed to negative reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported 46% approval and Metacritic a score of 38.

title: Your Christmas Or Mine?
overview: Students Hayley and James are young and in love. After saying goodbye for Christmas at a London train station, they both make the same mad split-second decision to swap trains and surprise each other. Passing each other in the station, they are completely unaware that they have just swapped Christmases.
plot:
Your Christmas or Mine? is a 2022 British Christmas romantic comedy directed by Jim O'Hanlon from a screenplay by Tom Parry. Asa Butterfield and Cora Kirk star as a young couple who each decide to surprise the other over the holidays, with Daniel Mays, Angela Griffin, Harriet Walter, David Bradley and Alex Jennings. It was filmed in and around London and Buckinghamshire in 2021.

University students James Hughes and Hayley Taylor are in love but have kept their relationship secret from their families. Parting at a London station before Christmas, each impulsively jumps aboard the other's train in order to surprise them, and both end up spending the holiday with the other's family. Hayley arrives at the grand country house of James's widowed, stern father, Humphrey, an aristocrat and former army officer, while James finds himself among Hayley's loud, warm, working-class family in Macclesfield. A heavy snowfall cancels every train, leaving them stranded. They agree to keep up appearances; Humphrey believes that James is training at Sandhurst, unaware that he long ago dropped out to study drama, and Hayley's attempt to pose as a fellow cadet quickly collapses.

Hayley tries to brighten the gloomy house with decorations, but she accidentally lets out Humphrey's dog, which is wounded by an elderly neighbor, Jack, and she infuriates Humphrey by taking the decorations from the study of his late wife, Fiona, a room he has kept closed. Meanwhile James is welcomed with open arms until he meets Steve, who introduces himself as Hayley's fiancé without mentioning that she broke up with him months earlier. Goaded by Steve during family games, James loses his temper, reveals that he is Hayley's boyfriend and storms off.

After an angry phone call with James, Hayley sets off on foot through the snow without her asthma inhaler and collapses. Humphrey, who has admitted to Iris, a member of his household, that grief has consumed him since Fiona's death, finds and rescues her with the help of his dog. Hayley's family, relieved that she has left Steve, drive James back to his father's house, and the couple reconcile. Humphrey makes peace with Jack, who turns out to be his own estranged father, and at a joint Christmas dinner at the Taylors' home, he accepts James's choice to pursue acting.

Released on Prime Video on December 2, 2022, it drew generally positive reviews, though some found it reliant on familiar tropes. A sequel followed in 2023.

title: Megalodon Rising
tagline: Too big to fail.
overview: When history’s greatest aquatic predator returns, the armada of modern warships sent to destroy it has no chance at all.
plot:
Megalodon Rising is a 2021 American action and science fiction creature film directed by Brian Nowak and produced by The Asylum as a sequel to its 2018 film Megalodon, once again trading on the popularity of the studio blockbuster The Meg. Tom Sizemore receives top billing as Commander Moore, although he appears only briefly in his office, while the lead role of Captain Emily Lynch, sister of the commander from the first film, is played by Wynter Eddins. The cast also includes O'Shay Neal as Lieutenant Commander Ahearn, Freda Yifan Jing as Dr. Lee, Zhan Wang as Captain Ping, Lisa Lee as Tuan and Chris Grant Wenchell as Samperio.

After a Chinese warship enters American waters while relaying classified US government information to a satellite, it is attacked and sunk by a megalodon. Nearby, an American warship commanded by Lynch is on patrol; Lynch is troubled because her sister faces a court-martial for allegedly sinking her own ship on purpose, and her claim that a giant shark was responsible has been dismissed as a lie. The crew recovers Dr. Lee, a scientist who survived the sinking in a life raft, and another Chinese warship under Captain Ping demands her return, threatening to treat a refusal as an act of war, with the crewmember Tuan acting as interpreter.

Tensions rise when three megalodons attack the Chinese ship and then the American vessel, leading Ping to suspect the Americans can control the sharks. When gunner Samperio kills one of the creatures, the others feed on it, allowing the ships to escape. Lynch contacts Moore, and the sharks head for a crowded beach in San Diego, where troops are sent to defend the coast; Dr. Lee and the radio operator Wilco lure them away by imitating the satellite signal. Returning to sea, the sharks sink the Chinese reinforcements one by one. The Americans rescue the Chinese survivors, kill a second shark with their guns, and Lynch makes peace with Ping before the two crews kill the last one together, although Wilco dies. Lynch publicly announces the attacks and the new alliance with China, but a final sonar reading reveals two more objects in the ocean.

Because of COVID-19 restrictions, the film used very few extras, and the sharks and many warship shots were created with CGI. German critics dismissed its effects, dialogue and characters, finding little to recommend beyond the sharks themselves.

title: The Passenger
tagline: Don't sit next to her
overview: Four people traveling in a van run over a lone woman while she is walking in the dark down a country road. After loading her into the vehicle to take her to the nearest hospital, they notice that she is behaving rather strangely. The occupants of the van soon realise that the time has come to fight for their lives, and together they agree on one very simple rule: "do not sit next to her."
plot:
The Passenger (Spanish: La pasajera) is a 2021 Spanish science-fiction comedy horror road movie directed by Raúl Cerezo and Fernando González Gómez. Ramiro Blas, Cecilia Suárez, Paula Gallego and Cristina Alcázar lead the cast. The screenplay was written by Luis Sánchez-Polack, based on an earlier script by Javier Echániz and Asier Guerricaechebarría.

The story brings together four very different people who share a ride in a battered van across the sparsely populated Spanish countryside. Behind the wheel is a crude, middle-aged driver with outdated attitudes and a fondness for crass jokes. His passengers are a pious Mexican woman and a well-to-do woman traveling with her rebellious teenage daughter, with whom she has a tense relationship. The awkward journey, filled with bickering and uncomfortable silences, takes a dark turn after an accident on a lonely road at night. The group soon comes into contact with an extraterrestrial parasite that takes possession of women's bodies and decapitates men, and the mismatched travelers are forced to set aside their differences in a desperate fight for survival as night falls.

The film is a co-production of Persons Films, La Dalia Films, SG Producciones and Eye Slice Pictures, with support from the Government of Navarre and the Navarra Film Office, and it was shot entirely in Navarre. It screened at the Sitges Film Festival on 9 October 2021 and was released theatrically in Spain by Karma Films on 18 February 2022. Dark Star Pictures distributed it in the United States, opening it in a limited theatrical release on 3 June 2022 ahead of streaming and DVD availability later that month.

The film received generally positive notices. Rotten Tomatoes reports a 73% approval rating from 15 reviews, with an average of 6.5/10. Dennis Harvey of Variety felt that although it never transcends its creature-feature premise, its style and humor make reaching a familiar destination more fun than most similar films, and Andrew Mack of ScreenAnarchy praised the way it sprinkles its action with dark humor. Pablo Tocino of Mondosonoro singled out the performances of Ramiro Blas and Paula Gallego. Other Spanish critics were cooler: Miguel Ángel Romero of Cinemanía and Beatriz Martínez of El Periódico de Catalunya each gave it two stars out of five, the latter pointing to the film's ambiguous attitude toward machismo, while Romero described a blend of B-movie exploitation and Spanish costumbrismo.
