title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
original_title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
tagline: Everybody loves Marcel.
overview: Marcel is an adorable one-inch-tall shell who ekes out a colorful existence with his grandmother Connie and their pet lint, Alan. Once part of a sprawling community of shells, they now live alone as the sole survivors of a mysterious tragedy. But when a documentary filmmaker discovers them amongst the clutter of his Airbnb, the short film he posts online brings Marcel millions of passionate fans, as well as unprecedented dangers and a new hope at finding his long-lost family.
plot:
Following the end of his marriage, documentary filmmaker Dean moves into an Airbnb and discovers Marcel, a one-inch-tall talking shell living in the home with his grandmother, Nana Connie, and Alan, his pet ball of lint.
Inspired by Marcel's whimsicality, resourcefulness, and fascination with the world, Dean begins filming Marcel's daily activities, most of which consist of gathering resources from the backyard in order to support himself and Nana Connie. Connie is wise but has some dementia. She tends to her garden assisted by insects she has befriended. Marcel and Connie share their mutual love of 60 Minutes and Lesley Stahl.
After Dean uploads his first video about Marcel to YouTube, it quickly becomes a cultural phenomenon. Marcel is both flattered and overwhelmed with his newfound popularity, lamenting that his family is not around to celebrate it with him. Marcel explains to Dean that there used to be an entire community of shells on the property, including Marcel's mother, father, brother, and aunt. The shells would take shelter in a sock drawer when the house's previous owners, Mark and Larissa, started knocking objects over while fighting. Following one fight, Mark accidentally packed the shells into his suitcase while moving out, leaving Marcel and Connie the only ones left on the property.
Dean helps Marcel produce a livestream on the Internet asking for help in locating his family. The livestream gains a substantial number of viewers, but after Marcel shares his location with viewers, the house becomes a popular area for influencers. Marcel becomes dismayed after realizing most of the people who saw his videos are fans desperate to be associated with him but largely uninterested in helping him.
The constant attention to the house quickly begins to bother Marcel, who is worried about Connie's deteriorating health. Marcel convinces Dean to drive him around the city in search of Mark's car but is overwhelmed to discover how large and vast the world outside his house really is. Realizing that the world is too big to likely discover the car on his own, a discouraged Marcel returns home to find Connie has fallen off the top of a washing machine and cracked her shell. Marcel tends to her wounds and grows more protective of Connie.
As a result of Marcel's Internet popularity, 60 Minutes reaches out to Marcel in the hopes of doing a cover story. Despite Dean's encouragement, Marcel is reluctant to accept the offer, concerned with what the large production crew and more attention to the house would do to Connie's health. Marcel tells Dean he will not accept the interview until Connie is fully recovered. Dean confides this information to a fast-deteriorating Connie. Wanting Marcel to live a meaningful life of his own, Connie pretends to show signs of improvement around Marcel while encouraging him to accept the interview. Despite his strong reservations, Marcel eventually agrees to the interview, believing it may help him find his family.

title: Sanctuary
tagline: Play by her rules.
overview: Confined to a claustrophobic hotel room, the heir to a hotel empire and the dominatrix who has primed him for success become locked in a battle of wits and wills as he tries to end his relationship with her.
plot:
Sanctuary is a 2022 American dark comedy psychological thriller film directed by Zachary Wigon from a screenplay by Micah Bloomberg. Margaret Qualley stars as Rebecca Marin, a dominatrix, and Christopher Abbott as Hal Porterfield, her wealthy client, who share an emotionally explosive final session as he prepares to take over his late father's hotel empire. The casting of Qualley and Abbott was announced in September 2021, and principal photography took place in New York City.

Hal orders room service in a luxurious hotel suite as Rebecca arrives, apparently to interview him for the job of chief executive of the hotel chain. Her questions grow increasingly personal and humiliating, and it becomes clear that she is a dominatrix following a script that Hal himself has written. Over dinner afterward, out of character, Hal explains that with his father's death he is about to become CEO of the family company, that their relationship no longer fits his new life, and that this must be their last session; he offers her an expensive watch as a farewell gift. Insulted, Rebecca storms out, only to return and turn the tables, arguing, with the help of his father's management book, that Hal is unfit to lead and demanding a large share of his first year's salary, under threat of releasing recordings of their sessions. What follows is a long night of shifting power in which Hal veers between nonchalance and fury, tearing the suite apart in search of a hidden camera, while Rebecca alternates between mockery, seduction and vulnerability. Each tries to gain control over the other through money, threats and violence, and the line between real emotion and role play blurs as Rebecca insists that she has given up her old life because she only feels fully herself during their sessions. Even their safe word fails to end the game, and with Hal at breaking point, the pair are forced to confront what they truly mean to each other.

Sanctuary premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 11, 2022, and was acquired by Neon, which gave it a limited theatrical release in the United States on May 19, 2023. Critics praised the two lead performances; it holds an 88% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus says it confounds expectations with élan, and a Metacritic score of 67.

title: The Hunting
tagline: Hunger runs deep.
overview: When a mysterious animal attack leaves a mutilated body in the forest, a conservative small town detective must enlist the help of an eager wildlife specialist to uncover the dark and disturbing truth that threatens the town.
plot:
The Hunting is a 2021 American werewolf horror film written and directed by Mark Andrew Hamer, co-written by Heather Ryan and Terrance Ryan; all three were making their feature debuts. Produced by Moonphase Media and Bright Shiny Things, it stars former NFL fullback Peyton Hillis, a Madden NFL 12 cover athlete appearing in his first leading film role, alongside Joelle Westwood, Joaquin Guerrero, Keith Migra, Angela Cole, Daniel Repas, Alan Tuskes, Heidi Azaro, Billy Grimm and Matt Tifft. Vertical Entertainment gave the film a limited theatrical release and put it on digital and video-on-demand platforms in January 2022. It runs 91 minutes.

The film opens with a half-glimpsed furry creature killing a drunken fisherman on a lake under the full moon. When he fails to come home, his wife Sarah (Cole) reports him missing, one of several disappearances troubling the small town. Police chief Galligan (Repas) sends Detective Ryan Conner (Hillis), a tough, conservative military veteran haunted by memories of his wartime service, to investigate with his partner Dave (Migra), the chief's son. Meanwhile, at Talbot's Wolf Sanctuary, Maggie Talbot (Westwood) marks the first anniversary of her parents' deaths while trying, with the help of Todd (Guerrero), to keep their dream alive. When a mutilated body is found in the forest after a mysterious animal attack, Conner is forced to enlist the eager wildlife specialist to help him uncover the dark truth threatening the town. Flashbacks to Conner's combat experience punctuate the investigation, and the hunt ends with a twist revealing the identity of the creature.

The film drew mixed reviews. Jim Morazzini, writing for Voices From the Balcony in a review republished by Nerdly, gave it two and a half stars out of five, finding it badly flawed but watchable; he praised the use of a practical man-in-a-suit creature rather than CGI but felt the heavy subplot about post-traumatic stress disorder would alienate viewers expecting a werewolf film, and called the final reveal, which hinges on a character never established as a suspect, a lazy cheat. Jeff Turner of Action Reloaded was more enthusiastic, calling it a howling good time with solid performances from Hillis and Westwood, intriguing backstories, a gruesome war flashback and an effective practical-effects creature, and noting that the ending left the door open for a sequel.

title: The Honeymoon
overview: Englishman Adam and his American bride Sarah are about to embark on the romantic honeymoon of a lifetime in Venice, Italy. But when the newlyweds’ trip is gatecrashed by Adam’s excessively needy best friend, Ed, it inadvertently turns their perfect lovers’ holiday into a complete disaster.
plot:
The Honeymoon is a 2022 romantic comedy written and directed by Dean Craig. Maria Bakalova and Pico Alexander star as a newly married couple whose trip to Venice is thrown into chaos by the groom's clingy best friend, played by Asim Chaudhry, while Lucas Bravo appears as a charismatic Italian gangster. The cast also includes Flynn Allen as a teenage version of the groom, Marco Valerio Montesano, Michele Enrico Montesano and Kai Portman, with Myha'la Herrold appearing as herself. Bakalova also served as a co-producer.

The story centers on Adam, who sweeps his new wife Sarah off to Venice for their honeymoon. The romantic getaway is compromised from the start, however, because Adam has invited his best friend Bav to come along. Bav, emotionally needy and lacking any sense of boundaries, attaches himself to the couple and sets off one embarrassing, gross-out mishap after another, leaving the newlyweds with almost no time alone. Matters grow more complicated when Sarah catches the eye of Giorgio, a suave local criminal who is immediately smitten with her. To clear the way to winning her over, Giorgio arranges to get rid of the two men by sending Adam and Bav across the border on a drug-smuggling errand, turning the holiday into a farcical crime caper in which the hapless pair must find a way back to Sarah before her new admirer succeeds in stealing her away.

The project was announced in August 2021, when Bakalova, Alexander, Chaudhry and Bravo were confirmed as the leads, with Craig directing from his own screenplay. Craig was previously best known as the writer of the British farce Death at a Funeral. Principal photography took place in Venice and Rome beginning in August 2021 and wrapped on 14 October 2021.

In July 2022 Amazon Studios acquired distribution rights for the United Kingdom and several European territories, Grindstone Entertainment Group took the rights for the United States and Canada, and Notorious Pictures secured Italy and Spain. The film opened in a limited theatrical release in the United States on 16 December 2022, simultaneously with digital and on-demand availability. It premiered in the United Kingdom on Amazon Prime Video on 29 December 2022, and Amazon also released it in Germany, Belgium, France, Scandinavia and Eastern Europe. Lionsgate issued it on Blu-ray on 24 January 2023.

title: Pursuit
tagline: They'll never be friends. But they're no longer enemies.
overview: Detective Breslin crosses paths with Calloway, a ruthless hacker desperate to find his wife, who has been kidnapped by a drug cartel. When Calloway escapes police custody, Breslin joins forces with a no-nonsense female cop to reclaim his prisoner. But is Calloway’s crime-boss father somehow involved in this explosive situation?
plot:
Pursuit is a 2022 American action thriller film directed by Brian Skiba and starring Emile Hirsch and John Cusack, with Jake Manley, Elizabeth Faith Ludlow, Graham Patrick Martin, Alexandria DeBerry and William Katt. The film centers on a police detective and a notorious hacker whose separate quests for their wives collide amid a war between drug traffickers.

Detective Mike Breslin is a straight-laced, honest cop still grieving his pregnant wife, who was murdered a few months earlier. He crosses paths with Rick Calloway, a ruthless, facially tattooed master hacker known by the alias Thanatos, who comes from an old Southern crime family headed by his father, played by Cusack. Rick's own wife has been kidnapped by a drug cartel, and he is desperate to save her. After being arrested, Rick offers to use his hacking skills to help Breslin track down the men who killed his wife, but the detective refuses the deal.

While being transported back to his hometown, Rick escapes from police custody. Breslin sets out to recapture his prisoner and joins forces with Zoe Carter, a no-nonsense local cop who has her own quiet agenda. As the two parallel stories unfold, with Rick's father overseeing his criminal operation and issuing orders to his men while grilling meat for his grandson, a series of cartel betrayals, bloody twists and violent encounters drive the characters toward one another. The pursuit finally converges in a chaotic climax filled with gunfights and a high body count.

Principal photography took place in Little Rock, Arkansas, in July 2021, and filming had wrapped by November. Lionsgate Home Entertainment released Pursuit direct to video on February 18, 2022. Reviews were overwhelmingly negative, and the film holds an 8% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Lisa Kennedy of The New York Times wrote that in an earlier era the film would have gone straight from postproduction into a bargain bin at a rundown video store. Leslie Felperin of The Guardian called it a generic crime caper with characters whose names seemed generated by an algorithm, noting Hirsch's amused, droning delivery and Cusack's barbecue-loving gangster, while finding the climax full of improbably bad marksmanship. Julian Roman of MovieWeb was more positive, calling it a bloody and twisted pulp actioner with a spectacularly convoluted plot that keeps the adrenaline pumping with gritty action scenes.

title: Escape the Undertaker
tagline: It’s up to viewers to decide the fate of these poor souls trying to survive the wrath of The Undertaker.
overview: The Undertaker has set a trap for the decorated tag team The New Day at his mansion. What they don't know: The Undertaker's mansion is an extreme Haunted House, packed to the brim with supernatural challenges. It's up to viewers to decide the fate of these poor souls trying to survive the wrath of The Undertaker.
plot:
Escape the Undertaker is a 2021 American interactive horror comedy special produced by WWE Studios for Netflix, in which viewers make choices that shape the story, in the tradition of the streaming service's earlier interactive titles such as Black Mirror: Bandersnatch and You vs. Wild. It stars Mark Calaway as his wrestling persona the Undertaker, alongside the tag team The New Day, made up of Kofi Kingston (Kofi Sarkodie-Mensah), Xavier Woods (Austin Watson) and Big E (Ettore Ewen). Aimed at families and released with a TV-G rating, it was launched in October 2021 as a Halloween-season offering, and each viewing runs roughly half an hour.

In the story, the Undertaker has set a trap for The New Day at his mansion. The three decorated champions travel to the Dead Man's house hoping to steal his urn, a relic said to hold supernatural powers, because they want to feel its power for themselves. What they do not know is that the mansion is an extreme haunted house filled with supernatural challenges. When Big E touches the urn, his soul begins to be drained away, turning their quest into a race against time. The trio must investigate the rooms of the eerie house while the Undertaker watches their every move from a basement control room full of old computers and monitors. Viewers choose among two or three options at various points, which usually switch the story to follow a different member of the group, so that Xavier faces his fears or Kofi wanders off alone, and one key decision about halfway through determines whether the heroes escape. At the very first choice, viewers can also tell the Undertaker they are too scared to take part, which ends the special at once with a joke.

The special received lukewarm reviews. Mat Elfring of GameSpot rated it mediocre, describing it as a fun but not fully realized idea that is rushed, with limited replay value and interactivity that disappoints because most choices only show events from a different character's perspective while the outcome hinges on a single decision. He nevertheless praised it as lighthearted entertainment that parents could enjoy with their children, highlighting the natural, zany chemistry and jokes of The New Day, such as Big E repeatedly calling the wrestler "Uncle Taker", and its WWE Easter eggs, while finding the Undertaker's role the weak link. Other reviewers similarly considered it light, low-stakes fun let down by its thin branching.

title: Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight 2
original_title: W lesie dziś nie zaśnie nikt 2
overview: When something horrible happens to the only survivor of a bloody massacre, an insecure rookie cop must overcome his fears to stop further carnage.
plot:
Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight 2 (Polish: W lesie dziś nie zaśnie nikt 2) is a 2021 Polish supernatural slasher film, the sequel to Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight (2020). Bartosz M. Kowalski again directed, writing the screenplay with Mirella Zaradkiewicz. Julia Wieniawa, Wojciech Mecwaldowski, Izabela Dabrowska and Michal Zbroja return from the first film, while Mateusz Więcławek and Zofia Wichlacz take over as the new leads.

Lonely young policeman Adam Adamiec learns from his boss, Sergeant Waldek, that a pair of deformed twin brothers have been arrested on the word of teenager Zosia, the only survivor of a massacre of her friends at a nearby camp. Waldek takes Zosia back to the twins' cabin to investigate, leaving Adam in charge. While the sergeant is away from her, part of the meteorite that mutated the twins splits open and releases a substance that turns Zosia into a mutant like them, and she kills Waldek. When he stops answering, Adam and his colleague Wanessa find the cabin wrecked and Waldek dead. Wanessa calls in two hunters, Mariusz and Slawek, but after Slawek traps his hands in a bear trap, the group shelters at the abandoned camp, where they find a frightened prostitute, Janeczka, whose companion Oliwier has been murdered outside.

Slawek bleeds to death, and a plan to lure Zosia using Janeczka as bait backfires when Zosia kills both Mariusz and Janeczka. Cornered in a cabin, Adam cannot bring himself to shoot her, and Wanessa shoves him toward Zosia and escapes. Zosia infects him through a stinger in her throat, and, able to talk with her in a language only they share, Adam learns they are monsters carrying an evil from the moon. Persuaded to kill whomever he chooses, he murders a man who abuses his dog, and the two become lovers. Zosia plans to free the twins and bring about the apocalypse, but the brothers refuse to leave their cell. Wanessa arrives armed with a machine gun and throws a grenade that fails to go off. Adam is captured, and one of the twins accidentally sets off the grenade, killing both brothers and destroying the station. Adam ends up in a laboratory as a test subject.

title: Corrective Measures
tagline: Anarchy in the world's most dangerous prison.
overview: Set in San Tiburon, the world's most dangerous maximum-security penitentiary and home to the world's most treacherous superpowered criminals, where tensions among the inmates and staff heighten, leading to anarchy that engulfs the prison and order is turned upside down.
plot:
Sean O'Reilly wrote, produced and directed this 2022 American superhero film, his first live-action feature, adapting Grant Chastain's graphic novel Corrective Measures. Bruce Willis plays Julius "The Lobe" Loeb, a mind-controlling criminal genius, with Michael Rooker as the corrupt Warden Devlin, Dan Payne as the vigilante Payback, Brennan Mejia as Diego Diaz, Tom Cavanagh as Gordon Tweedy, Kat Ruston as Officer Liz Morales, Kevin Zegers as Captain Jason Brody and Hayley Sales as Dr. Isabelle Josephs.

The film is set in a world transformed by a global catastrophe known as the Pulse, which left some people with superhuman abilities. The most dangerous of these "enhanced humans" are locked up in San Tiburon, a privately run maximum-security prison where inhibitors worn on the inmates' legs suppress their powers. The story opens as Payback, a Bible-quoting brute devoted to hunting down the enhanced, wipes out a gang in a parking garage so that he can kill their target himself, and is arrested and sent to San Tiburon.

Arriving on the same transport is Diego, a timid young man whose only power is heightened empathy. He is taken under the wing of Gordon, once an electricity-wielding villain called the Conductor, and is quickly drawn into the prison's power struggles when he stops Payback from killing the Lobe. Devlin, who insists on being called "the Overseer" and swaggers around in a straw boater, is determined to extort the location of the Lobe's hidden fortune to finance a lavish retirement, while his subordinates jockey to succeed him. Payback's feuds with the other inmates and Devlin's pressure on the Lobe push tensions to breaking point, and the prison erupts into a violent uprising in which Diego's gift becomes vital to his survival, leaving the fate of San Tiburon unresolved.

Tubi released the film in select theaters and on demand on 29 April 2022, and is one of Willis's last films before he retired from acting following his dementia diagnosis. Reviews were mixed: The Guardian found its blend of comic-book schlock and criticism of the American prison system distinctive despite its derivative premise, while other critics called the script bland and Willis's limited performance listless.

title: Resurrection
tagline: Maintain control.
overview: A woman’s carefully constructed life is upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she’s evaded for two decades.
plot:
Resurrection is a 2022 American psychological thriller written and directed by Andrew Semans. Rebecca Hall stars as a successful single mother whose controlled life falls apart when a man from her past reappears, with Tim Roth, Grace Kaufman and Michael Esper. Shot in Albany, New York, and Williamsburg, Brooklyn, it premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 22, 2022, and was released by IFC Films and Shudder on July 29, 2022.

Margaret is a composed, highly organised executive in Albany who is raising her daughter Abbie, about to leave for college, on her own. She carries on a casual affair with a married colleague, Peter, and seems entirely in command of her life. At a conference, however, she spots David, a man she has not seen in more than twenty years. Overcome by panic, she rushes home, becomes fiercely protective of Abbie and begins to suffer nightmares. When she confronts David, he calmly tells her that "Ben is with me", smiling to reveal a missing tooth. The police are unable to help, so she changes the locks and buys a gun.

To a young colleague, Margaret describes her past. She met David at eighteen, moved in with him almost immediately and fell under his control. He demanded "kindnesses", acts of humiliation and self-harm, as proof of her love. When they had a son, Benjamin, David grew jealous of the child, and one day Margaret came home to find the baby gone; David told her he had eaten him. He convinced her that their son still lived inside him, and she eventually escaped.

Now David again exerts his hold over her, hinting that she is to blame for Abbie's recent accident and leaving the key to his hotel room, where she finds Ben's blanket. Margaret starts to lactate, plans to kill him, and fails when he overpowers her, after which she imagines hearing a baby crying inside him. He forces her to perform a new "kindness", standing in a stress position in a park for hours at night. Abbie, frightened by her mother's behaviour, flees, and Margaret violently rejects Peter.

Leaving a farewell message for Abbie, Margaret meets David in a hotel room, where he invites her to feel his stomach. She attacks him with knives, ties him to the bed and cuts him open, apparently pulling out a living baby. In a final scene, a loving Abbie says goodbye to her mother, who holds the infant, but Margaret's smile gives way to terror, leaving the reality of the ending open.

Critics praised Hall's performance, and the film has 81% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Robbing Mussolini
overview: At the end of WWII, an ambitious bootlegger and his nightclub-singing girlfriend assemble a ragtag bunch of misfits for an impossible heist: to steal Mussolini's treasure right from his headquarters.
plot:
Robbing Mussolini (Rapiniamo il Duce) is an Italian historical action comedy of 2022 directed by Renato De Maria and distributed by Netflix, which released it on 26 October 2022. Pietro Castellitto stars as the smuggler Pietro "Isola" Lamberti, with Matilda De Angelis as the singer Yvonne, Tommaso Ragno as Marcello, Isabella Ferrari as Nora, Maccio Capatonda as the former racing driver Fabbri and Filippo Timi as the Fascist federal secretary Achille Borsalino.

In the last days of the Second World War, Isola, a black-market dealer in Fascist-held Milan, is trying to raise enough money to flee with his lover Yvonne, a singer who is also the mistress of the cruel Borsalino. With his associates Marcello and Amedeo he intercepts a coded order to move a vast hoard of treasure looted by the regime to Switzerland. They plan to steal it from the heavily guarded Black Zone within a week, recruiting the runner Hessa, the anarchist bomb-maker Molotov and Fabbri. Borsalino and his aide Leonida catch Isola leaving a rendezvous with Yvonne and warn him off, but Yvonne agrees to steal Borsalino's personal stamp so the gang can enter the zone. Borsalino, unaware, even shows her the treasure; he plans to leave his wife Nora, who is sleeping with Leonida.

When Yvonne faints on stage and Isola rushes to her, a gunfight erupts, and the couple escape with Fabbri's help; Yvonne then tells Isola she is carrying his child. Nora, who has been spying on them, blackmails Isola into giving her half the loot and pulling off the robbery within a day. The night raid goes wrong when guards stop Isola, disguised as a prisoner, and the alarm sounds early; Molotov is fatally wounded but sets off his explosives, and in the confusion the gang drive off with the treasure. Meanwhile Borsalino seizes Yvonne but is beaten to death by Nora, who then double-crosses Isola at the meeting point, keeps Yvonne as a hostage and orders Leonida to kill the gang. Partisans arrive and save them, and Nora and Leonida flee toward the Alps in the truck. Chasing them in a racing car, Isola knocks down Leonida and Fabbri shoots the truck's driver, sending the vehicle into a lake. Isola and Yvonne surface as the radio announces the surrender of Axis forces in Italy; a mid-credits scene shows that Nora survived as well.

Reviewing it for Cineuropa, Davide Abbatescianni was unimpressed, faulting weak characterization, below-par performances and predictable subplots.

title: Jingle Bell Princess
overview: An actual princess has some mechanical issues and is temporarily grounded.  Does she have time for a lobster roll? It is Christmas time in Maine which means snow, quaint scenery, and lots of Christmas lights near the ocean.  With the crew distracted attending to the repair, Princess Amelia deplanes to walk through a magical Christmas tree lot near the airport perimeter.
plot:
Jingle Bell Princess is a 2021 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Don McBrearty from a screenplay by Blaine Chiappetta and James D. Hughes. Produced by Brad Krevoy Television, the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Hideaway Pictures and All Canadian Entertainment, it stars Merritt Patterson as a European princess and Trevor Donovan as a widowed father, with Charlie Boyle, Marnie McPhail and Matthew Finlan in supporting roles. The film was shot in Ontario in the autumn of 2021 and premiered on the then-new GAC Family cable network on 4 December 2021, during the channel's first season of original Christmas films; it was later made available on Peacock. It runs 85 minutes.

Princess Amelia (Patterson), the polished royal of a fictional European kingdom, is due to fly home after a speaking engagement on the East Coast of the United States when mechanical problems ground her plane. While the crew is busy with the repairs and an old-fashioned snowstorm settles over the area, she slips away from the aircraft to wander through a magical Christmas tree lot near the edge of the airport. Through a series of mishaps she ends up stranded in Tucker, a small, snow-covered seaside town in Maine full of quaint scenery and Christmas lights. There she is taken in as an ordinary guest by the unsuspecting Cutler family, including widower Sam Cutler (Donovan) and his young daughter Sophie (Boyle), who do not know who she really is. As Amelia experiences small-town holiday traditions with them, she and Sam grow close and each learns lessons that leave them with renewed hope, while she must decide when to reveal her royal identity.

Reviews from holiday-film critics were mixed. Rissi JC of RissiWrites called it a sweet happenstance romance whose derivative plot mattered little given its cute story and its likable, familiar leads; she found the production less polished than its competitors, with busy backgrounds and some awkward transitions, but praised the script for letting the revelation of Amelia's secret unfold without the usual dramatic fallout. The Terrible Christmas Movie Project was harsher, judging the chemistry and plot merely fine and the film boring, and mocking Patterson's vaguely British accent, which it said slipped away in most scenes. The Christmas Everyday Club found it cute, festive and at times funny, with two leads who worked well together.

title: South Park: Post COVID
tagline: It's not a movie... it's a made-for-TV movie!
overview: What happened to the children who lived through the Pandemic? Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny survived but will never be the same Post Covid.
plot:
"South Park: Post COVID" is a 2021 American adult animated comedy special written and directed by Trey Parker, the first of a series of South Park television films made for the streaming service Paramount+. Parker and Matt Stone voice most of the characters, with April Stewart, Mona Marshall and Kimberly Brooks. Counted as the 310th episode of the series, it premiered on November 25, 2021, and its story continues in "The Return of COVID."

Forty years in the future, as the COVID-19 pandemic finally wanes, the adult Stan Marsh lives far from South Park, sharing his home with a nagging, sentient Alexa device. He receives a call from Kyle Broflovski, now the guidance counselor at South Park Elementary, with news that their old friend Kenny McCormick, who became a scientist researching the origins of COVID and a possible cure, has died. Kenny left word that, if anything happened to him, his closest friends would know where to find his missing research. Reluctantly returning home, Stan rebuffs Kyle's suggestion that they look for the data. At Kenny's wake they reunite with old classmates, including Eric Cartman, who has converted to Judaism, become a rabbi and started a family, to Kyle's deep suspicion.

When a scientist announces that Kenny was killed by a new COVID variant, panic sweeps the town and the military imposes a quarantine, trapping Stan. He finally visits his father, Randy, in a nursing home, and the dark history that divided the family is revealed: during the pandemic, Stan's parents divorced amid bitter disputes over the marijuana farm Tegridy Farms, and a tragedy involving the farm led to the deaths of Stan's sister and mother, leaving father and son estranged. Randy confesses his own responsibility for the pandemic, and something he says leads Stan to realize where Kenny must have hidden his data.

Meanwhile their former classmates discover Kenny's secret laboratory beneath the school and learn that he had been working on time travel in order to prevent the pandemic altogether. Recovering Kenny's flash drive, the friends watch a recording that shows a failed experiment and reveals that Kenny blamed the boys' estrangement for the bleak future. Moved by memories of their childhood, Stan and Kyle vow to finish Kenny's work, while Cartman, unwilling to lose his comfortable new life, flees with his family.

Flickering Myth praised its satirical touches and COVID jokes, though it felt the special mainly set up a later installment.

title: South Park: Post COVID: The Return of COVID

tagline: What will happen next?
overview: If Stan, Kyle and Cartman could just work together, they could go back in time to make sure Covid never happened. But traveling back to the past seems to be the easy answer until they meet Victor Chaos.
plot:
"South Park: Post COVID: The Return of COVID" is a 2021 American adult animated television special written and directed by Trey Parker, the second South Park special made for the streaming service Paramount+. A direct continuation of "South Park: Post COVID", it counts as the series' 311th episode and premiered on December 16, 2021. Parker and Matt Stone lead the voice cast.

In the future, an adult Stan Marsh recalls how it began: the class was sent home before they could blackmail classmate Heather Williams for courtside seats at a Denver Nuggets game, and later he burned down Tegridy Farms, accidentally killing his sister, Shelley, after which their mother, Sharon, took her own life. With South Park locked down again by a new variant, Tolkien rescues Randy Marsh and his last marijuana sprout and brings him to the late Kenny McCormick's laboratory, where the friends are trying to use Kenny's time-travel research. Opening it requires the voice of Kenny's associate "Chouce", who turns out to be Chaos, the institutionalized Butters, driven mad by abandonment and confined for dealing in NFTs. Meanwhile Randy reveals that every timeline involves his encounter with the pangolin, and Clyde refuses to be vaccinated.

Eric Cartman, now married to Yentl and hiding in the church with his family, founds the Foundation Against Time Travel, recruits Clyde and the escaped Chaos, who lures Stan and Kyle's group into NFTs, and steals the equipment, planning to have Kyle killed in the past. Wendy reveals that Kenny never meant to stop the pandemic but to repair the boys' friendship, and Randy forgives Stan and hands over his last seed. When Cartman's baby accidentally sends Clyde back in time, Stan, Kyle and Cartman follow, and Cartman shoots Clyde before he can kill young Kyle. Accepting that the pandemic cannot be undone, the three instead change how they reacted, getting their younger selves Nuggets seats so they reconcile, while Randy grows the future strain and a calmer town forgives itself. In the new future Sharon, Shelley and Kenny are alive, Butters is sane, Stan serves in the Space Force alongside a continuing romance with Wendy and Kyle has two children, but Cartman is a homeless, bitter drunk.

Dan Caffey of The A.V. Club compared the plot to Avengers: Endgame but felt subplots sometimes made the main story stall, and the revelation of the adult Cartman's fate drew strong reactions from longtime fans.

title: Gone in the Night
tagline: Some secrets are better left buried.
overview: Upon arriving at a remote cabin in the redwoods, Kath and her boyfriend find a mysterious younger couple already there — the rental has apparently been double-booked. They decide to share the cabin with these strangers until the next morning, but her boyfriend disappears with the young woman, which sends Kath in a spiral to find an explanation for their sudden breakup — but the truth is far stranger than she could have imagined.
plot:
Gone in the Night is a 2022 American thriller directed by Eli Horowitz in his feature debut, from a screenplay he co-wrote with Matthew Derby. Winona Ryder stars as a woman searching for answers after her boyfriend vanishes, with Dermot Mulroney, John Gallagher Jr., Owen Teague and Brianne Tju in supporting roles. It was released in theaters on July 15, 2022.

Kath and her younger boyfriend Max, an aimless former student of hers, drive several hours to a remote woodland cabin he has rented for the weekend. Arriving late at night, they find it already occupied by a young couple: the reserved Al and his lively, abrasive girlfriend Greta, who claim to have booked it too. Greta persuades them to stay, and the four spend an awkward evening playing a romantic board game before Kath goes to bed early. The next morning, Max and Greta are gone. Al, apparently distraught, tells Kath he found the two together and that they left as a couple. Hurt and angry, Kath returns to the city.

Ignoring her friends' advice to move on, Kath sets out to find Greta and learn the truth. She tracks down the cabin's owner, Nicholas Barlow, who proves warm and charming, and together they trace Greta to an underground rave, where Greta apologizes for taking Max but insists she loves him. Kath and Nicholas grow close as they share their sense of loss; he tells her he left a career as a biotech scientist after his father died of a hereditary illness, which he says he also carries and is treating with experimental methods.

Flashbacks reveal that Al and Greta befriended Max shortly before the trip, quizzed him with odd questions and lured him to the cabin, where they drugged him and hid him away. Nicholas, who turns out to be Al's father, learns what they have done, and the couple explain that they intend Max as a test subject for his treatments. Visiting Nicholas's cabin, Kath finds a photograph of him with Al and discovers Max imprisoned in a shipping container, hooked up to medical equipment. Greta reveals that Nicholas is not ill at all but is using young people's blood to preserve his own youth. In the violent confrontation that follows, Max dies, and Kath locks Nicholas, Al and Greta inside the container.

Critics were largely unimpressed, praising Ryder's performance and the intriguing setup but finding the twist strange and the execution clumsy and lacking in suspense; Variety called it haphazardly advanced and clumsily articulated.

title: Ash & Dust
tagline: Before you embark on a journey of revenge, dig two graves.
overview: The film is set in a small town where two modest couples find themselves caught up in a game of life & death with a vicious gang after the discovery of a mysterious box buried long ago.
plot:
Ash & Dust is a 2022 Canadian crime thriller written and directed by Adrian Langley, who according to Movie Nation also served as its producer, cinematographer, editor and composer. Produced by Dystopian Films and Grimehouse, it stars Michael Swatton, Blake Canning, Kayla Meyer, Nick Biskupek, Simon Phillips, Carly Fawcett, Doug Phillips, Olivia Tilley and Anne-Carolyne Binette. Running about 85 minutes, it takes its tagline from the proverb "Before you embark on a journey of revenge, dig two graves."

Set in and around a small, snowbound town, the film follows two modest couples who are drawn into a deadly game with a vicious gang after a mysterious box buried long ago comes to light. A prologue set in the frontier past shows a horseback pursuit through wintry woods that ends with an execution and the killer taking the box. More than a century later, a man burying his dog, which has been mauled to death, unearths the well-preserved wooden box, and his decision to have a coin from it appraised sets a chain of killers on him, his wife and anyone thought to know where the box is. A thug, played by Biskupek, and his girlfriend handle the box, his nephew Joel, played by Canning, who has a pregnant partner, asks to join the gang's work, and the gang's enforcers torture suspects in their search. One captive, Wade, played by Swatton, is taken into the woods and shot but survives, and after returning home to find his wife dead he sets out for vengeance. Meanwhile a near-silent detective, Bronwyn, played by Meyer, arrives at crime scenes after the fact and tries to piece together who is responsible. The contents of the box are never revealed, and the timeline shifts back and forth with little dialogue to guide the viewer.

The film was released in North America by Blue Fox Entertainment in March 2022, and High Fliers Films scheduled a UK release for October 2022. Reviews were largely negative. Roger Moore of Movie Nation called it a muddled, incoherent thriller driven by greed rather than revenge, faulting its jumping timeline and uneven acting. The Rotting Zombie, comparing its snowy setting to Fargo, found it a glacial and almost dialogue-free experiment that still managed to tell its story, singling out Biskupek's performance but felt its subplots amounted to little and that its pace would deter many viewers.

title: Grudge
overview: Ahead of a promotion, a police chief becomes entangled in a deadly incident and uncovers an intrigue fueled by grudge that threatens his colleagues.
plot:
Grudge (Turkish: Kin) is a 2021 Turkish crime thriller film directed by Türkan Derya and written by Yılmaz Erdoğan, who also stars as a decorated Istanbul police chief inspector. Produced by BKM Film, it is a Turkish adaptation of the 2015 South Korean film Chronicles of Evil, directed by Baek Woon-hak. The cast also includes Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan, Cem Yiğit Üzümoğlu, Rüzgar Aksoy, Duygu Sarışın, Yosi Mizrahi, Elif Gizem Aykul and Metehan Parıltı. Its trailer was released on 13 September 2021, and the film premiered on Netflix on 8 October 2021.

The film opens with a poor man being arrested in a slum as his children watch in tears. Years later, Chief Inspector Harun (Erdoğan) is named police officer of the year for his work against Istanbul's murders, with a further promotion apparently imminent. After celebrating with his team, he takes a taxi home and dozes off, only to wake in a remote wooded area where the driver tries to kill him. Harun kills his attacker in the struggle but, instead of reporting it, wipes the scene and tells no one. The next morning the cabbie's body is found hanging from a construction crane in full view of police headquarters, and Harun's young protégé Tuncay (Üzümoğlu) quietly finds and hides the tie clip that colleagues had given Harun the night before. As his team, including his lieutenant Yadigar (Aksoy), investigates, Harun runs his own frantic inquiry, threatening old informants and accidentally killing a key witness in a shootout, and he uncovers links between the cabbie and the deaths of three fellow officers. A mysterious woman, Gülendam (Sarışın), then confesses to the killings and reveals to Harun that she is the daughter of a man wrongly arrested years earlier for a mass murder who later died; to avenge him she is killing the officers involved, and she asks Harun to kill his boss Cevat (Taylan). Released as a fantasist, she kills Cevat herself and, before taking her own life, reveals that her brother is Tuncay. After killing Yadigar, Tuncay confesses that he himself committed the poisonings for which their father was blamed, and kills himself. Exposed for the cabbie's death, Harun is led away in handcuffs before his son Aslan, completing Tuncay's revenge.

Reviews were mixed. Jade Budowski of Decider praised Erdoğan, a standout Sarışın and the tight script, while Roger Moore of Movie Nation found it decently plotted but hampered by obvious foreshadowing and a cautious ending.

title: Ip Man: The Awakening
tagline: The legend begins
overview: When a young Master Ip stops a kidnapping, he ignites a turf war with a ruthless human trafficking ring. In retaliation, the gang kidnaps one of Ip Man’s close friends, forcing him to face the group’s brutal boxing champion head-on.
plot:
Ip Man: The Awakening (Chinese: Ye Wen Zongshi Juexing) is a 2021 Chinese martial arts action film that serves as an origin story for the Wing Chun master Ip Man, the teacher of Bruce Lee and the subject of Donnie Yen's acclaimed Hong Kong film series. Running about 80 minutes, it stars Miu Tse, a former child star associated with Jet Li, as the young Ip Man, with Sergio De Ieso as the British villain Mr. Stark and Chen Guanying, Hou Tongjiang and Gu Lei in supporting roles. The film is in Cantonese, and its fights pit Ip Man's Wing Chun against bartitsu, a real but largely forgotten British martial art of the nineteenth century that blends Western boxing with Asian techniques and often makes use of a cane.

Apparently set in the 1930s, the story follows a young Ip Man, a gifted fighter who arrives in the big city for the first time with no idea of the corruption he will face. When he stops a kidnapping, he stumbles upon a large-scale human trafficking ring run by arrogant British colonialists led by Mr. Stark, who round up local women with the help of police officers on the take and Chinese collaborators more interested in money than in their compatriots. His intervention ignites a turf war with the gang. In retaliation, the traffickers kidnap one of Ip Man's close friends, and after suffering losses and setbacks, he sets out to rescue the captive women, defend Chinese pride against the colonial bullies and confront the group's brutal boxing champion and finally Stark himself.

Distributed in North America by Well Go USA, the film premiered on the Hi-Yah! streaming service on 20 May 2022 and was later released on Blu-ray; in the United Kingdom it reached the Icon Film Channel in April 2023 and cinemas in May. Reviews were mixed. Mark Glass of We Are Movie Geeks gave it three out of four stars, calling Tse a worthy successor in the role and a likely rising star, and noting that although the early fights suffered from close camerawork and choppy editing, the later ones were polished. He also highlighted the novelty of bartitsu. Phil Hoad of The Guardian was harsher, describing it as a clunky attempt to cash in on Yen's superior series with a laughably thin narrative and pantomime villains who speak oddly accented English, though he found Tse spry and convincing in the generally competent fight scenes.

title: Ciao Alberto
tagline: They go together like pasta and pesto.
overview: With his best friend Luca away at school, Alberto is enjoying his new life in Portorosso working alongside Massimo – the imposing, tattooed, one-armed fisherman of few words – who's quite possibly the coolest human in the entire world as far as Alberto is concerned. He wants more than anything to impress his mentor, but it's easier said than done.
plot:
Ciao Alberto is a 2021 American animated comedy short written and directed by Kenna Harris and produced by Pixar Animation Studios, with Matt DeMartini as producer and Enrico Casarosa as executive producer. Set after the events of Pixar's 2021 feature Luca, it turns to Alberto Scorfano, the sea monster boy who has stayed behind in the town of Portorosso, and his awkward efforts to win the approval of the gruff fisherman who has taken him in.

The short opens with Alberto receiving a letter from his best friend Luca, who is away at school in Genova with Giulia, and writing back with news of his own life. Now fully accepted by the townspeople, he no longer has to hide what he is, and he works at the town fishery alongside Giulia's father, Massimo. For all his enthusiasm, however, his relationship with Massimo remains strained: the taciturn fisherman rarely speaks to him beyond warning him not to take the boat out on his own. Desperate to please him and afraid of being "fired" for his blunders, Alberto keeps trying to impress Massimo, and every attempt goes wrong. When one mishap costs them the day's catch, Alberto slips out at night and takes the boat out alone to make up for it. Startled by Machiavelli the cat, who has stowed away on board, he drops his lantern and sets the boat on fire, and the two barely escape as Massimo comes running to see the damage. Crushed, Alberto packs his things and leaves. Massimo follows him and finds him berating himself for his failures, and as Massimo reaches out, Alberto accidentally calls him "Dad", startling them both. Massimo then tells him that he once made his own father so angry that he punched through a brick wall, and that they made up by repairing it together. The two embrace, sealing their bond as surrogate father and son, and the next day they work side by side mending the boat, swapping stories and talking more openly than before.

Jack Dylan Grazer voices Alberto and Marco Barricelli voices Massimo, with Jacob Tremblay as Luca. Dan Romer, who scored Luca, composed the music. Released exclusively on Disney+ on November 12, 2021, the short ranked eighth among the most-watched films across all US platforms that week, according to Whip Media. Reviews were positive, with critics at CBR.com and Common Sense Media praising its humour and its message about communication between a parent and child.

title: The Simpsons in Plusaversary
overview: The Simpsons host a Disney+ Day party and everyone is on the list… except Homer. With friends from across the service and music fit for a Disney Princess, Plusaversary is Springfield's event of the year.
plot:
The Simpsons in Plusaversary, or simply Plusaversary, is a 2021 American animated short film based on the television series The Simpsons, produced by Gracie Films and 20th Television Animation and directed by David Silverman. Made to celebrate the second anniversary of the streaming service Disney+, it was released on November 12, 2021, Disney+ Day, as the fifth short film in the Simpsons franchise and the third promotional short produced for the service. The story concerns a Disney+ party at Moe's Tavern to which everyone is invited except Homer.

Dan Castellaneta voices Homer Simpson along with Donald Duck, Barney Gumble and the dwarfs Happy and Grumpy, among others. Nancy Cartwright voices Bart, Yeardley Smith voices Lisa, Hank Azaria voices Moe, Goofy and Buzz Lightyear, and Tress MacNeille voices Maleficent. Dozens of characters from Disney, Pixar, Marvel and Star Wars make silent cameo appearances, among them Cinderella, Cruella de Vil, Elsa, Olaf, Mulan, Woody, WALL-E, Loki, Ant-Man, Darth Vader, BB-8 and the Mandalorian.

A crowd of characters from across these franchises queues outside Moe's Tavern, where Maleficent checks names against the guest list. Homer protests that he has been left off it, but when Goofy arrives, Homer forces Goofy to take him in as his plus-one. Inside, Darth Vader drinks a beer, Doctor Strange plays pool with Carl and Lenny, and Elsa conjures ice into a bucket being filled with beer by an enchanted broom from Fantasia. Buzz Lightyear loses an arm-wrestling match to the Mandalorian, and when Moe thinks Donald Duck is choking, Barney attempts the Heimlich maneuver on him. At a table Homer and Goofy talk while Happy grumbles that the party stinks and turns his complaints on Grumpy. Lisa arrives to take Homer home, BB-8 knocks his beer away, and Lisa lifts the mood with a song about Disney+. Afterward, the shadow of Mickey Mouse falls across the door, and the guests are thrilled that the boss has arrived, but it is only Bart in a Mickey costume, who orders everyone back to work and drags Goofy off while Barney hauls Homer away.

Reviews were mixed to positive. CinemaBlend ranked it first among the Simpsons shorts made for Disney+, praising its gags and its satire of Disney and its characters, and LaughingPlace.com enjoyed seeing the Simpsons run amok with familiar characters, while Bubbleblabber gave it five out of ten, finding it the most hands-off of the shorts.

title: Strange World
tagline: Journey to a place where nothing is as it appears!
overview: A journey deep into an uncharted and treacherous land, where fantastical creatures await the legendary Clades—a family of explorers whose differences threaten to topple their latest, and by far most crucial, mission.
plot:
Strange World is a 2022 American animated science fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie follows the story of Willow, a young explorer who embarks on an extraordinary journey to save his family and discover the secrets of their world.

In a post-apocalyptic future, humans have abandoned Earth due to environmental disasters caused by their own actions. The remaining humans live in a vast network of underground tunnels called the "Nexus," where they rely on advanced technology to sustain themselves. Willow's father, Jael, is an explorer who has ventured into the unknown world above, known as the "Strange World." He discovers a hidden paradise filled with lush forests, towering trees, and diverse wildlife.

Willow, who feels overshadowed by his father's accomplishments, decides to follow in his footsteps and explore the Strange World. Alongside his friends, Migs and Soren, they set out on an adventure that takes them through treacherous landscapes, ancient ruins, and mysterious creatures.

As they delve deeper into the Strange World, the group discovers a hidden city called Auralia, which holds the secrets of their world's creation. They also encounter a strange being known as the "Voice," who is the guardian of the Strange World and its inhabitants. The Voice reveals that the Strange World was created by an ancient civilization to serve as a sanctuary for humanity.

However, Jael's actions have disrupted the balance of the ecosystem, causing the Strange World to begin collapsing. Willow and his friends must work together to find a way to restore the balance and save their world from destruction.

Throughout the movie, the characters face numerous challenges and obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile creatures, and personal conflicts. Along the way, Willow learns valuable lessons about courage, friendship, and the importance of preserving the natural world.

The film features stunning animation, vibrant colors, and a richly detailed world that is both fantastical and grounded in scientific principles. The story explores themes of environmentalism, colonialism, and the responsibility that comes with discovery and exploration.

Overall, Strange World is a visually stunning and thought-provoking animated adventure that celebrates the wonders of nature and the importance of preserving our planet for future generations.

title: Teen Wolf: The Movie
tagline: The pack is back.
overview: A full moon rises in Beacon Hills, and with it a terrifying evil has emerged. The wolves are howling once again, calling for the return of Banshees, Werecoyotes, Hellhounds, Kitsunes, and every other shapeshifter in the night. But only a Werewolf like Scott McCall, no longer a teenager yet still an Alpha, can gather both new allies and reunite trusted friends to fight back against what could be the most powerful and deadliest enemy they’ve ever faced.
plot:
Teen Wolf: The Movie is a 2023 American supernatural thriller directed by Russell Mulcahy and written by Jeff Davis, a continuation of the MTV television series Teen Wolf. Most of the series' cast returns, including Tyler Posey as Scott McCall, Crystal Reed, Tyler Hoechlin, Holland Roden, Colton Haynes, Shelley Hennig, Dylan Sprayberry, Linden Ashby, Melissa Ponzio and JR Bourne.

Fifteen years after leaving Beacon Hills, Scott runs an animal shelter in Los Angeles. Lydia, now working in San Francisco, has separated from Stiles after recurring visions of his death; Derek has a teenage son, Eli; and Liam, living in Japan, works with the kitsune Hikari guarding the urn that imprisons the Nogitsune, a malevolent fox spirit. A hooded figure attacks and frees it. As fires break out in the Beacon Hills forest, Scott, Lydia and Chris Argent begin experiencing visions of Allison, Scott's first love, who died years earlier. Believing her soul is trapped and needs release, they return home and perform a ritual at the Nemeton, which unexpectedly brings Allison back to life.

The resurrected Allison has lost most of her memory, recalling only fragments of her family's old feud with werewolves. The pack learns that the Nogitsune has been possessing Chris and engineered the visions to trick them into reviving her. Taking physical form and summoning Oni, it turns Allison against Scott, but he slowly reawakens her memories and they form an uneasy truce. The Nogitsune then traps many of Scott's friends and family in an illusory realm, while Lydia and Jackson discover that the fires were set by Adrian Harris, a former teacher seeking revenge on the pack.

Lydia's banshee scream fully restores Allison's memories. When the Nogitsune demands that Allison kill Scott, Hikari's spirit shields him, and the reunited pack battles the Oni. Derek sacrifices himself to restrain the Nogitsune so that Deputy Parrish can destroy it, becoming a true Alpha in his final moments. After Derek's funeral, Scott resumes his relationship with Allison and plans to look after Eli.

The film premiered on Paramount+ on January 26, 2023, and set a record for the most-watched original film on the service on its debut day. Critical reception was mixed to negative; Rotten Tomatoes reported 32% approval, its consensus judging that nostalgia could not save the lackluster revival, and Metacritic gave it 51 out of 100.

title: A Lot Like Christmas
overview: Jessica Roberts owns the most popular Christmas Tree lot in the picturesque New England town of Hudson Springs. But when big-city marketing executive, Clay Moore moves a "Big Box" store into the area and starts selling trees, Jasmine finds her business in jeopardy. As their professional competition escalates, Jasmine and Clay run into another complication - they start falling for each other.
plot:
A Lot Like Christmas is a 2021 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Stacey N. Harding from an original screenplay by Amyn Kaderali. Produced by Brad Krevoy Television and the Motion Picture Corporation of America with All Canadian Entertainment, with Rob Lycar as producer, it stars Maggie Lawson and Christopher Russell, with Marlie Collins, Matt Visser, Frances Flanagan, Ian Collins, Luvia Petersen and Brenda Crichlow in supporting roles. The film was one of three titles added in October 2021 to GAC Family's "12 Movies of Christmas" line-up, part of the newly launched network's Great American Christmas franchise, and premiered on the channel on 5 December 2021. It runs 84 minutes.

Jessica Roberts (Lawson) runs the most popular Christmas tree lot in Hudson Springs, a picturesque small town in New England, on her family's farm. Clay Moore (Russell), a big-city marketing executive, arrives to open a big-box store whose tree sales threaten local family businesses, and above all Jessica's. The two meet and are immediately attracted to each other before either realises who the other is. Once Jessica learns Clay's true identity, she turns against him and sets out to beat him at his own game, but the escalating competition is complicated by their growing feelings for each other. Her efforts to outdo the store prove costly, and her younger brother Scott (Visser) eventually has to tell her that the lot's expenses have outstripped its sales and pushed the business to the brink. A sudden idea to turn the farm into an event venue offers a way to save it, while Clay, discovering that the corporation he works for has been built on lies, decides that small-town life suits him better, clearing the way for the romance.

Reception was limited and mixed. Writing on the blog Rebekah's Readings and Watchings, the reviewer rated the film six out of ten, saying that Russell, cast against his usual type of rugged outdoorsman as a corporate executive, was excellent, funny and sincere, and that Lawson was fine, though her character came across as trying too hard and her escalating antics made her less sympathetic than the good-natured Clay. The review found the story dull and the farm's rescue implausibly quick, and admitted that Russell was the main reason for finishing the film.

title: Drifting Home
original_title: 雨を告げる漂流団地
tagline: What is the secret hidden in the apartment complex?
overview: Sixth-graders Kosuke and Natsume grew up in the same apartment building as childhood friends. During summer break, while playing in the apartment building that is set to be demolished, they find themselves caught in a strange phenomenon. All they can see around them is a vast sea. Will Kosuke and the others make it back to their world? A journey of farewells in summer has just begun.
plot:
Drifting Home is a 2022 Japanese animated drama film directed by Makoto Shinkai, produced by Studio Colorido, and distributed by Warner Bros. Japan.

The story follows two main characters: Akira Tendō (voiced by Kana Hanazawa) and Hinata Tachibana (voiced by Kiyohiko Shibukawa). The film takes place in a world where the Japanese government has built a massive, sprawling city called "New Tokyo" to accommodate the growing population of Tokyo. However, this new city is plagued by pollution, poverty, and social inequality.

Akira, a 17-year-old high school student, lives with his mother in a small apartment in New Tokyo. He spends most of his time daydreaming about his past life before moving to the new city, where he had a happy childhood with his father. Akira's mother is struggling to make ends meet, and their living situation is precarious.

Hinata, on the other hand, lives in a small, rural town called "Kokuryū" (Black Dragon) with her family. She is an aspiring artist who dreams of becoming a famous painter. Hinata's life is marked by poverty and hardship, but she finds solace in her art.

The two characters' paths cross when Akira's mother loses her job, and they are forced to move to Kokuryū. The film follows their journey as they navigate this new environment, confront their personal struggles, and find a sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the film, Shinkai explores themes of identity, community, and the human condition. He also critiques the social and economic issues faced by Japan's rapidly urbanizing population. The animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and beautiful landscapes that evoke a sense of wonder and magic.

Drifting Home is a poignant and thought-provoking film that celebrates the resilience of the human spirit. It is a powerful exploration of what it means to be alive, to find one's place in the world, and to hold onto hope in the face of adversity.

title: The Independent
tagline: Follow the lies. Find the truth.
overview: It's the final weeks of the most consequential presidential election in history. America is poised to elect either its first female president or its first viable independent candidate. Reporting history as it's made, an idealistic young journalist teams up with her idol, legendary journalist Nick Booker, to uncover a conspiracy that places the fate of the election, and the country, in their hands.
plot:
The Independent is a 2022 American political thriller directed by Amy Rice and written by Evan Parter. Jodie Turner-Smith stars as an ambitious young journalist, with Brian Cox, Luke Kirby, Stephen Lang, Ann Dowd and John Cena in supporting roles. The film was released on streaming by Peacock on November 2, 2022, days before the 2022 United States midterm elections.

Elisha "Eli" James is a young reporter at the Washington Chronicle who breaks the story that Nate Sterling, a Yale graduate, Olympic gold medalist and best-selling author played by Cena, is entering the presidential race as an independent candidate. His rivals are an unpopular Democratic incumbent and Senator Patricia Turnbull, a Republican who would become the first woman elected president of the United States. Eli forms a bond with Nick Booker, a veteran journalist she has long idolized, played by Cox, and she brings him a startling discovery: someone is skimming money from the national lottery, a dollar out of every thousand, and funneling it into a super PAC, diverting funds that should support the country's public schools.

At first the evidence appears to point to Turnbull. As Election Day approaches, Eli and Booker pursue the story through a maze of sources and political operatives while weighing the consequences of publishing a bombshell that could decide the race. Their investigation eventually reveals that the true architect of the scheme is not Turnbull but Sterling himself, and they confront the candidate and obtain his confession. Eli's personal life is strained at the same time, as her father is dying of cancer. When another journalist attempts to take credit for Eli's reporting and the Chronicle declines to run the story, Eli and Booker decide to leave the paper and found a new outlet, called The Independent, through which they publish the report on Sterling.

Parter's screenplay appeared on the 2013 Black List, the annual survey of Hollywood's most admired unproduced scripts, where it received twenty votes. The film was produced by Anonymous Content, Park Pictures and The Exchange. Principal photography took place in New York City beginning in December 2021. Reviews were mixed: Rotten Tomatoes reports that 35% of 17 critics' reviews were positive, and Metacritic gave it 48 out of 100. Critics credited its timely themes and script but felt it lacked the hard-hitting edge associated with the best political thrillers and treated its subject too simplistically.

title: Angel Falls Christmas
overview: Ally Morgan is a workaholic ER doctor struggling for work-life balance with boyfriend, Josh. On the night they breakup. Ally is miserable alone before a chance encounter with handsome barista, Gabe leads her to fulfill a Christmas bucket list of fun activities she never would have done on her own. Ally's best friend and fellow ER doctor, Dawn has never seen Ally so engaged outside of work and is rooting for a Gabe-Ally relationship. Now, the saintly Maureen must redirect Gabe's heartfelt intentions if Josh and Ally have any chance at reconciliation this Christmas.
plot:
Angel Falls Christmas is a 2021 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Jerry Ciccoritti from a screenplay by John-Eliot Jordan and Carlie Mantilla. Also known as My Angel's Christmas List, it was produced by the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Hideaway Pictures, Brad Krevoy Television and All Canadian Entertainment, and was filmed in Ontario. It stars Jessica Lowndes as Ally Morgan, Chad Michael Murray as Gabe and David Reale as Josh, with Samora Smallwood, Jane Luk, Deborah Tennant, Carlie Mantilla, Mia Schierau, Joy Castro and Bill Turnbull. James Mark Stewart composed the score and Jonathan Yapp was the cinematographer.

Ally Morgan is a dedicated emergency room doctor whose long night shifts leave little room for her relationship with her boyfriend Josh. When she is promoted to an administrative post, Josh hopes they will finally have more time together, but Ally cannot bring herself to leave the ER behind, and his patience with her work-life balance runs out until he ends the relationship. Miserable on her own and in no mood for Christmas, Ally has a chance encounter with Gabe, a handsome and mysterious barista, who leads her through a Christmas bucket list of festive activities she would never have tried alone, helping her learn to switch off and make room for herself. Her best friend and fellow ER doctor Dawn has never seen Ally so engaged outside work and roots for a romance between her and Gabe. Gabe, however, is an angel, and as he and Ally grow too close, the saintly Maureen must redirect his heartfelt intentions so that Josh and Ally have a chance at reconciliation before Christmas.

The film premiered on GAC Family on 26 November 2021 and later reached Netflix in Germany in December 2022. Critical response was mixed to negative. The Terrible Christmas Movie Project called it weird, boring and confusing, objecting to a story in which the heroine spends the film growing close to one man before returning to the boyfriend who left her, and finding Murray's slow, over-enunciated delivery as the angel highly distracting. Paul Siwasch of Film-Rezensionen.de was more forgiving, describing it as unremarkable and safely conventional but calm, with small twists, solid acting and a heartwarming angel-themed premise that made it acceptable viewing for a December afternoon, though he criticised the cheap-looking setting and the German dubbing of Murray.

title: A Kindhearted Christmas
overview: Jamie owns a sightseeing and tour company in the small town of Cooperville, New York. Navigating the holidays with enthusiasm is trickier for Jamie since her husband Matt passed. Matt loved Christmas and found unparalleled joy in giving to others. While reminiscing with family, Jamie realizes the town desperately needs someone with Matt’s genius for thinking of the small gestures that bring genuine happiness to the holidays.
plot:
A Kindhearted Christmas is a 2021 American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Alysse Leite-Rogers from a teleplay by Jennifer Barrow and Amyn Kaderali, based on a story by Barrow. Produced by Brad Krevoy Television and the Motion Picture Corporation of America with All Canadian Entertainment, it stars Jennie Garth and Cameron Mathison, with Emily Tennant, Bronwen Smith, Blair Penner, Mark Brandon and Catherine Lough Haggquist in supporting roles. The film premiered on the GAC Family cable network on 20 November 2021 and runs 84 minutes. It was released in Italy as Un Natale di cuore.

Jamie (Garth) runs a successful sightseeing and tour company in the small town of Cooperville, New York, and knows better than anyone where to find fun things to do. Since the death of her husband Matt, who adored Christmas and found his greatest joy in giving to others, facing the holidays with the same enthusiasm has been harder for her. With the support of her niece, a newlywed who is more like a younger sister to her, she tries to keep up a brave front. Jamie is a devoted viewer of the morning programme Wake Up Upstate and has a crush on its handsome anchor, Scott Morris (Mathison). When the show reports that students from a neighbouring high school have been invited to perform at the White House but cannot afford the trip, Jamie, remembering Matt's belief that Christmas is about bringing joy to others, anonymously covers the entire cost. Her gift inspires another and then another, until the whole town catches the spirit of giving. The mystery of Cooperville's Secret Santa draws Scott to town to uncover the donor's identity, and after some awkward first encounters with Jamie, a romance develops between them, tested when the truth about her secret comes out.

Reviews were positive about the leads. Markos Papadatos of Digital Journal gave the film an A, praising Leite-Rogers's direction, a heartfelt and resonant screenplay and the delightful performances of Garth and Mathison, describing Mathison's acting as subtle and poignant. OTTplay's reviewer called it formulaic but heartwarming, enjoying the Secret Santa premise and the adorable chemistry between Jamie and Scott, whose slow-building romance was found engaging, though Mathison's character seemed out of place when he storms off during the couple's late conflict; the review concluded that the endearing cast and its message about the joy of giving made it a touching holiday story.

title: The Festival of Troubadours
overview: An unexpected reunion between a traveling musician and his son opens old wounds as the two set out on a long journey to a troubadour festival.
plot:
The Festival of Troubadours (Turkish: Âşıklar Bayramı) is a 2022 Turkish drama film written and directed by Özcan Alper and produced by OGM Pictures. Based on Kemal Varol's novel of the same name, it stars Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ as Yusuf and Settar Tanrıöğen as his father, Heves Ali, with Laçin Ceylan as Zere, Erkan Can as Kul Yakup, Burcu Cavrar as the nurse Dilek, Çetin Kemal Sarıkartal as Mamoş, Erkan Bektaş, Uğur Uzunel as Salim, Pınar Göktaş as Dr. Zehra and Şirin Ergüven Hamşioğlu as Meryem. The film runs 102 minutes and was released on Netflix on 2 September 2022.

Yusuf, a successful criminal lawyer, has not seen his father since the day after his mother's funeral, some twenty-five years earlier. Heves Ali, a well-known travelling musician and wandering bard, turns up unexpectedly at his door after visiting his late wife's grave and, kept there by heavy rain, stays the night, explaining only that he must travel to Kars for the troubadour festival. When Yusuf discovers that the old man's health is failing and that his visit is a kind of farewell, he feels responsible for him and decides to drive him there himself. Much of the long road trip across the Turkish countryside passes in uneasy silence, broken by stops at places the father chooses on a whim, as he seeks out old musician friends and asks forgiveness of former lovers he once serenaded. Yusuf's years of anger eventually erupt, and he demands to know why he was abandoned, but his father offers little beyond saying he felt his son was better off without him. As Ali's condition worsens he is taken to hospital, yet he insists on reaching the festival, and Yusuf takes him to Kars in a private ambulance to fulfil his wish of seeing his friends one last time, leaving their relationship unresolved.

Critics praised the performances and the role of music and silence. Mrinal Rajaram of Cinema Express gave it three out of five, calling it a brooding, character-driven study of a dysfunctional father-son bond whose pauses and folk songs say more than its sparse dialogue. The Review Geek rated it 7 out of 10, admiring its cinematography and Tanrıöğen's weary performance but finding it slow and overstretched. Shraddha Bandapalle of The Envoy singled out Tatlıtuğ's portrayal of a son's rage and grief, while noting that the leisurely, non-linear storytelling sometimes left the film feeling static.

title: The Invisible Thread
tagline: A movie about a family like any other.
overview: The teenage son of two fathers makes a documentary film about his parents but is surprised when a real-life plot twist occurs in his family.
plot:
The Invisible Thread (Italian: Il filo invisibile) is a 2022 Italian coming-of-age comedy-drama directed by Marco Simon Puccioni, who co-wrote it with Luca De Bei. Made for Netflix, it stars Francesco Gheghi as a teenager raised by two fathers, played by Filippo Timi and Francesco Scianna, with Giulia Maenza, Emanuele Maria Di Stefano, Matteo Oscar Giuggioli, Valentina Cervi and Jodhi May in supporting roles.

The film opens with a school video project that Leone Ferrari is making with his best friend Jacopo, in which he tells the story of his own "rainbow family". His fathers, Paolo, a trained architect, and Simone, who runs a restaurant, have been together for nearly twenty years. Because gay couples cannot adopt in Italy, they had Leone with the help of Tilly, a surrogate mother in the United States who remains part of their lives, and the video traces the legal battles that followed, from the couple's civil union to the long struggle to have both men recognised as Leone's parents. The fathers are uneasy about having their private life put on display, and they have never taken DNA tests to find out which of them is Leone's biological father, since it never seemed to matter.

Leone falls for Anna, a new French girl at school, but has to deal with the prejudice of classmates who assume that the son of a gay couple must be gay himself, not least from Anna's aggressive twin brother Dario. Then a phone mishap reveals to Paolo that Simone has been cheating on him for two years, and the revelation explodes on the day of their twentieth anniversary. Simone moves out, the two men wage an increasingly petty war against each other, and Leone, who finds himself the most mature member of the family, is caught between them. The separation raises legal questions about his status, and the identity of his biological father, a question Jacopo had said would make their video more exciting, becomes a source of real conflict, forcing Leone to reflect on the invisible thread that binds him to his fathers and to everyone who helped bring him into the world.

Released on Netflix in March 2022, the film received mixed reviews. Critics praised Gheghi's understated central performance and the film's matter-of-fact depiction of a same-sex family, but several found the mix of teen comedy and divorce drama uneven and the parents' shouting matches tiresome.
