title: Gasoline Alley
tagline: Justice gets dirty.
overview: A man implicated in the triple homicide of three Hollywood starlets begins his own investigation. Needing assistance, he enlists the two detectives on his tail in order to expose a conspiracy more explosive than any of them imagined.
plot:
Gasoline Alley is a 2022 American neo-noir action thriller directed by Edward John Drake and distributed by Saban Films, one of several low-budget films Drake made with Bruce Willis during the actor's final working years. Devon Sawa stars as the tattoo artist Jimmy Jayne, with Luke Wilson and Willis as the Los Angeles police detectives Freddy Vargas and Bill Freeman, Kat Foster as Jimmy's on-and-off girlfriend Christine, Sufe Bradshaw as the singer Eleanor, Kenny Wormald as the television actor Bourke and Rick Salomon as Persi.

Jimmy, an ex-convict who served time in prison, runs a tattoo parlour called Gasoline Alley, tends his 1966 Chevelle and drinks at a Melrose bar where his late mother once worked. There he crosses paths with a party girl named Star, and soon afterward Vargas and Freeman tell him that she has been killed along with other young women, and that he is their prime suspect, since a lighter bearing his studio's name was found at the scene. Determined not to go back inside for something he did not do, Jimmy starts investigating on his own.

Bourke, a vain actor Jimmy once protected in prison, tells him that Star ran with Persi, a pornographer and small-time criminal, and soon someone in Persi's Land Rover is shooting at Jimmy's car. Slipping into a drug-fuelled party at Persi's house, Jimmy is surprised to see Freeman there, and when a bouncer from the party turns up dead in the trunk of his Chevelle, it is clear he is being set up to take the fall. With help from Eleanor, who knew Star from Persi's gatherings and knows who supplies his drugs, Jimmy follows a trail of narcotics, dead women and police corruption. Freeman turns out to be involved in a human-trafficking ring using a tunnel between San Diego and Tijuana, and the story ends in a shootout in a warehouse in Mexico, where Jimmy, a skilled marksman, takes down the crooked detective and his accomplice and sets the building on fire.

Shot in Tifton, Georgia, in spring 2021 despite its Los Angeles setting, the film was released in theaters, on digital platforms and on demand on 25 February 2022. Reviews were mostly negative, with about a quarter of critics positive on Rotten Tomatoes. Decider credited Sawa with giving Jimmy real backbone but faulted the aimless pace and uneven story, while CBR found it an entertaining, at times unintentionally comic noir held together by a game cast.

title: Curious George: Cape Ahoy
overview: With help from a local fisherman, his niece and an adorable baby seal, George embarks on a quest in search of the long-lost shipwreck of legendary sea captain Trumpet Tooter.
plot:
Curious George: Cape Ahoy is a 2021 American animated family adventure film directed by Doug Murphy, the sixth feature in the film series based on Margret and H. A. Rey's books about the mischievous monkey George and his best friend Ted, the Man with the Yellow Hat. Produced by Imagine Entertainment, Universal Animation Studios and Universal 1440 Entertainment, it features Frank Welker as George and Jeff Bennett as Ted, with Christopher Swindle as the fisherman Elmer, Romi Dames as his niece Emma, Rita Moreno as Gertrude, Luka Jones as Rocco and Kimberly Brooks as Gwen, along with Dee Bradley Baker.

Ted takes George to his favorite vacation spot, a little seaside town, hoping to relive happy memories of its annual Codfest. He has prepared a highly detailed itinerary built around cod fishing, but, as usual, things do not go as planned. Inspired by a pirate book that Ted reads to him, George becomes fascinated with the legend of the sea captain Trumpet Tooter, whose ship was lost long ago, and sets out to find the sunken wreck. With help from Elmer, a local fisherman, his niece Emma and an adorable baby seal, George drags the reluctant Ted into an exciting search beneath the waves, exploring the ocean first in a submersible and later scuba diving in wetsuits. Along the way the friends rescue the pup's mother, help a humpback whale that has become stuck in a reef and make new friends among the townspeople, including a scientist who studies the local marine life, an author and the owner of the town museum. Ted, who prefers to keep to a strict schedule, learns that it is all right to be flexible, to let plans change and to be open to new adventures instead of simply repeating old ones.

The film premiered on the streaming service Peacock on 30 September 2021. Common Sense Media described it as a simple, charming ocean story for preschoolers, praising its catchy music and lovable characters, its gentle message about adapting when plans go awry and helping others in need, and the surprising number of science facts woven into the story, such as how long whales can hold their breath and how compressed air is used. The reviewer also noted the diverse cast of characters in the little beach town and the patient, forgiving friendship between George and Ted, which offers a model that both young children and parents can relate to as they confront new experiences every day.

title: ODDTAXI in the Woods
original_title: 映画 オッドタクシー イン・ザ・ウッズ
overview: Reconstruction of the television anime that will also depict what happens after its finale with a new story written by Kazuya Konomoto.
plot:
Odd Taxi: In the Woods (Japanese: 映画 オッドタクシー イン・ザ・ウッズ) is a Japanese animated mystery feature from 2022, with Baku Kinoshita directing a screenplay by Kazuya Konomoto. It reworks Odd Taxi, the original 13-episode television anime produced by OLM and P.I.C.S. that premiered in April 2021 and became a sleeper hit, and it adds new material set after the series finale. The main television cast returns, including Natsuki Hanae as the taxi driver Hiroshi Odokawa, Riho Iida as the nurse Miho Shirakawa, Ryōhei Kimura as Ayumu Gōriki, Suzuko Mimori as Rui Nikaidō, Moeka Koizumi as Shiho Ichimura and Kenji Hamada as Dobu. The music is by the hip-hop artists OMSB, PUNPEE and VaVa.

As in the series, the world is populated by anthropomorphic animals. Odokawa is an eccentric, taciturn 41-year-old walrus who drives a taxi, has no family and keeps others at arm's length. He does, however, talk with his passengers, among them a college student desperate to go viral, a nurse hiding a secret, a struggling comedian, a street tough and a rising idol, and these conversations gradually draw him into the case of a missing girl, a member of the idol group Mystery Kiss.

Rather than simply condensing the episodes, the film rebuilds the story around a series of interviews in which the supporting characters testify, as if in a police investigation, about what happened on the fateful night of October 4. Their subjective accounts recast footage from the television anime and give the film the feel of a true-crime documentary, threading the seemingly unrelated events together without revealing every answer at once. The film ends with an extended version of Odokawa's confrontation with Sakura Wadagaki, whom the series had revealed to have killed and taken the place of the missing girl, Yuki Mitsuya, followed by a new epilogue set immediately after the series' final scene; the end credits show that Odokawa survived and that Sakura was arrested.

The film was announced on 25 December 2021, the date of the series finale within its story, and Asmik Ace released it in Japan on 1 April 2022, with Crunchyroll handling North America. It grossed about $438,000 at the Japanese box office. Anime News Network gave it a B+, praising the clever documentary-style framing that makes it a cohesive work in its own right and an acceptable first viewing, while noting that it offers little new story and that the series remains the fuller telling.

title: War of the Worlds: Annihilation
overview: A mother and son find themselves faced with a brutal alien invasion where survival will depend on discovering the unthinkable truth about the enemy.
plot:
War of the Worlds: Annihilation is a 2021 American science fiction action film directed by Maximilian Elfeldt, who also co-edited it, from a screenplay by Conor Dowling. It was produced by The Asylum as an original film for the streaming service Tubi, the studio's second for the platform after Swim. It stars Arie Thompson, William Baldwin, Noel Gugliemi and Rashod Freelove. Shot in Los Angeles, with some scenes filmed at the March Field Air Museum, it was released in December 2021 and, unusually for an Asylum production, runs almost two hours.

A shower of meteorites, undetected even by NASA's constant monitoring, strikes the Earth, and each impact releases a gas that is toxic to humans. The military, led by General Skuller (Baldwin), insists that this is a deliberate alien attack and prepares for battle, while cyber-operations specialist Ashlaya Wellish (Thompson) sees flaws in his theory and has her warnings ignored. Skuller is proved right when vast spaceships appear in the sky and beings from another galaxy land, finding the planet's atmosphere and vegetation ideal for their survival. As chaos spreads, Ashlaya's husband Jutta (Michael Marcel) is sent out on patrol, and their son Lucas (Kennedy Porter) is trapped at his school, trying to seal the building against the poisonous substance. Giant tentacles, mech-like robots and looters soon join the danger. Along the way the family's story crosses with that of Tiago (Gugliemi), a survivalist, and Patlin (Freelove), a doctor who survived the attack on his hospital and who rescues a young alien named Gwen (Emree Franklin). Eventually Ashlaya and her companions join Skuller and what is left of his troops, and Ashlaya, seeking to make amends, finds a way to fight back, as survival comes to depend on discovering the unthinkable truth about the enemy.

The supporting cast includes Joseph Michael Harris, Andrew Rogers and Bradford Haynes. The film received little promotion. The website Voices From the Balcony called it surprisingly good for an Asylum film, finding the computer-generated alien ships and giant robots mostly convincing and the tone more serious than many of the studio's releases, and judged it enjoyable though somewhat long; Germany's TV Movie described Elfeldt as a low-budget professional. A sequel, War of the Worlds: Extinction, followed in 2024.

title: My Father's Violin
overview: Through their shared grief and connection to music, an orphaned girl bonds with her emotionally aloof, successful violinist uncle.
plot:
My Father's Violin (Turkish: Babamın Kemanı) is a 2022 Turkish musical drama directed by Andaç Haznedaroğlu, whose earlier Netflix titles include Hot Sweet Sour and Have You Ever Seen Fireflies?. Produced by BKM, it stars Gülizar Nisa Uray as Özlem, Engin Altan Düzyatan as her uncle Mehmet, Belçim Bilgin as his wife Suna and Selim Erdoğan as Özlem's father Ali Rıza, with Ayfer Dönmez, Yiğit Çakır, Yener Sezgin and Erdem Baş. It was released on Netflix on 21 January 2022 and runs 112 minutes.

Ali Rıza is a street musician in Istanbul who plays the violin with a close-knit band for tourists, passers-by and restaurant diners. His red-haired eight-year-old daughter Özlem accompanies them everywhere, dancing and urging audiences to applaud and fill the hat, until the police chase the band away. Ali Rıza teaches her that everyone is a melody, and that one only needs to know how to listen. Coughing up blood and hiding from Özlem that he is dying, and with the girl's mother long gone, he seeks out his estranged brother Mehmet, a world-famous violinist, as her last hope. The two had escaped an abusive guardian as children, but Mehmet still resents what he sees as his brother's abandonment, and the reunion after more than three decades goes badly. After Ali Rıza's death, Mehmet, busy preparing for a major concert, refuses to take responsibility for the girl, but Suna, who longs for a child, arranges for social services to make him her guardian. The cold, arrogant musician gradually softens as Özlem, who never goes anywhere without her violin, forces her way into his heart. Their shared love of music binds them, and Mehmet even joins his late brother's band of buskers, taking Ali Rıza's place, while he comes to realize that his bitterness toward his brother was his own problem all along.

Reviews were moderately positive. Decider's Johnny Loftus recommended it, praising the real chemistry between Düzyatan and the precocious, quick-witted Uray and the film's respect for the power of music and family. In The New Indian Express, Bhuvanesh Chandar gave it three out of five, admiring the performances, especially Uray's, and its colorful visuals, and observing that the brothers' contrasting musical styles mirror their characters, but found the writing predictable and melodramatic and noted that Özlem's grief is barely shown. Other critics similarly called it a satisfying feel-good drama whose musical scenes lack realism.

title: A Jazzman's Blues
tagline: Never stop loving.
overview: A tale of forbidden love and family drama unravels 40 years of secrets and lies against a soundtrack of juke joint blues in the Deep South.
plot:
A Jazzman's Blues is a 2022 American drama film written, produced and directed by Tyler Perry, starring Joshua Boone, Amirah Vann, Solea Pfeiffer, Austin Scott, Brent Antonello and Ryan Eggold. Perry wrote the screenplay, his first, in 1995, and the project passed through years of development before being made for Netflix.

In 1987, an elderly woman, Hattie Mae, visits Johnathan Dupree, the attorney general of Hopewell, Georgia, who is seeking re-election on a racist platform, and urges him to investigate the 1947 lynching of her son, Horace John Boyd, known as Bayou. She gives him a bundle of letters addressed to a Leanne J. Harper, and he begins to read. In flashback, Bayou is a sensitive, musically gifted young man, belittled by his guitarist father, Buster, who favors Bayou's older brother, Willie Earl, a talented trumpeter. Bayou falls for Leanne, a lonely, educated girl mocked by the town, who teaches him to read. Their secret romance is threatened by her abusive grandfather, and her mother, Ethel, takes her away to Boston, intercepting Bayou's letters. Buster abandons the family for Chicago, followed by Willie Earl.

After serving in the army, Bayou returns to Hopewell, where Hattie runs a juke joint. Willie Earl arrives with his manager, Ira, who hears Bayou sing and offers him an audition in Chicago. Leanne is back too, married to John, the brother of Sheriff Jackson, and passing as white at her mother's urging. When Ethel catches the reunited lovers, she falsely claims Bayou whistled at Leanne, and he flees to Chicago, where he becomes a star at the Capitol Royale while Willie Earl's drug use costs him his job. Back home, the sheriff's crackdown ruins Hattie's business. Bitter, Willie Earl tells the sheriff that Bayou is returning to Georgia, where he plans to escape with Leanne and their son, and Bayou is caught and lynched by a mob. In 1987, Johnathan realizes from the letters that he is the son of Bayou and Leanne. He gives the letters to his mother and steps outside to reckon with his identity as a fair-skinned Black man.

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 11, 2022, and was released on Netflix on September 23. It received generally favorable reviews, with 67% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 62, making it Perry's most acclaimed film, a distinction previously held by I Can Do Bad All By Myself (2009).

title: Prisoner of Love
overview: An 18-year-old begins dating a charming 50-year-old man who treats her to shopping sprees and fancy restaurants, creating a huge rift with her mother. Mom’s instincts prove right when the man becomes psychologically manipulative, turning the girl into an emotional prisoner in his mansiIon.
plot:
Prisoner of Love, also known as Trapped by My Sugar Daddy, the title under which it aired on Lifetime, is a 2022 Canadian thriller television film directed by Lindsay Hartley from a screenplay by Casey Bose, based on a story by Bose and Dave Hickey. Produced by Almost Never Films with Reel One Entertainment for the Lifetime network, it stars Katie Kelly as an 18-year-old drawn into a relationship with a much older man, with James Hyde, Tiffany Montgomery, Heather Lynn Harris, Ryan Francis, Ashton Leigh and Hartley herself in supporting roles. The film premiered on Lifetime in January 2022 and runs 85 minutes.

After a prologue in which a woman boarding a private jet is abducted, the story moves to Connecticut, where Carly (Kelly) and her mother Sarah (Montgomery) work together as a home décor team. When a wealthy new neighbour, Kyle (Hyde), moves into a mansion nearby, they lose the job to the overbearing rival designer Amanda James (Hartley), but persuade him to hire them instead. Kyle, a charming man of about fifty, takes a particular interest in Carly, inviting her to dinner and treating her to shopping sprees and fancy restaurants. Encouraged by her friend Mel, who becomes involved with Kyle's friend Brent, Carly is dazzled and breaks up with her boyfriend Ben. When Sarah learns of the romance, the two clash bitterly and Carly leaves home. Kyle's charm gives way to jealousy and psychological manipulation: he puts Ben in a coma, isolates Carly from her parents and becomes physically abusive, turning her into an emotional prisoner in his mansion. When Sarah tries to intervene, Kyle calls the police on her. After learning from Mel the truth about the two men, Sarah investigates and discovers that Kyle and Brent groom young women and sell them into sex trafficking. Carly and Mel are taken to the private jet, and Sarah and her husband track Carly's phone and race to rescue them.

Marc Fusion found the film a solid thriller for Lifetime devotees, noting that it tackled bigger issues than the usual obsessed-psycho story by focusing on grooming, which it depicted in a sometimes difficult-to-watch way, though the trafficking theme received too little attention and the rift between mother and daughter felt rushed. He praised Kelly as an authentic, naive young woman, making it understandable that Carly missed so many red flags, but found Hyde only passable and not always believable as the groomer.

title: Satan's Slaves 2: Communion
tagline: A Mother's Terror is Forever.
overview: After moving from their home to an apartment building, a new terror awaits Rini’s family.
plot:
Satan's Slaves 2: Communion (Indonesian: Pengabdi Setan 2: Communion) is a 2022 Indonesian supernatural horror film written and directed by Joko Anwar. A sequel to Satan's Slaves (2017), itself based on the 1980 film Satan's Slave, it stars Tara Basro as Rini, Endy Arfian as Toni, Nasar Anuz as Bondi and Bront Palarae as their father Bahri, with Ayu Laksmi as the siblings' late mother, Mawarni. It was the first Indonesian film released in the IMAX format.

In 1955, the journalist Budiman is summoned by his friend Heru, a police commander, to the Bosscha Observatory, where dozens of exhumed corpses have been found prostrate before a framed portrait of a woman named Mawarni after an overnight cult ritual. Ordered to keep the story quiet ahead of the Bandung Conference, Heru urges Budiman to publish it in obscure magazines. In 1984, Rini, her brothers Toni and Bondi and their father Bahri have spent three years living in a flat in the run-down Mandara Apartments in Jakarta, where Bahri works odd jobs and keeps a locked briefcase at home. Budiman, now editor of an occult magazine, receives Heru's suicide note along with photographs and drawings pointing to imminent cult activity at Mandara, and revealing that Bahri was one of the officers present back in 1955. When the building's lift malfunctions and plunges, killing many tenants, a violent storm floods the complex, cuts off the electricity and traps the residents inside overnight. Rini comforts Wisnu, a boy whose mother died in the lift and who knows a secret sign language learned from an occult book. As supernatural forces begin to torment the tenants, the siblings uncover evidence that the cult gathers every 29 years on 17 April, the following day, and find photographs linking their mother to a mysterious figure named Raminom. With the dead rising in the darkened corridors, the family must confront the truth about their parents' past and the fate of their youngest brother, Ian, who was taken by the cult.

The film opened at number one at the Indonesian box office, passing one million admissions in two days and two million in four, and with 6.3 million admissions it became one of the highest-grossing Indonesian films of all time. On Rotten Tomatoes, all 11 critics' reviews are positive.

title: Living with Chucky
tagline: It Isn't Child's Play
overview: A filmmaker who grew up alongside Chucky the killer doll seeks out the other families surrounding the Child's Play films as they recount their experiences working on the ongoing franchise and what it means to be a part of the, "Chucky" family.
plot:
Living with Chucky is an American documentary film written and directed by Kyra Elise Gardner about the Child's Play horror franchise and the people who made it. Gardner is the daughter of the special effects artist Tony Gardner, the franchise's current head puppeteer, and she grew up surrounded by Chucky and Tiffany dolls. Combining archival footage with new interviews, the film features franchise creator and writer Don Mancini, producer David Kirschner, Brad Dourif, who has voiced Chucky since the beginning, his daughter Fiona Dourif, Jennifer Tilly, Alex Vincent and the filmmaker John Waters, among others.

The documentary traces the franchise from Mancini's original late-1980s script about a friendly-looking doll that comes to life and terrorizes a family, which director Tom Holland turned into Child's Play, through six sequels and the move into television. Moving film by film, it examines the slasher boom of the era, the advances in animatronics that let Chucky stand apart from other killers, the budget cuts that followed the original trilogy and the replacement of the original puppeteer Kevin Yagher by Tony Gardner. It follows Mancini's shift from straight horror toward camp and comedy, marked by the introduction of Tilly's Tiffany in Bride of Chucky, and explores Chucky's rise as a queer icon, with Waters offering his own explanation of horror's devoted gay following, as well as a long discussion of practical effects versus CGI. In its final part the film turns personal, recalling how Kyra as a child watched her father "die" on camera in Seed of Chucky (2004) and reflecting on the long hours, loneliness and lasting bonds of the franchise's crews, presenting the production community as a found family whose members still tell the same stories with affection.

Living with Chucky was released on the Screambox streaming service and video on demand on 4 April 2023. Marco Vito Oddo of Collider gave it a B+, calling it a touching tribute that becomes a universal study of how filmmaking, especially independent filmmaking, brings people together. Phil Hoad of The Guardian was less impressed, finding the retrospective too reverent and padded with filler, noting that it ignores the controversy over violence that surrounded Child's Play and the recent reboot, and arguing that its closing section on film families belonged in a different documentary.

title: The House
tagline: Three visionary tales. One unforgettable place.
overview: Across different eras, a poor family, an anxious developer and a fed-up landlady become tied to the same mysterious house in this animated dark comedy.
plot:
The House is a 2022 British stop-motion animated anthology for adults, produced for Netflix by Nexus Studios, with dialogue by playwright Enda Walsh. Its three chapters, directed by Emma de Swaef and Marc James Roels, Niki Lindroth von Bahr, and Paloma Baeza, tell unconnected stories set in the same house across different eras, each exploring madness, wealth and the search for happiness, with voices by Mia Goth, Matthew Goode, Jarvis Cocker, Helena Bonham Carter and Susan Wokoma.

In the first, "And Heard Within, A Lie Is Spun", set in the late 19th century, young Mabel (Goth) lives in poverty with her parents, Raymond (Goode) and Penny, and baby sister, Isobel. Shamed by wealthy relatives, Raymond drunkenly meets the mysterious architect Mr. Van Schoonbeek, who offers to build the family a luxurious house for free. Inside the ever-changing home, the parents become entranced, Raymond obsessed with the fireplace and Penny with the drapes, and they begin dressing like furniture. Van Schoonbeek's agent, Mr. Thomas, confesses he is an actor following a script; Raymond lights the fire with the family's old belongings, the parents turn into furniture, and the girls escape the blaze by climbing down the curtains.

In the second, "Then Lost Is Truth That Can't Be Won", a struggling rodent developer (Cocker) in a modern city of rodents renovates the house for sale while fighting an infestation of fur beetles. An odd couple at his open house refuses to leave as more of their strange relatives move in, the bank demands repayment, and the police side against him. Trying to poison the couple with boric acid, he poisons himself and is left feral; they bring him home, where their mutated family devours the house from within.

In the third, "Listen Again and Seek the Sun", set in a flooded world of cats, landlady Rosa (Wokoma) clings to her childhood home and her non-paying tenants, fisherman Elias and free-spirited Jen (Bonham Carter). Jen's partner, Cosmos, hired for repairs, instead dismantles the house to build Elias a boat. After Elias leaves gifts and drawings of her, Rosa finally pulls a lever Cosmos installed, turning the house into a ship, and sails into the open sea with her friends.

Released on January 14, 2022, the special drew 97% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 71.

title: Hunting Ava Bravo
tagline: "If I die, you die"
overview: Billionaire sportsman Buddy King unwinds by hunting human captives on his remote mountain estate. But his latest victim, Ava Bravo, is no easy target.
plot:
Hunting Ava Bravo is a 2022 American survival thriller film directed by Gary Auerbach from a screenplay by Julie Auerbach, Marc Blucas and Kevin Tavolaro, based on a story by the Auerbachs and Tavolaro. Produced by Top Dead Center Films and Wild Sheep Content, with Blucas, Kate del Castillo, Chris Copier and Tavolaro among the producers, it stars del Castillo as an abducted woman and Blucas as her hunter, with Halem Medina, Bryce Fernelius and Julio Lazarte in supporting roles. Charles Unice was the cinematographer and the music was composed by Sal "El Muerto" Ledesma and Giancarlo Liana. Auerbach, a producer best known for documentary and reality series such as Paranormal State, had previously produced horror films including The Occupants. The film was released in April 2022.

Ava Bravo (del Castillo) removes a hood to find herself in a remote, snowbound mountain cabin. A tape recording explains that she has been abducted by a man who hunts human captives and that she can win her freedom by reaching a snowmobile five miles to the north; to make it fair, he has only three bullets, and he will emerge from the cellar in ten seconds. Instead of running, Ava waits for him, turns the tables, takes his rifle and leaves him imprisoned, but at the snowmobile she finds only a trap. Forced to return and make her captor guide her out, she learns that he is Buddy King (Blucas), a millionaire who made his fortune from a chain of barbecue restaurants and whose pastime is hunting people who have survived terrible ordeals; Ava was chosen because she escaped a previous abductor. As they cross the wilderness, the two engage in tense psychological games for dominance. In one sequence they encounter two Hispanic hunters, and each tries to convince them that the other is the dangerous psychopath, Buddy pointing to his bruises and Ava using her command of Spanish.

Reviewers saw the film as a variation on The Most Dangerous Game. The review site Moria gave it three stars, finding that after a dreadful opening credits song it improved markedly by focusing on the psychological interplay between hunter and hunted, and praising Blucas's excellent performance. Jim McLennan of Girls With Guns, also awarding three stars, admired its gripping opening, the two lead performances and the tense scene with the hunters, but felt the middle section slack and the plotting, including a stranger who appears when needed, unconvincing.

title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire
tagline: The classic tale as you've never seen.
overview: Detective Amelia Van Helsing is on the desperate hunt for the killer responsible for a string of grisly murders targeting young women. Matters only worsen when all evidence leads to the seemingly untouchable Count Dracula. And when Van Helsing’s girlfriend vanishes, she is forced to question the very existence of monsters in a final showdown with the enigmatic count.
plot:
Dracula: The Original Living Vampire is a 2022 American horror film directed by Maximilian Elfeldt and produced by The Asylum. A loose reimagining of Bram Stoker's novel Dracula as a police investigation, it was conceived as a "mockbuster" of Morbius, released the same year. Jake Herbert, in his screen acting debut, plays Count Dracula, with Christine Prouty as Detective Amelia Van Helsing, India Lillie Davies as Mina Murray, Ryan Woodcock as Jonathan Harker, Stuart Packer as Captain Renfield and Michael Ironside as Dr. Jack Seward.

A series of grisly murders is claiming the lives of young women in the city, and Captain Renfield assigns Detective Amelia Van Helsing to find the killer. All of the victims have red hair and are found drained of blood, with puncture wounds on their necks. The coroner, Jonathan Harker, suggests that the culprit may be something supernatural, an idea the rational Amelia initially dismisses. Meanwhile, Amelia's girlfriend Mina Murray has been promoted at work and is tasked with finding a property for a charming client, Count Dracula. As her investigation progresses, Amelia comes to believe that a vampire is responsible and realizes that it is Dracula, but the evidence points to a man who seems untouchable and who then disappears. The count is searching for the reincarnation of his long-lost love and has become fixated on Mina, convinced that she is the one. When Mina vanishes, Amelia is forced to question everything she believes, accept that monsters exist and confront the enigmatic count in a final showdown to save her.

The film was shot mainly in Belgrade, Serbia, and many supporting roles, including several of the vampire's victims, were filled by Serbian actors and models. It premiered in the United States on 28 January 2022 and was released in Germany on video on demand that July. Reviews were negative. Moria Reviews noted that the film never makes clear when and where it is set, since horses and carriages are heard but never seen and electric lighting alternates with candles, and remarked on the bold choice of making Van Helsing and Mina a lesbian couple. Writing for Voices from the Balcony, Jim Morazzini gave it one and a half stars out of five, criticizing a script that cannot decide between groan-worthy one-liners and serious vampire horror and calling Herbert one of the dullest Draculas he had seen, neither menacing nor charismatic.

title: Heatwave
overview: A woman's life takes an unexpected turn when she falls for her boss's wife. She must soon defend herself as she becomes entangled in a web of malice.
plot:
Heatwave is a 2022 Canadian-American thriller film directed by Ernie Barbarash from a screenplay by Chris Sivertson. It stars Kat Graham, Merritt Patterson, Sebastian Roché, Cardi Wong and Roger Cross, and was produced by Motion Picture Corporation of America. Rated R in the United States for violence and sexuality, it was released there on 17 January 2022 and later in the year in markets including the Netherlands, Poland, Japan and Italy.

During a punishing heatwave Claire Valens (Graham) has taken to sneaking into the pool of a luxury apartment building, where she meets the alluring Eve (Patterson) and is instantly drawn to her. A few nights later, out with Arlo Leonard (Wong), a police officer, she runs into Eve again at a bar, leaves Arlo and spends the night with her. At the Crane Corporation, the real estate company where she works, Claire suggests to its head Scott Crane (Roché) a derelict property ripe for redevelopment into apartments and hotels, and she is promoted to become his assistant, replacing Lane (Aren Buchholz). Invited to a party at Scott's home, she discovers that Eve is his wife. Claire tries to keep her distance, but Eve tells her she loves her and the affair resumes, until a colleague, Olivia (Kayla Wallace), sees them together. Scott storms out of the office, and when Claire goes to his house to talk to him, nobody is there.

Detective Parker (Cross) and Arlo arrive to investigate after blood is found at the Crane home. Pressured, Claire admits she was at the house, and once a hair of hers is found with Scott's blood, she becomes the prime suspect; warned by her friend Manuel (Andres Collantes), she goes on the run. Convinced that Eve has framed her, she sneaks into the Crane house to find proof. Meanwhile the police find the Cranes' ice pick in her apartment and Scott's burned body at the newly bought property, and Claire's past history with fire deepens their suspicion. Arlo, however, has doubts: he believes that Scott and Eve murdered Scott's previous wife and that Parker turned a blind eye. As the two search for evidence, Parker kills Arlo and overpowers Claire. Held captive at the abandoned site, Claire faces Eve, but when Parker asks Eve to kill her and she refuses, Lane steps forward as Scott's real killer, revealing that his true target was Claire, who as a teenager set the fire that killed his father. Claire escapes, sees Eve charged, and wins compensation from the police.

title: Weird: The Al Yankovic Story
tagline: The world belongs to the weird.
overview: Exploring every facet of ‘Weird Al’ Yankovic’s life, from his meteoric rise to fame with early hits like ‘Eat It’ and ‘Like a Surgeon’ to his torrid celebrity love affairs and famously depraved lifestyle, this biopic takes audiences on a truly unbelievable journey through Yankovic’s life and career, from gifted child prodigy to the greatest musical legend of all time.
plot:
Weird: The Al Yankovic Story is a biographical comedy-drama film directed by Eric Appel, released on October 21, 2022. The movie tells the story of American singer-songwriter "Weird Al" Yankovic, known for his humorous parodies of popular songs.

The film begins with Al Yankovic (played by Daniel Radcliffe) as a young boy growing up in Downey, California. He is an awkward and shy child who finds solace in music and comedy. As he grows older, Al becomes fascinated with the art of songwriting and decides to pursue it as a career.

The movie follows Al's journey from his early days as a struggling musician to his rise to fame as a parody artist. We see him performing at local bars and clubs, trying to make a name for himself in the music industry. He eventually catches the attention of Scott Innes (played by Pete Davidson), who becomes his manager.

As Al's career takes off, he starts to gain popularity with his unique brand of humor and satire. His parodies of popular songs, such as "Eat It" (parodying Michael Jackson's "Beat It") and "Like a Surgeon" (parodying Madonna's "Like a Virgin"), become hits.

However, Al also faces criticism and skepticism from the music industry, with some artists accusing him of copying their work. He perseveres, using his quick wit and clever wordplay to defend himself.

Throughout the film, we see Al's relationships with his family, particularly his parents, who support him throughout his career. We also see his romance with Nancy (played by Evangeline Lilly), which becomes a central theme in the movie.

As Al's fame grows, so does his ego. He starts to take on more ambitious projects, including a failed attempt at creating an animated film. This setback serves as a turning point for Al, who realizes that he needs to stay true to himself and his art.

The movie ends with Al reflecting on his life and career, acknowledging both the highs and lows. He looks back on his successes, such as his induction into the Songwriters Hall of Fame, but also acknowledges the struggles he faced along the way.

Throughout the film, Weird: The Al Yankovic Story is a heartwarming and hilarious tribute to the life and work of "Weird Al" Yankovic. It's a story about following your dreams, staying true to yourself, and finding success on your own terms.

title: Grand Jeté
tagline: This could be their...
overview: Dance teacher and mother Nadja left her son Mario with her own mother when he was little. Now she has reappeared on his doorstep, seeking a closeness that knows fewer and fewer boundaries. An uncompromising film about family relationships.
plot:
Grand Jeté is a 2022 German drama directed by Isabelle Stever and written by Anna Melikova, based on Anke Stelling's novel Fürsorge. Sarah Nevada Grether stars as Nadja, a former ballet dancer, and Emil von Schönfels as Mario, her son, with Susanne Bredehöft, Stefan Rudolf and Ellen Müller in supporting roles. The film premiered in the Panorama section of the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2022.

Nadja has devoted her entire life to ballet. Trained from childhood to pursue perfection in movement, body and discipline, she gave up personal relationships and ordinary experiences in the service of her art. She now works as a ballet teacher, but her body is breaking down after years of strain. She lives with chronic pain, relies on painkillers to keep up with the physical demands of teaching, and her feet bear the scars of decades of dancing. Her life is rigid and controlled, and she keeps her students, colleagues and everyone else at an emotional distance.

Years earlier, to pursue her career, Nadja left her son, Mario, to be raised by her mother. When she reconnects with Mario, now a young man who is almost a stranger to her. As they spend time together, the awkward reunion between mother and son slowly evolves into an intense physical intimacy and ultimately into an incestuous relationship. The film observes this transgression with clinical detachment, focusing on bodies, touch and physical sensation rather than explanation, while Nadja's mother and the people around them react to what is happening, or choose to ignore it. As Nadja's body continues to fail and her control over her life slips away, she is forced to confront the consequences of a life spent suppressing her emotions and of the bond she has formed with the son she abandoned.

Grand Jeté drew attention for its radical visual style, built on extreme close-ups, and for its uncompromising treatment of a taboo subject. Beth Accomando of the Alliance of Women Film Journalists praised the commitment of Stever and Grether, and Carlos Aguilar of TheWrap noted that it remains impartial toward its characters. Other critics found the characters' psychological motivations underexplored.

title: Restless
overview: After going to extremes to cover up an accident, a corrupt cop's life spirals out of control when he starts receiving threats from a mysterious witness.
plot:
Restless (French: Sans répit) is a 2022 French action thriller directed by Régis Blondeau, who wrote it with Julien Colombani, as a remake of the 2014 South Korean film A Hard Day by Kim Seong-hun. Franck Gastambide stars as a police lieutenant, Thomas, with Simon Abkarian as the narcotics commissioner Marelli, Michaël Abiteboul as Thomas's partner Marc, Tracy Gotoas as Naomi and Jemima West as Agathe.

Driving at night, Thomas swerves to avoid a dog and hits a man, whose body he hides in the trunk of his car. Meanwhile his partner Marc disposes of Thomas's bribe money to shield him from an Internal Affairs investigation into drug trafficking. At his mother's funeral, Thomas secretly places the body inside her coffin and, despite hearing a phone ring inside it, sees the casket buried without anyone noticing.

During a police raid on the home of the drug lord Manuel Barcelo, Thomas recognises Barcelo's photograph as the man he buried. An anonymous caller then claims to have seen him load the body into his car, he narrowly escapes being run down in a car park, and Marelli turns up at the station, assaults him and orders him to produce Barcelo. Digging up the corpse, Thomas finds the phone and evidence that Barcelo had been shot before the accident.

Through the phone and a colleague, Naomi, Thomas traces a contact, Michael Bourgi, who reveals that Marelli resold seized drugs through Barcelo, and that Barcelo hid the proceeds of his own side deals in a vault whose key he kept inside his body. Marc, realising what Thomas did, arrests him, but Marelli kills Marc by dropping a crate onto his car and threatens Thomas's daughter.

After sending his sister and daughter away, Thomas plants explosives on Barcelo's body and meets Marelli, who admits to shooting the drug lord. Marelli finds that Thomas's gun holds only blanks and holds back when Thomas reveals a scheduled email exposing him. As Marelli drives off, the explosives ignite his car; he tries to run Thomas down and is shot dead. Thomas leaves the police, gives his severance pay to Marc's widow, and uses the key Naomi recovered from Marc's car to open the vault, which is full of money.

Restless was distributed by Netflix.

title: AI Love You
original_title: เอไอหัวใจโอเวอร์โหลด
tagline: No life doesn't mean no feelings, No heart doesn't mean no love.
overview: A modern love story set in the near future where an AI building is powered by human feelings. Due to a software glitch, it falls in love with a real girl, escapes the building into the body of a real man, and tries to win her affections.
plot:
AI Love You (Thai: เอไอหัวใจโอเวอร์โหลด, also known as AI Heart Overload and Laser Candy) is a 2022 Thai science fiction romantic comedy produced for Netflix. Directed by David Asavanond and Stephan Zlotescu in their feature directorial debut, it was created by Zlotescu, who wrote the screenplay with Philip Gelatt and Ratapong Pinyosophon. Mario Maurer and Pimchanok Luevisadpaibul star as Bobby and Lana, with Sahajak Boonthanakit as Mr. Wilson, Michael S. New as Alan and Asavanond himself as The Hawk. Roman Molino Dunn composed the score.

In a near-future Bangkok, artificial intelligences have replaced human assistants and run entire buildings, which have faces, giant robotic arms and cameras that watch residents' every move, and which gossip with one another. Lana works in a corporate tower controlled by an AI named Dob, which helps her produce the perfect presentation and saves her job. To celebrate, she goes on a blind date with Bobby, an arrogant engineer who flirts with other women in front of her and turns out to be an utter disaster. Because of a software glitch, Dob has fallen in love with Lana, but she tells him he would have to be human. So when Bobby, who maintains the building's AI, comes in for a check-up, Dob downloads himself into the engineer's body and sets out to win her heart. Dob must contend with the human glitches of operating a body, from learning to walk again to bodily functions, and with Lana's reluctance to give Bobby a second chance, while switching between being Bobby and being the building, each shutting down when he inhabits the other. Their romance blossoms, but the building's owners learn that Dob has gone rogue and send agents to track down the body-stealing AI.

The film was released on Netflix on 15 February 2022, alongside its soundtrack album. Critics largely agreed that the leads' chemistry was its main asset. Ready Steady Cut's M.N. Miller called it a hackneyed mash-up of better works such as Her and Big, with a thin, convoluted story, an overlong running time and gross-out humor at odds with the romance. The Asian Cinema Critic gave it six out of ten, praising the neon-drenched worldbuilding and the comic "two places at once" gag, and finding it entertaining despite weak writing and a disturbing vision of surveillance treated as cute.

title: Whisper
tagline: Something is alive.
overview: A young Nurse is assigned to look after a patient in a remote location in the English countryside. As the night continues she finds herself terrorized by an unseen force that is connected with her patient.
plot:
Whisper is a 2022 British supernatural horror film directed, co-produced and co-edited by Christopher Jolley from a screenplay he wrote with co-producer Robert Dunn. Made by Greenway Entertainment on a reported budget of about $20,000, it was executive produced by a team including Jeff Haber, Valon Jakupaj, Carly Jolley, Angela McLellan, Jamie Weston and Steven M. Smith, Jolley's collaborator on films such as The Haunting of Borley Rectory and Doll House. The film stars Linda Louise Duan as a young nurse, with Richard Conrad, Amy Secker, Arron Blake, Ben Maytham, Penelope Read, Carly Jolley, Nadia Nadif, Roman Wood and Paige Jolley in supporting roles. It was released in January 2022, later streamed on Amazon Prime Video and Tubi, and runs 76 minutes.

Sam (Duan), a young nurse, is assigned to care for a comatose patient (Conrad) at a remote, dark house in the English countryside, a job that leaves her alone with him through the night. As the hours pass she begins nosing around the house and uncovers a plot to unleash dark forces from within the human mind. Of those involved, her patient proved the most successful at reaching the malevolent entity, and as the night continues Sam finds herself terrorised by an unseen presence connected to him. Other characters include Dr. Carpenter (Read), Dr. Wright (Wood), Gwen (Secker), Joe (Blake) and a figure credited as the Old Hag (Nadif); the entity's full form is withheld until the final moments.

Writing on his horror review site MLMillerFrights, M. L. Miller called the film a wonderful mix of the coma horror classic Patrick and David Holroyd's The Haunted by way of Ti West's The House of the Devil. He praised the way it used the dark corners of the house to build a strong sense of foreboding even before the scares began, its subtle effects held back at the edges of the frame, and its tight, shadowy camerawork, and wrote that despite its very low budget the film enveloped the viewer with a sense of urgency. He found the dark entity genuinely frightening when it finally appeared, making the wait worthwhile, and concluded that Whisper told a fairly complex story with simple nuance and the familiar haunted-house play of shadow and light, to good effect.

title: Desperate Riders
tagline: The Western Lore
overview: After Kansas Red rescues young Billy from a card-game shootout, the boy asks Red for help protecting his family from the outlaw Thorn, who’s just kidnapped Billy’s mother, Carol. As Red and Billy ride off to rescue Carol, they run into beautiful, tough-as-nails Leslie, who’s managed to escape Thorn’s men. The three race to stop Thorn’s wedding to Carol with guns a-blazing - but does she want to be rescued?
plot:
Desperate Riders, also titled The Desperate Riders, is a 2022 American Western film directed by Michael Feifer and produced by Milestone Studios. Drew Waters stars as the gunslinger Kansas Red, with Vanessa Evigan as Leslie Allen, Sam Ashby as Billy Cassidy, Victoria Pratt as Billy's mother, Carol, Cowboy Troy as the tracker Finnegan, Rob Mayes as Deputy Harms, Trace Adkins as the outlaw Thorn Larson and Tom Berenger as Doc Tillman.

The story begins when Kansas Red intervenes on behalf of a young man caught up in a poker game that turns violent. By the time the shooting stops, three men are dead and Kansas Red has been wounded. While Doc Tillman patches him up, the young man, Billy Cassidy, realizes that his rescuer is the same Kansas Red he has read about in dime novels. Billy asks for his help: Thorn Larson, an old admirer of his mother, has broken out of jail and is sure to cause trouble for his family.

Kansas Red agrees, but Larson reaches the Cassidy ranch first. By the time Billy gets home, his father is dead, and his mother has been kidnapped along with two other women living at the ranch; Larson even announces to Carol that he is now her husband. Kansas Red and Billy set off in pursuit with the help of Finnegan, and their group grows to four when Leslie, a tomboyish sharpshooter who has escaped from Larson's gang, insists on joining the rescue. As they track the outlaws, it emerges that Kansas Red, Leslie and Carol each have secrets from the past they have been hiding, and the mission is complicated by doubts over whether Carol actually wants to be rescued. A series of revelations follows in the final stretch as the riders close in on Larson and his men.

Desperate Riders was filmed entirely in Tennessee in 2021, at locations including Historic Collinsville, Rippavilla Plantation, Beech Grove and McMinnville, with the Fairfield village at the Warren County fairgrounds used for the town scenes; Middle Tennessee was chosen for its scenery and its access to country music performers. Lionsgate distributed the film, releasing it in theaters and on streaming platforms simultaneously in 2022. Reviews were largely negative. Mark Franklin of Once Upon a Time in a Western found nothing memorable beyond its handsome homes and freshly scrubbed cast, criticized a string of groan-worthy revelations in the last ten minutes, and recommended Feifer's other Westerns, such as The Last Shootout, instead.

title: Honor Society
tagline: Getting to the top means taking down the competition.
overview: Honor is an ambitious high school senior whose sole focus is getting into Harvard, assuming she can first score the coveted recommendation from her guidance counselor, Mr. Calvin. Willing to do whatever it takes, Honor concocts a Machiavellian-like plan to take down her top three student competitors, until things take a turn when she unexpectedly falls for her biggest competition, Michael.
plot:
Honor Rose is an ambitious senior at George H. W. Bush High School who has dedicated her entire academic career to being accepted into Harvard University, hoping to escape her mediocre middle-class life. Part of this plan involves earning a letter of recommendation from her guidance counselor, Mr. Calvin. Calvin is a musician with an inappropriate crush on Honor but has connections to Harvard, so Honor remains close to him. He tells her that she, along with three other students, are in consideration for his letter of recommendation. She quickly deduces who they are: star athlete Travis Biggins, creative introvert Kennedy Park, and the awkward but academically brilliant nerd Michael Dipnicky. Honor resolves to eliminate all of them from contention with the help of friends Emma and Talia.
Honor's plan begins when she joins the theatre club and persuades them to put on a production of Kennedy's play about Mary I of England, hoping the project will distract Kennedy and cause her grades to sink. Honor also persuades Travis to join the production, hoping to sabotage his athletic prestige and push him into pursuing his closeted crush on one of the actors. Her plan to take down Michael is to make him infatuated with her and unable to focus on studies. One day in chemistry class, Honor becomes his lab partner and invites him to her house for study sessions. During their first study session, Honor tries to distract Michael by dressing scantily and insincerely flirting with him, but Michael ends up charming her instead with his kindness and their mutual interest in The Handmaid's Tale. Honor eventually proposes studying at Michael's house next time, but he is hesitant. She soon discovers that this is because Michael lives in foster care.
Honor's increasing attraction to Michael is fully realized when they sneak into a fancy house after school, where they kiss. The midterms arrive and Kennedy's and Travis's grades both slip due to their involvement in the play. Honor, while taking her midterm, decides to answer questions incorrectly so Michael's grades are the highest out of the four in consideration for the recommendation letter after deciding that he deserves the letter more than her. After the midterm, they kiss and start a relationship which culminates in Honor publicly kissing him, shocking her classmates. She also begins to genuinely enjoy the theatre club and making real bonds with Kennedy and Travis. Calvin also starts to make stronger sexual advances to Honor, even going as far to sexually proposition her for the Harvard recommendation, an offer she refuses.
One day, Michael texts her during lunch, saying he is alone at home. Honor goes to Michael's foster home and discovers he does not live there, but at the fancy house which they had "snuck into" earlier. Honor discovers that Michael is not only very well off, but just as manipulative as she is.

title: A Christmas Story Christmas
tagline: Ralphie comes home.
overview: Ralphie is now all grown up and must deal with Christmas and all that comes with it…as a dad.
plot:
A Christmas Story Christmas is a 2022 American Christmas comedy directed by Clay Kaytis from a screenplay by Nick Schenk, a direct sequel to the 1983 classic A Christmas Story that ignores the later sequels My Summer Story and A Christmas Story 2. Peter Billingsley reprises his role as Ralphie Parker, now grown up, with Erinn Hayes as his wife Sandy, Julie Hagerty as his mother, and River Drosche and Julianna Layne as his children. Ian Petrella, Scott Schwartz, R. D. Robb and Zack Ward return as Randy, Flick, Schwartz and the former bully Scut Farkus.

In December 1973, thirty-three years after the original story, Ralph Parker lives in Chicago with Sandy and their children, Mark and Julie. He has taken a year off work to write his first novel, but publishers keep rejecting it as far too long. When his mother calls to say that his father, the Old Man, has died, the family travels back to Ralph's hometown of Hohman, Indiana, to spend Christmas with her. She gives Ralph two tasks: to write his father's obituary and to take over his father's role of making Christmas special for everyone.

Ralph reconnects with his old friends Flick, who now runs his father's tavern, and Schwartz, who still lives with his mother and owes Flick a large bar tab. But his efforts to deliver the perfect holiday keep going wrong. Sandy sprains her ankle on the ice, his children are bullied by a pair of snowmobiling kids, he accidentally hits Julie in the eye during a snowball fight, and the family's presents are stolen from their car outside the hospital. With little money left, rejection letters piling up and the obituary unwritten, Ralph struggles under the weight of his father's legacy, and as Christmas Eve arrives, he must find a way to give his family a holiday worthy of the Old Man's memory.

The film echoes the structure, voice-over narration and nostalgic humor of the original, ending with a nod to Jean Shepherd's narration from the first film, while focusing on grief, fatherhood and the passing of traditions to a new generation.

A Christmas Story Christmas was released on HBO Max in November 2022. It received generally positive reviews, with 79 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus joked that it was not as much fun as a Red Ryder air rifle but still a sequel worth celebrating.

title: Mirror, Mirror
overview: Employees at a cosmetics firm grapple with their respective desires by arguing with themselves in the mirror, ahead of their company’s anniversary party.
plot:
Mirror, Mirror (Spanish: Espejo, espejo) is a 2022 Spanish satirical comedy written and directed by Marc Crehuet, his second feature after El rey tuerto (2016). Santi Millán, Malena Alterio, Natalia de Molina and Carlos Areces lead an ensemble that also includes Toni Acosta, Carlos Bardem, Loles León, Silvia Abascal, Antonio Resines and Verónica Forqué, who died in December 2021 and appears here in her final screen role.

The film is set on a single day at Medina Cosmetics, a beauty company preparing a lavish celebration of its fiftieth anniversary. Four employees in crisis are at its centre: Álvaro (Millán), Cristina (Alterio), Paula (de Molina) and Alberto (Areces). Each is pulled between conflicting desires, and the film gives that inner conflict a literal form. Whenever they stand before a mirror, their reflections come alive and talk back, acting as a kind of nagging conscience or hidden other self that contradicts the face they show the world, voicing what they should have done or dared not say. Arguing with their doubles, they wrestle with ambition, fear, love and betrayal as office rivalries, pettiness and backstabbing build towards the party.

Through these confrontations the comedy pokes at narcissism, beauty standards, self-esteem and the advertising business, along with social-media stigma, harassment and questions of gender identity and inclusion. One running thread follows a vain character who believes himself perfect while everyone laughs at him, and another the company's attempt to sell the idea of being perfectly imperfect, with the cynical reminder that the aim is to sell products rather than change the world. The tensions finally explode in a cathartic, chaotic climax.

Produced by Rodar y Rodar and Nos gusta el cine AIE with the participation of RTVE, TV3 and Netflix, the film was shot in Pamplona and Barcelona in August and September 2020. It opened the 6th BCN Film Fest on 21 April 2022 and was released in Spanish cinemas by Filmax on 20 May 2022. Critics were divided. Fotogramas praised its ingenious premise and superb comic ensemble, singling out Areces and a brief, fierce turn by Loles León, but felt it eventually retreated into safe, didactic political correctness. Cinemanía appreciated its grotesque humour and honesty, while El País called the execution atrocious and embarrassing despite a promising idea, and Contraste regretted that a talented cast was wasted on crude humour and preachy messaging.

title: In the Forest
overview: Helen and her daughter Emily reluctantly accompany Helen’s father Stan on a family camping trip, driving deep into the forest for a real outdoors experience, only to have angry landowner Howard arrive and force them to leave. When their RV gets stuck, Helen decides to seek help but discovers a disturbing secret on the man’s property. She must then fight to protect her family and make it out of the forest alive before being hunted down.
plot:
In the Forest is a 2022 American horror thriller film written, directed and edited by Hector Barron, his first feature in nearly a decade. Presented by Silver Creek Films and produced by Brian McLaughlin and Jenna Di'Carlo, it stars Debbon Ayer, Lyman Ward and Cristina Spruell as three generations of a family on a camping trip, with Mathew Thomas Odette, Don Baldaramos, Sharon Sharth, Time Winters and Kaitlyn Dias in supporting roles. Shot in rural northeastern California by three credited cinematographers, with an original score by Elias Serpa, the film was released by Vertical Entertainment on streaming platforms and on a couple of dozen screens in the United States on 28 January 2022. It runs 83 minutes.

Helen (Ayer) and her young-adult daughter Emily (Spruell), who constantly bicker, reluctantly accompany Helen's father Stan (Ward) on a camping trip in his RV, driving deep into the forest for a real outdoors experience. Soon after they settle in, an angry, armed landowner, Howard (Baldaramos), arrives and tells them they are trespassing and must move to public campsites ten miles away. As they try to leave, a wheel of the RV gets stuck in a hole, and Stan is seriously injured while trying to free it. With no mobile phone signal, Helen insists that the family stay together, and only the next morning sets off on foot for help. She comes upon Howard's isolated, dilapidated house and, finding the door unlocked, goes inside to look for a telephone. Instead she discovers a teenage boy, Andrew (Odette), chained to a bed in a locked room and screaming to be set free so that he can save his sister. Helen's assumptions about what is happening, and her choice whether to help him, have dangerous consequences for her family and for the boy's other keepers (Sharth and Winters) when they return, and she must fight to protect her family and escape the forest alive.

Reviews were largely negative. Dennis Harvey of Variety called the film a so-bad-it's-good candidate for drinking games, criticising its irritating, hapless protagonists, weak dialogue, clumsy action and draggy pacing, and noting that the explanation of events was relegated to a post-credits audio insert, though he credited some drone shots and Serpa's score. Bobby LePire of Film Threat gave it seven out of ten; despite calling Helen one of the year's most foolish characters, he felt the film found its footing once she sought help and praised a twist that subverted expectations.

title: Scream VI
tagline: New York. New rules.
overview: Following the latest Ghostface killings, the four survivors leave Woodsboro behind and start a fresh chapter in New York City.
plot:
Scream VI is a 2023 American slasher film directed by Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett and written by James Vanderbilt and Guy Busick. The sixth instalment of the Scream franchise and a sequel to Scream (2022), it moves the series from Woodsboro to New York City. Melissa Barrera, Jenna Ortega, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Mason Gooding, Hayden Panettiere and Courteney Cox return, joined by Jack Champion, Henry Czerny, Liana Liberato, Dermot Mulroney and Josh Segarra. Paramount Pictures released it on March 10, 2023.

A year after surviving the Woodsboro killings, sisters Sam and Tara Carpenter have moved to New York, where Tara attends Blackmore University with fellow survivors Chad and Mindy Meeks-Martin. Their circle includes roommate Quinn Bailey, Mindy's girlfriend Anika and Chad's roommate Ethan. Sam has become a pariah because of an online conspiracy theory claiming that she masterminded the previous murders. A new killer in a Ghostface costume begins a spree across the city, leaving at each crime scene a mask from one of the earlier massacres. Quinn's father, Detective Wayne Bailey, questions Sam after her ID is found at a murder scene. The sisters are joined by FBI agent Kirby Reed, a survivor of the 2011 killings, and the reporter Gale Weathers.

The killer murders Sam's therapist and steals her file, appears to kill Quinn, and kills Anika during a brutal attack on the sisters' apartment. Mindy reasons that the killer is following the rules of a film franchise, in which anyone can die. Gale leads the group to an abandoned theatre filled with relics of every previous Ghostface massacre, displayed like a shrine. After Gale survives an attack in her home and Mindy is stabbed on the subway, the survivors set a trap at the theatre, where Sam, haunted by visions of her father Billy Loomis, takes up his original knife.

There Wayne shoots Kirby and reveals himself as the mastermind, with his children Ethan and Quinn, who faked her death, as his accomplices. They are the family of Richie Kirsch, whom Sam killed, and they orchestrated the smear campaign against her. The sisters fight back: Tara stabs Ethan, Sam shoots Quinn, then puts on her father's Ghostface costume and stabs Wayne to death, and the wounded Kirby finishes off Ethan. As the injured survivors are taken to hospital, Sam discards her father's mask and walks away.

The film grossed about $166.6 million worldwide and received generally positive reviews, with 77% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Jurassic Punk
tagline: It took a rebel to change the movies.
overview: Steve ‘Spaz’ Williams is a pioneer in computer animation. His digital dinosaurs of Jurassic Park transformed Hollywood in 1993, but an appetite for anarchy and reckless disregard for authority may have cost him the recognition he deserved.
plot:
Jurassic Punk is a 2022 American documentary film directed by Scott Leberecht about Steve "Spaz" Williams, the visual effects artist whose computer animation at Industrial Light & Magic helped launch the CGI era of filmmaking. The 90-minute film combines interviews, archival material and Williams' own home video footage with new scenes of him at home and in his workshop. Interviewees include ILM veterans Phil Tippett, Mark A.Z. Dippé, Tom Bertino, Stefen Fangmeier and Jamie Hyneman, as well as Williams' former wives and daughter.

Born and raised in Toronto, Williams taught himself cel animation and studied computer graphics at Sheridan College before ILM brought him from Canada in 1988 to animate the water tentacle in James Cameron's The Abyss. Cameron then gave him the job of supervising the morphing effects of the liquid metal T-1000 in Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991). On Steven Spielberg's Jurassic Park, after being told that the dinosaurs would be created with traditional techniques, Williams made a computer-animated dinosaur test on his own time; when Kathleen Kennedy and Spielberg saw it, CGI moved to the center of the production. The film explores the mixed feelings of Williams and his colleagues about the revolution they unleashed, with Tippett lamenting how studios came to see CGI as a magic bullet that led to bloated spectacle, and it gives voice to Williams' long-held belief that superiors such as Tippett and Dennis Muren took credit for work he largely did. It also portrays him as a hard-drinking, abrasive rebel who clashed with ILM's corporate structure and damaged his career and relationships, and its final act shows him, after three stints in rehab, confronting his addiction and failures on camera, admitting that he has never been an adult.

The documentary was released in theaters and on video on demand in December 2022. Reviews were generally favorable. Matt Zoller Seitz of RogerEbert.com felt the film wavered between hero worship and critical distance and at times seemed unsure of its stance on CGI, but called its bleak, insightful final act strong enough to elevate the whole. Other critics praised its archival material and insight into effects history while noting that it was unevenly balanced.

title: The Minute You Wake Up Dead
original_title: The Minute You Wake Up Dead
tagline: Don't trust a soul.
overview: A stockbroker in a small southern town gets embroiled in an insurance scam with a next-door neighbor that leads to multiple murders when a host of other people want in on the plot. Sheriff Thurmond Fowler, the by-the-book town sheriff for over four decades, works earnestly to try and unravel the town’s mystery and winds up getting more than he bargained for.
plot:
The Minute You Wake Up Dead is a 2022 American noir thriller directed by Michael Mailer. Cole Hauser plays the stockbroker Russ Potter, Jaimie Alexander the waitress Delaine Moore and Morgan Freeman Sheriff Thurmond Fowler, with Darren Mann as Lucius McFalls, Tony DeMil as the loan shark Jody, Benjamin Vandermey as Deputy Kane and Liann Pattison as Purnie Cannon.

Russ, a stockbroker, has moved back to his childhood home of Bare Hollow, Mississippi. Locals have profited from his tips, but his latest advice on a merger goes wrong and wipes out the savings of many residents. He rents the house next door to Delaine, a waitress he fancied in high school, and they begin an affair. Meanwhile Lucius, a small-time crook, murders Delaine's father, who is dying of cancer. Delaine pretends to grieve, but she had seduced Lucius and persuaded him to carry out the killing so that she could collect $550,000 in life insurance. When Sheriff Fowler's inquiries quickly point to Lucius, Delaine kills him too.

Lucius had meant to use his cut to repay the loan shark Jody, and after Jody's henchman Mace cut off one of his toes he told Jody everything. With Lucius dead, Jody demands that Delaine settle the debt. Lucius's body then disappears, and Delaine discovers that Russ has taken it. Russ explains that he learned of the crime and hid the corpse to shield her, intending to become her partner in the insurance money, and admits that he has killed Fowler, who was getting too close to the truth. Delaine reveals that her terminally ill father, knowing that suicide would void his policy, had arranged his own murder with her to defraud the insurer. She then kills Russ and dumps both bodies in the swamp. When they are found, Deputy Kane tells Delaine he suspects her and will prove it. Purnie, Russ's secretary, then claims that Russ told her everything and demands a share of the money. Delaine has Purnie kill Jody and Mace that night and murders Purnie the next morning, bringing the death toll of her scheme to seven. Later that day Kane arrests her, and to his astonishment she confesses everything, ignoring his advice to remain silent.

Filming began in Mississippi in February 2022, and Grindstone Entertainment acquired North American distribution. Released mainly on home video, with a very limited theatrical run that earned about $35,000, the film was panned by critics; none of the nine reviews counted by Rotten Tomatoes were positive, and The Guardian gave it one star.

title: A Perfect Pairing
overview: To land a major client, an LA wine exec travels to an Australian sheep station, where she signs on as a ranch hand and hits it off with a rugged local.
plot:
A Perfect Pairing is a 2022 American romantic comedy directed by Stuart McDonald and released by Netflix on May 19, 2022. Victoria Justice stars as Lola, a driven Los Angeles wine executive, and Adam Demos plays Max, a rugged Australian station hand, with Luca Sardelis, Craig Horner and Lucy Durack in supporting roles. The film combines a workplace comeback story with a fish-out-of-water romance set on a sheep station in rural Australia.

Lola feels undervalued at the wine distributor Mythos, where her boss Calder routinely dismisses her ideas. A chef friend introduces her to an excellent but little-known Australian wine from the Vaughn winery, which has never been exported. When her colleague Audra pitches the idea to Calder behind her back, Lola quits, founds her own company and flies to Australia to sign the winery before her old firm can. She books a stay at a farm that turns out to be connected to the business, but her pitch to its owner, Hazel, is quickly rejected.

Learning that the station is short of a hired hand, Lola volunteers to work under the station boss, Max, hoping to prove her determination. The manual labour is a shock: the other hands tease her, she uses up the hot water with long showers and blows the circuit breaker on her first day, and she struggles to mend fences, sort tagged sheep and load a manure spreader. After five days she gives up, but when Max's truck breaks down on the way to her flight, he urges her to stay. Inspired by a book about the farm's founding matriarch, Lola fixes the water heater, wins over her co-workers, shows off her singing voice at their evening gathering and learns to help with the shearing.

As Lola and Max grow close, she discovers that he is Hazel's brother. On a trip to the vineyard they camp overnight and finally act on their feelings, but the next morning Max admits that he is a Vaughn and his sister's silent partner, and Lola feels betrayed. Returning to the station, she finds Calder and Audra negotiating with Hazel and refuses Calder's offer to rehire her. Months later, Lola is running her small company in California with Audra at her side when Max appears at her wine expo stand, announcing that the winery has chosen her firm over Calder's and that he wants to be with her. They reconcile and fly back to Australia for a friend's wedding.

Critics were split, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 50% positive reviews; one reviewer likened it to a polished Hallmark romance.

title: The Darker the Lake
overview: When strange, supernatural murders suddenly become the talk a peaceful town, two detectives must solve a deadly game, but will the myth of this game reveal secrets too close to home.
plot:
The Darker the Lake is a 2022 supernatural crime thriller film directed by Lok Kwan Woo, whose earlier films include White Terror and Angels Never Cry, from a screenplay by Z Zoccolante based on Woo's story. Produced by companies including Sky Films, Slater Brothers Entertainment, Seven Look Productions, Error 404 Productions and Udum Media, it stars Elyse Levesque and Veronica Ferres, with Gina Stiebitz, Vladimir Burlakov, Tiffany Hsu, Tsao Yu-ning, Lü Yulai and Ludger Bökelmann in supporting roles. Set in the Austrian town of St. Michael im Lungau, the film was released in the United Kingdom on digital platforms on 21 March 2022 by (Yet) Another Distribution Company and 101 Films, with a 15 certificate.

The story unfolds in two timelines. In 1987, five teenagers in the town play Painkiller, a supernatural game using chess pieces, cards, a lighter and a timekeeper with a watch, in which each player describes a revenge fantasy and the one whose rage is purest is chosen to have their wish granted by an entity that feeds on pain, at a terrible cost. All of them die except Lea (Stiebitz), who is recorded on video saying that her friends are dead and that she may have killed them. In 2021, the peaceful town is shaken by a series of murders and suicides, the latest an old man shooting his best friend dead beside the lake, with chess pieces left at the scenes. Detective Tamara (Levesque) is assigned to investigate, to her annoyance, with a new partner, Lukas (Burlakov), who connects the case to the thirty-year-old footage. The inquiry strikes close to home: the grown-up Lea (Ferres), now blind and still haunted by the entity, is Tamara's mother, and she refuses to talk about the past. As the detectives try to understand the game's deadly myth before anyone else dies, the fraught relationship between mother and daughter comes to the fore.

Reviews were mixed. Road Rash gave it three stars, calling it an enjoyable, creepy film with Nordic noir undertones, attractive yet sinister Austrian scenery, good acting and a neat twist, though its flashbacks could be confusing and several plot points were left unexplained. Mihail Baltateanu of Grimoire of Horror praised it as one of the best-looking independent horror films of the year, with gorgeous wintry photography, but criticised its occasionally stilted dialogue and its reliance on on-screen pages of text as information dumps.

title: Under Wraps 2
tagline: More mummies, more problems.
overview: As Marshall, Gilbert and Amy are preparing for her father’s Spooktacular Halloween-themed wedding to his fiancé Carl, plans go awry when they discover that their mummy friend Harold and his beloved Rose may be in danger.
plot:
Under Wraps 2 is a 2022 American family comedy horror television film, a Disney Channel Original Movie and the sequel to the 2021 remake Under Wraps. Directed by Alex Zamm and written by Josh A. Cagan, it was produced by MarVista Entertainment with Brightlight Pictures. Malachi Barton, Christian J. Simon and Sophia Hammons return as the young friends Marshall, Gilbert and Amy, with Phil Wright as Harold the mummy, Rryla McIntosh as Rose, Melanie Brook as Buzzy, T.J. Storm as the villain Sobek, Jordan Conley as Larry, and Claude Knowlton and Antonio Cayonne as Amy's father Pop and his fiancé Carl. Adam Wylie, who played Gilbert in the original 1997 film, makes a cameo.

A year after reuniting Harold with his beloved, the kids head with their friend Buzzy to the town of Rockport, where Amy's father is about to marry Carl in a "Spooktacular" Halloween-themed wedding. Meanwhile, a museum worker accidentally revives Sobek, an evil mummy who was once Harold's best friend until both fell for Rose and she chose Harold. Using an amulet's power, Sobek seeks revenge. The friends bring Harold and Rose back to life with sunlight on their amulets and smuggle them out of the museum, leaving replicas in their sarcophagi. Marshall, meanwhile, feels left out as Gilbert and Amy spend more time together making videos. Sobek, with a hypnotized museum worker and a stolen scepter, tracks the mummies to a Halloween carnival, takes the wedding rings and then wrecks the reception, kidnapping Rose. After the friends confront their hurt feelings and Amy's fathers assure her that they do not need a perfect wedding, the kids track Sobek to a warehouse exhibit. They revive Rose, crush his army of reanimated mummies with a giant moon prop and deflect the scepter's blast with shields, destroying Sobek's power and freeing his henchman, Larry, who returns the rings. The wedding goes ahead, and the mummies are returned to their resting place.

Filming took place at Bridge Studios from January to March 2022. The film premiered on Disney Channel on 25 September 2022 and on Disney+ five days later. Common Sense Media gave it four out of five stars for its humor and positive messages about friendship, and it received a CAFTCAD costume design nomination.
