title: Surviving Paradise: A Family Tale
overview: As the Kalahari Desert faces a worsening dry season, prides, packs and herds of all kinds must rely on the power of family to survive.
plot:
Surviving Paradise: A Family Tale is a 2022 British nature documentary film made for Netflix. Directed by Renée Godfrey with Matt Meech and produced by Wild Space Productions with Freeborne Media, it is narrated by the actor Regé-Jean Page. Following a year in the life of the animals of Botswana's Okavango Delta, an oasis in the Kalahari Desert, it explores how the bonds within prides, packs and herds allow their members to survive a worsening dry season. The film was released on Netflix on 3 March 2022 and runs 78 minutes.

The documentary follows three main families. A lioness and her sisters are threatened when two young males challenge their ageing king; the usurpers destroy the harmony of the pride and cast her out, and, alone, she must hunt for herself and, after being made pregnant by a passing male, raise her cubs on her own. The alpha female of a pack of 24 painted wolves has trained her hunters to think and act as one, and the pack returns meat to its den to feed a litter of 14 pups. A six-month-old elephant calf experiences every challenge of Kalahari life for the first time within her herd, guided by a matriarch who remembers vital water sources. As drought grips the region, these animals and great numbers of wildebeest, giraffes, zebras, hippos and buffalo converge on the delta. When floodwaters from rain that fell months earlier in the Angolan Highlands finally arrive, the landscape becomes a lush wetland, a boon for grazers but a hardship for the hunters, as the water-adapted lechwe easily escape the wolves. By September the water is receding, and by October the delta is a scorching dust bowl where the balance of power shifts back to the predators, lightning ignites fires and swarms of locusts emerge, until the elephants, able to detect distant thunder, sense the coming of the rains.

Reviews were positive. Johnny Loftus of Decider recommended streaming it, praising the way it linked the experiences of the young animals to the wisdom of their elders, its visceral predation scenes, such as the lioness bringing down a wildebeest alone, and its excellent camerawork and drone photography. Aaron Phillips of But Why Tho? gave it 9 out of 10, calling it wholesome and enthralling, and singling out Page's soft-spoken, eloquent narration, the score and the cinematography, which he felt shaped the footage into an evocative story.

title: Christmas with You
overview: Feeling career burnout, pop star Angelina escapes to grant a young fan's wish in small-town New York, where she not only finds the inspiration to revitalize her career but also a shot at true love.
plot:
Christmas with You is a 2022 American Christmas romantic comedy directed by Gabriela Tagliavini and written by Paco Farias, Jennifer C. Stetson and Michael Varrati. It stars Aimee Garcia as Angelina Costa, a pop star, and Freddie Prinze Jr. as Miguel, a high school music teacher and single father, with Deja Monique Cruz as his daughter Cristina, Zenzi Williams as Angelina's manager Monique, Gabriel Sloyer as Ricardo, Socorro Santiago as Cristina's grandmother Frida and Lawrence J. Hughes as Barry. It was released on Netflix.

Angelina, a Latina singer-songwriter who has been famous since her teens, feels pressure from her record label to stay relevant against younger stars, and her executive Barry expects a new Christmas song in time for a gala. Overwhelmed and suffering a panic attack, she takes her manager on an impromptu road trip to a small town in upstate New York to meet Cristina Torres, a teenage fan whose Christmas wish is to meet her after posting a cover online.

When a snowstorm hits, Angelina and Monique are invited to stay with the Torres family. Angelina discovers that she and Cristina have both lost their mothers recently, and she finds a song that Miguel has been writing on the piano. The two begin to collaborate, and while working on the tune, Angelina helps the teens with the choreography for her quinceañera, bonds with the family over home cooking and visits the Christmas lights with Miguel, who helps her find the missing lyrics. Their growing connection is interrupted by the arrival of Ricardo, a soap opera star she has been dating, who takes her back to New York for the gala. Torn between her image and her feelings, Angelina must decide what truly matters to her before the holidays end.

The film is a warm holiday story about family, grief, creativity and rediscovering one's passion, with Latino family traditions such as the quinceañera at its heart.

Christmas with You premiered on Netflix on November 17, 2022. It received mixed reviews, with 67 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes. The Los Angeles Times found the stars likable enough to make it satisfying, while IndieWire gave it a D grade, quipping that not even Santa Claus could save it.

title: A Man Called Otto
tagline: Fall in love with the grumpiest man in America.
overview: The story of Otto Anderson, a grumpy widower who is very set in his ways. When a lively young family moves in next door, he meets his match in quick-witted and very pregnant Marisol, leading to an unlikely friendship that will turn his world upside-down.
plot:
A Man Called Otto is a 2022 American comedy-drama directed by Marc Forster from a screenplay by David Magee. A remake of the 2015 Swedish film A Man Called Ove, itself based on Fredrik Backman's 2012 novel, it stars Tom Hanks as Otto Anderson, with his son Truman Hanks playing the character as a young man, alongside Mariana Treviño, Rachel Keller and Manuel Garcia-Rulfo. Sony Pictures released it in limited theaters on 29 December 2022 and nationwide in the United States on 13 January 2023.

Otto Anderson is a sixty-three-year-old widower living in a townhouse community in suburban Pittsburgh. Six months after the death of his wife, Sonya, a schoolteacher, he has become a grumpy, rule-obsessed recluse who patrols the neighborhood scolding residents for every infraction. Forced into retirement from his job at a steel company, he cancels his utilities and prepares to take his own life so he can be with Sonya. His attempt is interrupted by the arrival of new neighbors across the street: Marisol, who is pregnant, her husband Tommy and their two young daughters, who insist on befriending him.

Otto's repeated attempts to end his life are thwarted by mishaps and by the needs of the people around him. Visiting Sonya's grave, he remembers how, as a young man rejected by the army because of a heart condition, he met her on a train platform when she dropped a book, and how their romance began. He helps his neighbor Anita with her radiators, although he holds a long grudge against her husband Reuben, once his close friend, now incapacitated after a stroke. When Tommy is injured falling from a ladder, Otto reluctantly drives Marisol and the girls to the hospital and begins teaching her to drive. Gradually, his friendship with Marisol's warm, persistent family, a stray cat and a young transgender man who was once Sonya's student draws Otto out of his isolation. He also takes on a real-estate company scheming to force Anita and Reuben from their home, and comes to terms with the painful events that shaped his marriage.

The film received generally positive reviews, with critics praising Hanks's and Treviño's performances despite finding the story sentimental and predictable. It grossed over $113 million worldwide, and its original song "Til You're Home," performed by Rita Wilson and Sebastián Yatra, featured on the soundtrack.

title: The Killer
tagline: The killer instinct that started again for peace!
overview: A retired hitman whose wife goes on a trip with her friend, and asks him to look after the friend's teenage daughter. Things go awry when he is forced to use a little violence to protect the girl from juvenile delinquents, but then they are found dead and the girl is kidnapped.
plot:
The Killer, also known as The Killer: A Girl Who Deserves to Die, is a 2022 South Korean action thriller directed by Choi Jae-hoon. It is adapted from Bang Jin-ho's popular novel The Kid Deserves to Die. Jang Hyuk stars as Bang Ui-gang, a retired professional killer, with Lee Seo-young as Kim Yoon-ji, Bruce Khan as Yuri, Lee Seung-joon as Detective Lee Young-ho and Lee Chae-young as Hyeon-soo.

When Ui-gang's wife Hyeon-soo goes on holiday to Jeju with her best friend, she asks him to look after the friend's 17-year-old daughter, Yoon-ji, and he reluctantly agrees. Yoon-ji soon slips away with a group of delinquents led by a girl named Sung-yeon. Using a tracking device he hid in her wallet, Ui-gang finds them threatening her, beats them up and takes her home. The next night, a murder is discovered at the spot where the fight took place, and Detective Lee begins to suspect Ui-gang. Sung-yeon has kept the knife used in the killing, which bears Ui-gang's fingerprints. He tracks her down through the wallet and recovers the knife after fighting Yuri, a former Spetsnaz soldier, only to find on his return that Yoon-ji has been kidnapped.

Ui-gang uncovers a trafficking ring tied to the Russian mafia, saves the girl and discovers that Detective Lee is a corrupt officer working for the organization. A gangster named Park Hyung-joo reveals that a powerful judge ordered Yoon-ji and that the operation answers to a figure known as Pig Mama. Through Lee, Ui-gang learns that Yoon-ji's mother is really her stepmother. At the judge's mansion, Lee betrays him and hands him over to Judge Kim, who is next in line to become Chief Justice of the Supreme Court. Ui-gang breaks free, kills Lee, Yuri and the guards, and finally Judge Kim after learning that Pig Mama is Yoon-ji's stepmother, who is in Jeju with his wife. He travels to the island and kills her. On a Jeju beach, it is revealed that the suicidal teenage girl from his flashbacks was Hyeon-soo.

Principal photography ran from June to October 2021. The film had its world premiere at the 24th Udine Far East Film Festival in April 2022 and was pre-sold to 48 countries and territories. After a red carpet premiere at the Regency Village Theatre in Los Angeles, it opened simultaneously in South Korea and North America on July 13, 2022. It later screened at the New York Asian and Fantasia festivals and reached Japan in May 2023. Son Hyun-joo and Cha Tae-hyun appear in cameos.

title: Teasing Master Takagi-san: The Movie
original_title: 劇場版 からかい上手の高木さん
overview: Takagi and Nishikata are in their final year of middle school, and have both anxiety and hope for the future. During the summer of their final year, on the day before summer vacation starts, the two find a kitten that they name Hana. They decide to take care of the kitten themselves until they can find its mother.
plot:
Teasing Master Takagi-san: The Movie (Japanese: 劇場版 からかい上手の高木さん) is a 2022 Japanese animated romantic comedy film based on Sōichirō Yamamoto's manga Teasing Master Takagi-san and its spin-off Tomorrow Is Saturday, and a sequel to the 2018–2022 anime television series. Produced by Shin-Ei Animation and distributed by Toho Visual Entertainment, it was directed by Hiroaki Akagi from an original story by Hiroko Fukuda, co-written with Aki Itami and Kanichi Katō. Its voice cast includes Rie Takahashi and Yuki Kaji. The film follows Takagi and Nishikata through the last summer of their third year of junior high school on their island.

On a rainy day Nishikata frets over his forgotten umbrella, and Takagi teases him with a doodle, then beats him at a game of guriko by teasing him about what she would ask if he lost. As graduation approaches, classmates photograph their daily school life, and in swimming class Nishikata loses a breath-holding contest after misunderstanding something Takagi says. Takagi hears a rumor that seeing fireflies grants a wish, and when Nishikata stands in for a classmate at the island's mushi okuri ritual, he invites her along, but they find none. Meanwhile, their friends Mina and Yukari learn that Sanae hopes to attend high school in the city, and Mina draws up a list of a hundred things for the trio to do over the vacation.

Takagi and Nishikata discover an abandoned kitten at a shrine, buy food for it at a pet shop, and name it Hana after watching it play with flowers. Throughout the summer they care for it, and Takagi decides to adopt it, but when they return with a flower-patterned collar, a family is taking the kitten away. Nishikata comforts her and promises to make her happy forever. At a summer festival, Mina and Yukari learn with relief that Sanae will stay on the island for high school, and as fireworks light the sky, Takagi makes the same promise to Nishikata. A post-credits scene shows the adult couple and their daughter, Chi, finally finding fireflies at mushi okuri.

Teased in 2021 and confirmed alongside the series' third season, the film was released in Japan on June 10, 2022, and premiered in the United States at Anime Expo in July. It grossed ¥410 million in Japan, debuting sixth, and topped Filmarks' first-day satisfaction ranking; one reviewer found the kitten subplot unoriginal but gave the film five stars.

title: Bull Shark
tagline: Everything is Bigger in T E X A S !
overview: A hungry shark begins feeding on some unsuspecting lake goers in a small Texas town.
plot:
Bull Shark, also known as Blood in the Water, is a 2022 American horror thriller film written and directed by Brett Bentman and produced by B22 Films, with distribution by ITN Distribution. It stars Thom Hallum as the game warden Spencer Timms, Billy Blair as Nolan, Lindsey Marie Wilson as Spencer's estranged wife Dottie and Derrick Redford as Sheriff Wilson, with Richard Ray as Mayor Groves, Colin Heintz as Spencer's son Grant, Tiffany McDonald as the coroner, Michael Dooley, Michelle Holland, Joe Bunner, Colleen Elizabeth Miller and Mallory Hargrove. The film runs 80 minutes.

In a small Texas lake town, Spencer Timms is a hard-drinking game warden whose alcoholism has cost him his family; he wakes up hours late, fills a thermos with coffee and vodka and heads to work. His dim friend Nolan shows him a shark he has caught and plans to sell for its teeth, and Spencer tells him to get rid of it so that no one thinks there are sharks in the lake. Too lazy to dispose of it properly, Nolan dumps it in the water, but the bull shark, a species able to live in both salt and fresh water, is not dead, and it soon devours a young woman swimming in the lake. When her remains are found with a shark's tooth lodged in her back, the sheriff and the mayor, facing an election year and fearful for the summer tourist season, want the matter settled quickly and quietly, and the mayor's office pressures the coroner over her report. While the shark claims more victims, Spencer struggles with his drinking, his wife serves him with divorce papers and his teenage son comes to stay. After the sheriff is killed by the shark and Grant is attacked in the water, Spencer and Dottie, with C-4 explosives supplied by Nolan, take a boat onto the lake to destroy the animal, though a final shot reveals another shark in the water.

ITN released the film free with advertisements on Tubi and YouTube, as well as on DVD and other streaming platforms. Reviews were mixed. Jim Morazzini of Voices from the Balcony and Nerdly gave it 3 out of 5, describing it as Jaws relocated to a Texas lake with added domestic drama and comic relief, and finding it entertaining despite few attacks and variable computer-generated effects. Jim McLennan of Film Blitz enjoyed its laid-back tone, which he likened to Lake Placid, but called the climax embarrassingly flat, while Jamie Tingle of The Daily Jaws considered it so bad it was good.

title: Blue's Big City Adventure
tagline: All They Need is You.
overview: When Josh gets the opportunity of a lifetime to audition for Rainbow Puppy’s Broadway musical, Josh and Blue skidoo to NYC for the very first time where they meet new friends and discover the magic of music, dance, and following one’s dreams.
plot:
Blue's Big City Adventure, previously titled Blue's Broadway Dreams, is a 2022 American live-action and animated musical comedy directed by Matt Stawski. The second film in the Blue's Clues series and a stand-alone sequel to Blue's Big Musical Movie (2000), it is based on the Nick Jr. series Blue's Clues and its revival Blue's Clues & You!. Traci Paige Johnson voices the puppy Blue, with Josh Dela Cruz as host Josh, and original hosts Steve Burns and Donovan Patton returning as Steve and Joe. Broadway performer Ali Stroker and singer Taboo appear as themselves. It was released on Paramount+ on 18 November 2022.

Josh has dreamed of singing in a Broadway musical since he was a child. One day he receives a letter from Rainbow Puppy, a friend of Periwinkle, inviting him to come to New York City that very day to audition for her new Broadway show, Happiness Is Magic. Excited but nervous, Josh is encouraged by his friends at the Blue's Clues house, and Mr. Salt writes the theater's address in Josh's Handy Dandy Notebook. Josh and Blue set off for the city aboard the Skidoo Express.

Arriving in New York, Josh realizes that his notebook is missing, and without it he has no idea where the audition is taking place. Blue suggests they play Blue's Clues, with the audience's help, to find the theater. Along the way they meet Ali Stroker, who teaches them that practice makes a big challenge feel less overwhelming, and Taboo, who shows them how music can build confidence. They find all three clues, a piano, rainbow curtains and a stage, and deduce that they must find a theater containing all three. Back at the Blue's Clues house, their friends discover the forgotten notebook and set out to help. As Josh and Blue explore the city's neighborhoods and street art, Steve and Joe, the show's previous hosts, reappear to offer support, and Josh must overcome his stage fright in time to audition, in a grand musical finale celebrating friendship and following one's dreams.

Blue's Big City Adventure received positive reviews, with an 83 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on six reviews. Marco Vito Oddo of Collider gave it a "B," describing it as a movie aimed at preschoolers that adults can also enjoy, with exciting musical numbers and a tribute to New York's street art. Critics particularly appreciated the reunion of the franchise's three hosts.

title: The Wonderful Winter of Mickey Mouse
original_title: The Wonderful Winter of Mickey Mouse
overview: The wonder of the winter season takes Mickey Mouse and his friends on a journey through three magical stories.
plot:
The Wonderful Winter of Mickey Mouse is a 2022 American animated television special produced by Disney Television Animation for the streaming service Disney+. The first of four seasonal specials forming the second season of The Wonderful World of Mickey Mouse, it gathers three new shorts into a 24-minute package linked by a snow globe narration. The segments were directed and written by Ryan Gillis, William Reiss and Eddie Trigueros, with writers including Paul Rudish, Kristen Morrison, Stevie Borbolla, Darrick Bachman and Ricky Roxburgh. The voice cast includes Chris Diamantopoulos as Mickey Mouse, Kaitlyn Robrock as Minnie Mouse, Bill Farmer as Goofy and Tony Anselmo as Donald Duck, with Craig Robinson as the snowflake factory boss and Antonia Thomas as the narrator. The special premiered on Disney+ on 18 February 2022.

In the first story, set in a snowflake factory above the clouds designed in a style recalling Mary Blair's art for It's a Small World, Mickey works as a janitor who dreams of becoming a snow maker. Left alone with a giant jar of snowflake juice, he tries to make a snowflake himself, but the jar breaks and creates a huge, dangerous ice ball that crashes through the floor towards a town below. Using his janitorial skills to break it apart, Mickey produces the best snowfall his boss has ever seen and is promoted. In the second, Mickey, Donald and Goofy arrive for a ski holiday at Mineral King, a resort Walt Disney had planned to build, only to find their cabin rundown and then buried by a snowdrift. Goofy becomes claustrophobic and delirious, mistaking a group of woodland animals for a fur coat, until the cabin breaks loose and skis down the mountain pursued by a living avalanche. In the third, Mickey and Minnie try to perform an ice dancing show for their fans but are repeatedly thwarted by an ice-fishing Goofy, a hockey team and a Zamboni, until Minnie encourages a discouraged Mickey to carry on.

Jeremy Brown of What's On Disney Plus gave the special five stars out of five, naming the cabin and avalanche short his favourite, with Goofy at his funniest, and welcoming the decision to group the shorts into longer seasonal episodes. Alex Reif of Laughing Place highlighted the many Easter eggs for longtime Disney fans, including nods to Country Bear Jamboree, Fun and Fancy Free and Runaway Brain.

title: Paradise Highway
overview: A truck driver has been forced to smuggle illicit cargo to save her brother from a deadly prison gang. With FBI operatives hot on her trail, Sally's conscience is challenged when the final package turns out to be a teenage girl.
plot:
Paradise Highway is a 2022 thriller written and directed by Anna Gutto in her feature debut, starring Juliette Binoche, Frank Grillo and Morgan Freeman, with Hala Finley and Cameron Monaghan in supporting roles. An international co-production between the United States, Germany and Switzerland, it was produced by Grindstone Entertainment Group and Silver Reel and released in the United States by Lionsgate on July 29, 2022.

Sally is a hardened long-haul truck driver who works the highways of the American South. Her brother Dennis, played by Grillo, is in prison and in danger from the criminal gang he once worked for, which has threatened his life unless Sally does them a favor. To save him, she reluctantly agrees to transport a final shipment of illicit cargo. To her horror, the cargo turns out to be Leila, a young girl being trafficked by the gang. Sally, who has always kept to herself, sets out on a perilous journey across state lines with the frightened child in her truck.

As the miles pass, the initially wary Sally and the guarded, resilient Leila gradually form a bond, and Sally begins to question whether she can bring herself to hand the girl over. Meanwhile, a seasoned FBI analyst, Gerick, played by Freeman, and his young, by-the-book partner, played by Monaghan, pick up their trail. Gerick is determined to dismantle the human trafficking operation and to bring Sally and Leila to safety before the gang catches up with them. As the traffickers grow increasingly impatient and violent, Sally is forced to choose between her loyalty to her brother and her conscience, and the pursuit converges toward a dangerous confrontation on the open road.

The lead cast was confirmed in July 2021, and filming took place that month in Mississippi, including in Jackson, Clarksdale and Brookhaven. Lionsgate acquired North American distribution rights in October 2021 and released the film in theaters and on demand, and it also screened at the Locarno Festival in August 2022. It earned about $222,000 at the box office outside North America. Critical response was largely negative, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting that only 14% of 21 critics' reviews were positive. Variety's Joe Leydon was more appreciative, calling it a shrewdly constructed melodrama that shows how effective conventions can be, while RogerEbert.com described it as tonally muddled, and The New York Times found that its focus on supporting the victim left little narrative tension.

title: Stalked by a Prince
overview: Publicist Alyssa Banks thinks she’s woken up in a fairy tale when she meets Jack, a British Prince. At first, everything seems to be going great–Jack wines and dines Alyssa, taking her to extravagant meals, on romantic helicopter rides over Los Angeles, and whisking her away to Europe on a private jet. But Alyssa’s dream quickly turns into a nightmare when the volatile Prince refuses to let Alyssa leave his family’s luxurious estate in the English countryside. As Alyssa desperately tries to escape, she soon finds a way to turn the tables on her not-so-perfect Prince.
plot:
Stalked by a Prince is a 2022 American-Canadian psychological thriller made for television, directed by Max McGuire from a script by John F. Hayes and Shawn Riopelle and produced by Johnson Production Group and Fireside Pictures, with Timothy O. Johnson and Andrew C. Erin among the executive producers. It premiered on Lifetime on 27 February 2022. Natalie Hall stars as Alyssa Banks, with Jonathan Keltz as Prince Jack, Michael Swatton as his bodyguard Taffer, Konstantina Mantelos as Alyssa's colleague Rachel, Alexander Crowther as Jack's brother Timothy, Mélanie St-Pierre as Timothy's wife Susan and Roderick McNeil as Chuck.

Alyssa, a publicist still recovering from a painful breakup, is sent with Rachel to a promotional event for a vodka brand, where she meets Jack, a British prince sixth in line to the throne, who quickly falls for her. He sweeps her off her feet with lavish dinners and romantic helicopter rides over Los Angeles, and despite some doubts she agrees to fly with him on his private jet to his family's country estate in England, accompanied by his bodyguard Taffer, who tries to subtly warn her. What Alyssa does not know is that Jack is a dangerous psychopath who refuses to take the medication that keeps his violent urges in check; he has already killed other young women lured to the estate, and murdered Chuck, a lawyer who was courting Alyssa, staging it as an accident. He monitors her every move with cameras and listening devices. When Alyssa reads of Chuck's death and discovers a woman's body hidden in an abandoned stable, she realizes she is trapped. Jack's older brother Timothy, believing Jack has reformed, arrives with Susan and their young children. Alyssa's secret plea for help is intercepted, but she manages to broadcast a livestream on Susan's social media account in which Jack confesses to brutal crimes. Jack stabs Taffer, who urged him to surrender, kills his brother and pursues Alyssa into the woods, but he is shot dead by the wounded Taffer, who dies soon after. Back home, Rachel suggests that Alyssa turn her unwanted fame to their company's advantage.

The film is one of Lifetime's thrillers built around a fairy-tale romance that turns into a nightmare. Reviews were unfavorable: the Italian site Movieplayer.it gave it one and a half stars out of five, criticizing a predictable, contrived screenplay and a lack of tension or surprises.

title: Without Saying Goodbye
original_title: Hasta que nos volvamos a encontrar
overview: The opposite lives of a workaholic architect and a fiery artist are upended when their chance encounter in breathtaking Peru shifts their views on life.
plot:
Without Saying Goodbye (Spanish: Hasta que nos volvamos a encontrar, literally "Until We Meet Again") is a 2022 Peruvian-Spanish romantic comedy film written and directed by Bruno Ascenzo and produced by Tondero. It stars Stephanie Cayo and Maxi Iglesias. It was the first Peruvian film made for Netflix, which released it worldwide on 18 March 2022. The title refers to a line in which Cayo's character explains that Spanish "adiós" has no direct equivalent in Quechua.

Salvador Campodónico (Iglesias), a workaholic Spanish architect whose family owns Spain's leading hotel company, travels to Cusco to lead his first international project, a luxury hotel, although his father Alberto (Vicente Vergara) doubts he is ready for such a responsibility. He wanders into the lively hostel next door, run by Lichi (Wendy Ramos), and meets her niece Ariana (Cayo), a free-spirited, fiery artist who lives a life opposite to his. The morning after they spend the night together, Ariana learns that he intends to build the hotel on land that includes her aunt's hostel, and she is furious. To understand her world, Salvador persuades her to guide him through the region, and the trip through Inca sites and landscapes brings them closer. On the bus back, a violent storm triggers a panic attack in Ariana, and Lichi tells Salvador that Ariana was the sole survivor of a car accident that killed her parents when she was thirteen. Pressed by his father and his board to close the deal and persuade Lichi to sell, Salvador hesitates to commit, and Ariana leaves without telling anyone where she is going. Salvador sets out to find Ariana, tells her he has left the company to take a year off and that the project will not go ahead, and the two reunite.

Conceived by Ascenzo around 2013 as a travel film, the project was announced in February 2020 when Netflix's Reed Hastings visited Lima. Delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic, it was shot from March to May 2021 under the working title Mochileros in Cusco, Puno and Paracas. It topped Netflix's charts in Peru and reached second place among the platform's most-watched non-English films in its first full week. Reviews were mixed: critics praised its landscapes and photography but found the script, characters and humour thin, with several likening it to a tourism advertisement and others criticising the lack of indigenous representation.

title: The Takeover
overview: Self-proclaimed ethical hacker Mel Bandison's life is turned upside down when she stops a data breach on a high-tech self-driving bus that also happens to shut down an international criminal network. She then becomes a target and is framed with a deepfake video that “shows” that she murders someone.
plot:
The Takeover is a 2022 Dutch action thriller directed by Annemarie van de Mond and produced by Fiction Valley for Netflix, billed as the streamer's first original action film set in the Netherlands. Holly Mae Brood stars as the ethical hacker Mel Bandison, with Géza Weisz as Thomas, Frank Lammers as the hacker Buddy Benschot, and Susan Radder, Noortje Herlaar, Walid Benmbarek and Lawrence Sheldon in supporting roles.

Mel, a talented 26-year-old IT security expert in Rotterdam, is auditing the software that controls the country's first self-driving bus for the transport company Rotramax. The system processes images of passengers' faces to allow secure payment, and Mel discovers that this biometric data is secretly being sent to outside recipients. To stop the leak, she plants her own Trojan, unknowingly making herself the target of an international criminal network. Two armed men break into her apartment and chase her; when she escapes to a police station, she sees them chatting amiably with officers and flees again. She is helped by Thomas, the man she met the night before on a failed blind date. Soon a video appears on television apparently showing Mel shooting a man, and she becomes a fugitive. A man named Rogers offers to make her "video problem" disappear if she decrypts the Trojan, threatening Thomas as well. To prove that the footage is a deepfake, Mel turns to the eccentric Buddy, a former partner she once reported for keeping money they had seized from criminals. Their search leads to a facial-recognition company working with Rotramax that steals personal data, and Mel realizes the fake video was built from data captured when she boarded the bus. After Rogers's men kill Buddy, Mel breaks into the Rotramax server room, where a shootout cuts the link to the driverless bus on its maiden trip with fifteen passengers aboard. With Thomas's help on board, she stops the bus before it plunges toward an opened bridge, clears her name and inherits a digital network Buddy built.

Filming lasted two months, partly in Rotterdam, where the Erasmus Bridge was closed to traffic for night shoots. Released on Netflix on 1 November 2022, the film drew largely negative reviews, with critics citing clichéd plotting, flat dialogue and limited budget in the final action scenes, though some praised Brood. It nonetheless became an international hit, ranking second among Netflix's non-English films worldwide in its first week with more than 25 million hours viewed.

title: Titanic 666
tagline: Welcome on board.
overview: After a mammoth cruise ship sails over the site of the Titanic’s disaster, dark and deadly events start to occur on board. As the ship’s captain investigates the tragic occurrences, it becomes clear that the passengers and crew from the original Titanic have returned.
plot:
Titanic 666, also released as Titanic Rises and Titanic 3, is an American supernatural horror film of 2022 directed by Nick Lyon and produced by The Asylum as a sequel to its Titanic II (2010). Keesha Sharp stars as Captain Celeste Rhoades and Jamie Bamber as Professor Hal Cochran, with Lydia Hearst as the stowaway Idina Bess, AnnaLynne McCord and Derek Yates as the influencers Mia and Jackson Stone, Joseph Gatt as crewman Brian Andrews, Giovannie Pico as Nancy and Jhey Castles as Julie.

The film opens on the night of 15 April 1912, as a woman searches desperately for her husband on the sinking Titanic. She escapes in a lifeboat after its ropes mysteriously give way and kill several passengers, but watches her husband drown, and his ghost later drags her into the sea. Exactly 110 years later, the luxury liner Titanic III sets out on the original route. On board are the married influencers Mia and Jackson Stone with their fan Nancy, while Captain Rhoades warns her crew to avoid the fates of the earlier ships. Idina, hiding below decks, steals an artifact from Hal's collection of belongings recovered from Titanic victims, and the influencers clash with Hal as they dig into the voyage's history.

In the hold, Idina performs a satanic ritual to resurrect her great-grandfather, Captain Edward Smith, whose spirit summons the souls of those who died in 1912. During an evening commemoration the ghostly orchestra attacks; Jackson vanishes and Mia is killed. The ghosts slaughter the engineers and seize the ship, and when Rhoades and Brian try to shut down the engines, the turbines explode and the controls fail. Idina kills Brian and escapes, then, possessed by Smith, takes the bridge and kills herself as the liner strikes an iceberg. Rhoades orders the survivors into lifeboats, but once more the ropes loosen, killing nearly everyone aboard. Adrift as the ship sinks, Hal blames himself for the disaster and dies of hypothermia, and when Rhoades tries to revive him, his ghost turns on her.

The film premiered on Tubi in the United States on 15 April 2022, the 110th anniversary of the sinking. Reviews were largely negative: Matt Donato of Paste rated it 4 out of 10, likening Tubi to late-night SyFy, and Josh Bell of Crooked Marquee gave it a C-minus, finding it a slow, dull haunted-ship story. Social media users noted its resemblance to both Titanic (1997) and Studio 666.

title: A Man of Action
overview: Loosely inspired by the life of Lucio Urtubia, explore the figure of the so-called anarchist 'Robin Hood,' who ran a legendary counterfeiting operation in Paris that put him in the crosshairs of America's largest bank, when he managed to obtain a huge amount of money by forging traveler's checks to invest in causes he believed in.
plot:
A Man of Action (Spanish: Un hombre de acción) is a 2022 Spanish crime drama directed by Javier Ruiz Caldera from a screenplay by Patxi Amezcua, freely inspired by the life of Lucio Urtubia, the Spanish bricklayer, bank robber and anarchist who became known in Paris for forging traveler's checks in a vast swindle against City Bank. Juan José Ballesta stars as Lucio, with Miki Esparbé as the veteran anarchist Quico Sabaté, Luis Callejo as Asturiano, Liah O'Prey as Lucio's partner Anne, Alexandre Blazy as Inspector Costello, Ben Temple as Barrow and Ana Polvorosa as Satur. The story spans the 1940s to the 1980s and was shot in Vigo, Catalonia and France.

The film begins with Lucio's impoverished upbringing in Spain and the roots of his hatred for the system and the banks. After his father's death he settles in Paris, where he works as a bricklayer and is drawn into the city's anarchist circles. There he meets the charismatic Sabaté, who teaches him the tricks of the trade and warns him never to trust a stranger. Lucio begins robbing banks alongside Sabaté, handing part of every haul to the movement, until the police close in and the two go their separate ways.

With Asturiano, Patrick and Petite Jeanne, Lucio forms his own small group devoted to "expropriating" from banks, now by passing counterfeit dollars, and finds a partner in Anne, a clever and rebellious woman. A spell in prison follows, during which he protects a fellow inmate, and after his release he steps back from militancy to devote himself to Anne and their daughter. Years later, the spread of traveler's checks gives him an idea for his most ambitious operation. With his comrades and other anarchists, he forges checks on a huge scale to fund revolutionary causes, gaining notoriety and drawing the attention of the bank, which sends its own man to Paris. On the eve of a final mass cash-in, Lucio and his associates are arrested. The others are released on bail, but Lucio remains in custody until he negotiates a deal with the bank, which sees the charges dropped and brings substantial funds to the movement, and he is reunited with his family.

Netflix released the film on 30 November 2022. Reviewers found it fast-paced and entertaining, praising Ballesta's engaging lead performance and the period recreation of Paris, while noting that its brisk structure left the supporting characters underdeveloped.

title: The Marriage App
overview: Tangled in a troubled marriage, a frustrated couple finds hope in a watch-based app that rewards good deeds — until unhealthy obsessiveness takes over.
plot:
The Marriage App (Spanish: Matrimillas) is a 2022 Argentine romantic comedy directed by Sebastián De Caro from a screenplay by Gabriel Korenfeld and Rocío Blanco, and produced by Buffalo Films for Netflix. Luisana Lopilato and Juan Minujín star as the married couple Belén and Federico, with Cristina Castaño as Milán, Andrea Rincón as Juana, Betiana Blum as Alicia, Carla Pandolfi as Belén's sister Nati, Javier Pedersoli as her husband Germán, and Aylén Malisani and Vicente Archain as the couple's children, Mica and Toto. The title fuses the Spanish words for marriage and miles, alluding to the habit of keeping score in a relationship as if collecting airline points.

Belén and Federico meet by accident, in a car crash at Christmas, and before long they are married with two children. Years later, the romance has given way to routine and recrimination. Federico, a dentist continuing his family's profession, would rather be a chef and lives for his weekly cooking sessions with friends, while Belén runs a shop selling handmade toys and resents carrying the household. Over dinner, Nati and Germán tell them about Equilibrium, a programme that uses a watch-based app to award or deduct miles for the gestures each partner makes toward the other; the miles can then be spent on activities without the spouse. Belén hesitates over the cost, but Federico persuades her.

At first it works wonderfully, but Federico has a hidden motive: he and his friends have qualified for an amateur cooking competition in Cancún, which he has not mentioned to his wife. When Belén overhears that his attentions are all about the trip, she studies the app's rules and sets out to earn enough miles for a holiday in India. A war over points follows, and both resort to cheating; Federico even stages a fake mugging with his friends so he can play the hero. At an Equilibrium gala honouring them as a model couple, Belén recognises the waiter, one of Federico's friends, as her supposed robber, takes off her watch and leaves. During their separation Federico pursues cooking and Belén focuses on her shop, until the two reconcile at Toto's basketball game and the family is reunited.

Netflix released the film on 7 December 2022. La Nación praised the premise and the chemistry between Lopilato and Minujín, though it found the direction visually correct but unimaginative and the happy ending conventional; other critics called it pleasant but predictable.

title: Lost Bullet 2
overview: Having cleared his name, genius mechanic Lino has only one goal in mind: getting revenge on the corrupt cops who killed his brother and his mentor.
plot:
Lost Bullet 2 (French: Balle perdue 2) is a 2022 French action film written and directed by Guillaume Pierret and the sequel to his 2020 Netflix film Lost Bullet. Alban Lenoir returns as Lino, a police officer and expert in modified vehicles, with Stéfi Celma as Julia. Like its predecessor, the film is built around elaborate car chases and practical stunts.

Six months after the death of his mentor Charas, Lino works in the drug squad now led by Julia. He remains obsessed with finding the men who killed Charas and his brother Quentin and spends his nights watching the home of Stella, the wife of the killer Areski, waiting for him to return. His colleagues urge him to move on. When Julia gives him the keys to Charas's wrecked Renault, which has been stored in the police garage, Lino rebuilds the car, painting it blue and fitting it with a powerful battery that electrifies a ram on its front, used to stop vehicles carrying drugs.

A year later, Lino is leading police raids on drug traffickers in his modified vehicles and has struck up a friendship with Alvaro, a Spanish police officer who knew Charas. Lino is now in a relationship with Stella, to Julia's regret. Lured to a remote location by a fake phone call about the health of his foster mother, Lino discovers that his colleagues have secretly been protecting Marco, Areski's henchman and a key witness against drug runners. Instead of taking revenge, Lino decides to deliver Marco to justice in Spain, setting off a long and destructive chase in the Renault involving honest and corrupt police officers, drug traffickers, explosions and border checkpoints, as Lino fights to keep Marco alive.

The film expands the action of the first installment with a larger budget for its car chases and stunt sequences, while continuing Lino's story of loyalty and vengeance.

Lost Bullet 2 was released on Netflix on 10 November 2022. It received positive reviews from the small number of critics counted by Rotten Tomatoes, who praised its slightly better character development and its impressive stuntwork.

title: Into the Deep
tagline: At sea, there are no boundaries.
overview: Follows a woman desperate to escape her town, she meets a stranger who promises a romantic escape, but it results in deceit, mistrust, and violence.
plot:
Into the Deep is a 2022 British-American psychological thriller film directed by Kate Cox from a screenplay and story by David Beton. Produced by Tea Shop & Film Company with Signature Films and Capstone Studios, it stars Ella-Rae Smith, Matthew Daddario and Jessica Alexander as three people trapped together on a boat, with Nikkita Chadha, Jack Morris, Andrew Steele and Michael Workeye in supporting roles. Lionsgate released the film in theatres, on demand and on digital platforms in the United States on 26 August 2022. It is rated R for sexual content and nudity, drug use, violence and language, and runs about 90 minutes.

Jess (Smith) is still haunted by the drowning of her mother a decade earlier, and her memories of near-drownings recur throughout the film. Estranged from her father, whom she resents for starting a new relationship, and desperate to escape her small seaside town, she sets out to party with friends and meets Ben (Daddario), a charming, attractive visitor who promises a romantic escape and who, like her, has lost a parent. After a whirlwind night together, Jess wakes up on Ben's boat to find that he has taken them out to sea. Despite her initial misgivings, she embraces the carefree domestic life he seems to offer. The idyll unravels when a stranger, Lexie (Alexander), crashes her jet ski into the side of the boat and comes aboard. Lexie and Ben accuse each other of vicious lies and dark secrets, and in the cramped, claustrophobic quarters of the boat a dangerous cat-and-mouse game develops, forcing Jess to decide whom to believe as deceit, mistrust and violence escalate and she must fight for her own survival.

Critical reception was negative. Rachel LaBonte of Screen Rant gave the film two out of five stars, finding that it showed moments of promise and created a genuine mystery once Lexie's motives emerged, with the boat setting used to claustrophobic effect and capable performances from the three leads, but that it lacked suspense, asked viewers to forgive implausible behaviour and ended with a twist that strained credulity. Alan French of Sunshine State Cineplex rated it three out of ten, criticising poorly written exchanges, wooden performances and an unsympathetic heroine, and objecting that the film flirted with troubling ideas about guilt and trauma before backtracking on them in the final act.

title: Broken Idol: The Undoing of Diomedes Díaz
original_title: Diomedes: el ídolo, el misterio y la tragedia
overview: This documentary chronicles Diomedes Díaz's rise as one of Colombia's most iconic singers, and his downfall after being accused of killing a fan.
plot:
Broken Idol: The Undoing of Diomedes Díaz (Spanish: Diomedes: el ídolo, el misterio y la tragedia) is a 2022 Colombian biographical documentary film directed by Jaime Barbosa and Jorge Durán for Netflix. Running about 101 minutes, it traces the career of the vallenato singer Diomedes Díaz, known as the King of Vallenato and one of Colombia's best-selling and most beloved performers, and the case surrounding the death of Doris Adriana Niño, a young woman who was his fan. The film combines archival concert footage and interviews Díaz gave during his lifetime with testimony from his family, friends, fans, colleagues, music industry figures, lawyers, investigators and Niño's relatives.

The documentary follows Díaz from a childhood of extreme poverty and his early struggle to make a name for himself in the competitive world of vallenato to his rise as a superstar in the 1980s and 1990s, whose songs drew on his own experiences and filled concerts with huge crowds. It portrays an exuberant, impulsive figure with a famous smile and a diamond set in his tooth, who boasted of fathering dozens of children with many women and whose drinking and drug use grew alongside increasingly chaotic shows. The second half turns to May 1997, when Niño, who had met Díaz at a concert and had a relationship with him, went to his Bogotá apartment and never returned home; her body was found the next morning in a cow pasture near Tunja. The film examines the conflicting accounts of that night, the investigation that connected Díaz and members of his entourage to her death, her brother's efforts to defend her reputation, Díaz's denials, his flight from justice and the trial in which he was convicted of involuntary manslaughter. It leaves viewers to weigh the competing versions for themselves.

The documentary was released on Netflix on 30 March 2022. Romey Norton of Ready Steady Cut considered it a good, intriguing watch, praising its energetic Colombian music, quick cutting and contrasting cinematography, and its wide range of interviewees, including the victim's brother, whose determination she found moving. Pooja Sharma of Leisurebyte called it a gripping and thorough account of an icon whose story had been curiously under-told, presenting it as the sad tale of a man so consumed by fame that he lost sight of everything else. Díaz died of a heart attack in Valledupar at the age of 56, days after releasing his thirtieth album.

title: Sinister Stepsister
overview: Jeff Mitchell seems to have it all. He has an interesting and lucrative job, a loving wife, and two amazing kids. Therefore, life is good. However, on one bright day, a cosmic sucker punch comes out of the blue. When Jeff was in high school, unbeknownst to him, he got his girlfriend pregnant. Next, the girl moved away, had the baby, and raised her as a single mother, never telling her daughter, Carlee, who her real father was. However, Carlee's mother recently died in a tragic accident, prompting Carlee to try and uncover the truth. Maybe Jeff is not so lucky after all?
plot:
Sinister Stepsister is a 2022 American thriller television film directed by John Murlowski from a screenplay by Adam Rockoff. Produced by Maple Island Films and Reel One Entertainment, it stars Annika Foster as a young woman who claims to be a long-lost daughter, with Tu Morrow, Jhey Castles, Matthew Pohlkamp, Johan Gran, Jacob Taylor, Dayne Jarrah and Madison Russ in supporting roles. The film premiered in March 2022 on the Lifetime Movie Network and runs 84 minutes.

Jeff Mitchell (Pohlkamp) appears to have it all: an interesting, well-paid job, a loving wife, Lisa (Castles), and two children, the caring Noah (Jarrah) and the mildly rebellious Ella (Morrow). When his talented colleague Blake (Taylor) is promoted over him to replace their boss, Jeff goes to a bar to consider his next steps. There a young woman, Carlee Byrne (Foster), introduces herself; he mistakes her approach for flirtation, but she asks whether he remembers Jennifer, his high-school girlfriend, and reveals that Jennifer became pregnant by him without his knowledge, moved away and raised her daughter alone, never telling her who her father was. Jennifer's recent death in an accident has prompted Carlee to seek the truth. Stunned, Jeff and Lisa ask her to take a paternity test; when the results appear to confirm that she is his daughter, Jeff welcomes her into the family. Ella, however, does not trust her, and she is right: Carlee is dangerous and willing to kill to secure a perfect family. To protect her secret she fakes lab results, poisons a man and commits murder, and when Ella's boyfriend Ryan (Gran) tries to catch her in a lie, she warns him off with a knife at his throat.

Reviews were mixed. Phil Wheat of Nerdly described the film as another riff on Single White Female that followed a very familiar formula but was too clean-cut and watered down to make an impact; he found Morrow's tenacious, genuine performance as Ella the only real standout, considered Foster's Carlee too two-dimensional to be an intriguing villain and criticised the weak ending, though he suggested fans of home-invasion thrillers might enjoy it. That Darn Girl Movie Reviews gave it three out of five stars, calling it entertaining though predictable, describing Carlee as a worthy foe for Ella and singling out her chilling exchanges with Ryan.

title: Silverton Siege
tagline: Freedom is a fight.
overview: After a failed sabotage mission, a trio of anti-apartheid freedom fighters ends up in a tense bank hostage situation. Based on a true story.
plot:
Silverton Siege is a 2022 South African action thriller directed by Mandla Dube and inspired by the real Silverton bank siege of January 1980 in Pretoria, in which members of uMkhonto we Sizwe, the armed wing of the African National Congress, took hostages in a bank. Thabo Rametsi, Noxolo Dlamini and Stefan Erasmus star as the three freedom fighters, with Arnold Vosloo as the police captain pursuing them and Tumisho Masha. The film was released internationally on Netflix on 27 April 2022.

Calvin Khumalo, Terra Mabunda and Aldo Erasmus are anti-apartheid guerrillas in MK planning to sabotage a fuel depot outside Silverton, a suburb of Pretoria. Their mission is foiled because the security police, led by Captain Langerman, have been tipped off. Forced to abort, they flee toward the city; after Terra's partner Masego is shot and their van disabled, they escape through sewer tunnels and emerge in the heart of Pretoria near Church Square. Spotted by police, they take refuge inside a branch of the Volkskas Bank.

Calvin addresses the frightened customers and staff, explaining that the group is not there to rob the bank and asking for calm cooperation so that no one is hurt. Christine, a bank supervisor, proves helpful and sympathetic. Police surround the building, and when Langerman calls each of the fighters by name over a loudhailer, they become convinced that there is an informant inside their organization. They demand a helicopter with an unarmed black pilot, intending to take a hostage with them, but an attempted escape to the helicopter turns out to be a trap, and everyone returns to the bank. As the standoff grows tense and the world's press gathers outside, the fighters change strategy, using the media attention to demand the release of Nelson Mandela, who was then imprisoned, turning the siege into a political statement against apartheid while the police prepare to storm the building.

The film received mixed to positive reviews, with a 75 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on eight reviews. Critics praised the performances of the three leads, which gave the characters depth and complex motivations, especially during the tense standoff, although some noted that the film fictionalizes important elements of the historical events.

overview: Everyone's favorite yellow canary unexpectedly becomes next in line for the crown when the queen of an island paradise disappears. His Little Highness’ entourage includes motorbike daredevil Granny and sly Sylvester, whose allegiance is tested when he uncovers a sinister plot to eliminate Tweety for good.
plot:
King Tweety is a 2022 American animated direct-to-video comedy produced by Warner Bros. Animation and starring the Looney Tunes characters Tweety and Sylvester, with a voice cast that includes Eric Bauza, Candi Milo, Jon Daly, Niccole Thurman and Flula Borg. It was the first new direct-to-video Looney Tunes feature since Looney Tunes: Rabbits Run in 2015, Tweety's second direct-to-video starring vehicle after Tweety's High-Flying Adventure (2000), and the first Looney Tunes film directed by a woman.

Watching the evening news, Tweety, Sylvester and Granny learn that Aoogah, the bird queen of the Canary Islands, has mysteriously vanished, and that Tweety bears all the marks of a member of the royal bird family. The kingdom invites Tweety and Granny to fly from New York so that Tweety can be crowned, but cats are forbidden there, so Sylvester stows away. When he is discovered, Tweety insists that he be allowed to stay as his "brother". The royal adviser and sorcerer Diego von Schniffenstein gives them a tour of the islands, home to both birds and dogs, and helps prepare Tweety for his lavish coronation.

At the ceremony, Sylvester discovers that Diego was responsible for the queen's disappearance and is now plotting against Tweety. He spends the following day foiling Diego's assassination attempts while hunting for proof, but Tweety inadvertently gets them both caught, and Diego kidnaps the new king and frames Sylvester for eating him. Granny, who has seen the evidence against Diego, breaks Sylvester out of jail, and they use one of Tweety's magical royal tail feathers to track him to a ship offshore. There Tweety finds Aoogah alive. Diego reveals that he made himself immortal seven centuries ago, led a failed uprising of dogs against the birds, and has been secretly killing monarchs to collect their feathers, which he has made into a boa that magnifies his magic.

Sylvester sneaks aboard, defeats the henchdogs and frees the captives, but Diego uses the boa to transform into a giant. When Sylvester distracts him and the birds pull the boa apart, the feathers become the spirits of past rulers, who help defeat the sorcerer. Homesick, Tweety returns the crown to Aoogah, who decides she needs a vacation and joins the trio in New York. Common Sense Media awarded the film three out of five stars.

title: The Aviary
tagline: Believing is deceiving.
overview: A twisted journey of two women’s desperate flee to escape the clutches of Skylight, an insidious cult. Lured in by the promise of “freedom” in the isolated desert campus called The Aviary, Jillian and Blair join forces to escape in hopes of real freedom. Consumed by fear and paranoia, they can’t shake the feeling that they are being followed by the cult’s leader, Seth, a man as seductive as he is controlling. The more distance the pair gains from the cult, the more Seth holds control of their minds. With supplies dwindling and their senses failing, Jillian and Blair are faced with a horrifying question: how do you run from an enemy who lives inside your head?
plot:
The Aviary is a 2022 American psychological thriller written and directed by Chris Cullari and Jennifer Raite. Malin Åkerman and Lorenza Izzo star as two women fleeing a cult, with Chris Messina as its leader and Sandrine Holt. The film was released by Saban Films on 29 April 2022.

Jillian and Blair, two women who have been members of a secretive self-help community, escape from its compound in the middle of the night and set out on foot across the New Mexico desert. They hope to reach a town and a rendezvous point where they believe help will be waiting. The group, which presents itself as a wellness retreat, is controlled by Seth, a charismatic and manipulative leader who has exerted enormous psychological power over his followers, including both women.

As they cross the empty landscape, the two women's supplies of water dwindle, the heat and exhaustion take their toll, and they begin to fear that Seth or his followers are tracking them. The longer they walk, the more Seth seems to be present in their minds, his voice and teachings echoing in their memories. Memories of life inside the group surface as they walk, showing how its leader exploited their vulnerabilities. Tension grows between them as they argue about directions and whom to trust, and doubts arise over whether both of them truly want to leave Seth behind. Strange signs and inexplicable events make them question their perceptions, and the desert becomes a psychological trap as they try to determine whether the danger is real, whether they are truly free, and whether they will ever escape the hold the cult has over them.

The film received mixed reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 63 percent approval rating based on 27 reviews, with a consensus stating that its adroitly assembled cast lends extra weight to an uneven depiction of how dangerous cults can be, and it has a Metacritic score of 57. Critics praised the performances of Åkerman, Izzo and Messina and the film's atmosphere of paranoia, but some felt the story lost momentum and that its ambiguous ending was unsatisfying.

title: The Mystery of Marilyn Monroe: The Unheard Tapes
original_title: The Mystery of Marilyn Monroe: The Unheard Tapes
tagline: The brighter the star, the darker the truth.
overview: This documentary explores the mystery surrounding the death of movie icon Marilyn Monroe through previously unheard interviews with her inner circle.
plot:
The Mystery of Marilyn Monroe: The Unheard Tapes is a 2022 American documentary directed by Emma Cooper for Netflix. It examines the life and early death of actress Marilyn Monroe through archival footage and previously unheard interviews with people who knew her.

The film is built around the research of Anthony Summers, author of the 1985 book Goddess. Summers began investigating after the Los Angeles County District Attorney reopened the inquiry into Monroe's death. Over three years he recorded about 650 interviews with people who knew Monroe or had information about how she died. Actors lip-sync the original audio in reenactments.

It traces Monroe's rise in Hollywood and her affairs with powerful men who helped her career. Jane Russell recalls her work ethic; others describe mental health struggles rooted in her troubled childhood. The film covers her marriage to playwright Arthur Miller, whose left-wing ties brought FBI scrutiny to the couple, and her growing dependence on prescription drugs before their divorce in 1961. It then turns to her relationships with the Kennedy family. Witnesses describe her affairs with John F. Kennedy and Robert F. Kennedy, often at the Malibu beach house of Peter Lawford and his wife Patricia Kennedy Lawford. Summers argues that in the Cold War climate of 1962, the FBI feared that Monroe, given her leftist politics, might repeat what the brothers told her, and the Kennedys tried to cut her off.

The documentary then compares the official account of Monroe's death in August 1962 with the testimony Summers gathered. In the official version, her housekeeper Eunice Murray found the bedroom locked in the early morning, and psychiatrist Ralph Greenson broke in to find her dead, leading to a ruling of probable suicide by overdose. Several interviewees instead describe an emergency that began hours earlier, the arrival of publicist Arthur P. Jacobs and an ambulance ride with Greenson. They say Monroe died at or on the way to the hospital before being returned to her bed. Investigator Fred Otash and surveillance expert Reed Wilson say Lawford hired them to remove evidence of the Kennedy connection. Summers still does not believe Monroe was murdered. He concludes she died by suicide or an accidental overdose and attributes any cover-up to her ties with the Kennedys. A 1982 district attorney review upheld the ruling.

Netflix released the film on April 27, 2022, and it drew about 23 million viewing hours in two weeks.

title: Rainbow
tagline: This is not a movie, it’s a trip!
overview: A modern tale of a teenager’s coming-of-age journey loosely inspired by the classic novel “The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.”
plot:
Rainbow is a 2022 Spanish fantasy drama directed by Paco León and loosely based on L. Frank Baum's 1900 novel The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. The singer Dora Postigo stars as Dora, a teenager with an extraordinary musical gift, with Áyax Pedrosa, Wekaforé Jibril, Carmen Maura, Carmen Machi and Luis Bermejo. León described it as not a musical but a film with a great deal of music. It premiered at the 70th San Sebastián International Film Festival on 18 September 2022, was released in selected Spanish cinemas on 23 September and arrived on Netflix on 30 September.

The film reimagines Baum's story as a contemporary coming-of-age road movie set in Spain. Dora is a gifted young singer living with her father, Diego. After a bitter argument with her father, she decides to leave home, taking her dog Toto with her, and sets out on a journey toward the faraway "Ciudad Capital," hoping that there she will find what she is looking for.

Along the way, Dora meets a series of characters who mirror the companions of Baum's Dorothy, outsiders who are each looking for something they believe they lack and who join her on the road. The journey through a stylized, colorful landscape of highways, villages and strange encounters becomes a search for identity and belonging, as the travelers confront their insecurities, and Dora's music and the people she meets help her understand her past and decide who she wants to be. Rather than retelling the novel faithfully, León uses its familiar structure as a framework for a story about youth, family, diversity and self-acceptance, in which music plays a central role.

Critical reception in Spain was largely negative. Fernando Bernal of Cinemanía gave it one star out of five, writing that the road movie never manages to pick up speed and that its sequences falter in their own rhythm. Elsa Fernández-Santos of El País described a film capable of both the best and the worst, uneven and largely botched, though she acknowledged a beautiful epilogue and the courage to look to the future.

title: Shark Bait
tagline: Terror runs deep.
overview: A group of friends enjoying a weekend steal a couple of jetskis racing them out to sea, ending up in a horrific head-on collision. They struggle to find a way home with a badly injured friend while from the waters below predators lurk.
plot:
Shark Bait, also released under the title Jetski, is a 2022 British survival horror thriller directed by James Nunn from a screenplay by Nick Saltrese, a writer previously known for British television soap operas. Filmed in Malta and sold internationally by Altitude, it stars Holly Earl as Nat, with Jack Trueman as her boyfriend Tom, Catherine Hannay as Milly, Malachi Pullar-Latchman as Tyler and Thomas Flynn as Greg. The film runs 87 minutes.

Five young friends are enjoying their last spring break before graduation at a beach resort in Mexico. After a night of drinking and partying, during which the cautious Nat, the only one who speaks Spanish, ignores a local amputee's warning about what lurks in the water, the group steals two jet skis early in the morning and races them out to sea. A reckless game of chicken ends in a head-on collision: one machine is left capsized and abandoned, Greg suffers a badly broken leg, and the five end up crowded onto a single stalled jet ski drifting farther from shore. Because the craft were taken without permission while nobody was around, no one knows they are missing, and their only slim hope is that someone notices when they fail to board their flight home. Tensions boil over when it emerges that Milly slept with Tom behind Nat's back the night before. Tyler, despite a head injury, tries to swim for help, but a great white shark begins circling, and the predator toys with the survivors one by one as they search for a way to save themselves, leaving Nat to fight for her life in the final stretch.

Shark Bait was released in the United States on 13 May 2022 and on DVD and digital platforms in the United Kingdom on 6 June 2022. Reviews were mixed to negative. Jennie Kermode of Eye for Film was the most positive, praising an opening that pays intelligent tribute to Jaws, convincing shark footage, effective action and a predator presented as an animal with a mind of its own. Blueprint: Review found it handsome and well made, with a standout turn from Earl, but faulted its thin plot, unlikable characters and needless melodrama. In The Guardian, Phil Hoad gave it a scathing review, calling it a depressingly unimaginative thriller that lacks tension compared with Open Water or The Shallows and joking that the shark had more charisma than the cast.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Revenge of Scar
original_title: 鋼の錬金術師 完結編 復讐者スカー
tagline: The promised day is coming soon
overview: The Elric brothers meet their toughest opponent yet — a lone serial killer with a large scar on his forehead.
plot:
Fullmetal Alchemist: The Revenge of Scar (Japanese: Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Kanketsu-hen: Fukushūsha Scar) is a 2022 Japanese fantasy action film directed by Fumihiko Sori, who co-wrote the screenplay with Takeshi Miyamoto. Based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga, it is the sequel to the 2017 live-action Fullmetal Alchemist and the first half of a two-part finale, followed by Fullmetal Alchemist: The Final Alchemy in June 2022. Ryosuke Yamada returns as Edward Elric, with Atomu Mizuishi as Alphonse, Tsubasa Honda as Winry and Dean Fujioka as Roy Mustang, while Mackenyu plays the vengeful Scar. Announced as part of the manga's 20th-anniversary celebrations, it was meant to shoot in Italy like its predecessor, but because of the COVID-19 pandemic open sets were built in Kyonan, Chiba. Warner Bros. Japan released it on 20 May 2022, and it reached Netflix in August.

Travelling by train to Central City, Ed and Al meet Ling Yao (Keisuke Watanabe), a prince from Xing seeking the secret of immortality. When bandits hijack the train, the brothers fight them on the locomotive, are unexpectedly helped by the homunculus Envy, and use alchemy to stop a bomb plot. In Central they learn that a serial killer is murdering State Alchemists. Slipping away from their bodyguards, they meet May Chang, a girl from Xing, and are attacked by Scar, an Ishvalan who badly damages Al's armour and destroys Ed's automail arm before Mustang drives him off. While Ed returns to Resembool for repairs, he encounters his estranged father Van Hohenheim (Seiyo Uchino), and Scar recovers among Ishvalan refugees. Ling proposes an alliance to capture Scar and the homunculi, but the trap collapses: Winry learns that Scar killed her parents, a doctor couple, during the Ishval war and tries to shoot him, King Bradley (Hiroshi Tachi) wounds Ling's bodyguard Lan Fan, and Scar escapes with May. Riza Hawkeye tells Ed about the massacre of Ishval, in which Scar lost his brother. Later, when Al and May find Scar, Winry dresses his wound and he expresses remorse. In a final clash, the homunculus Gluttony swallows Ed, Ling and Envy, and inside his stomach Envy reveals that Gluttony is a failed Gate of Truth created by Father before transforming into a monstrous dragon.

The ensemble also includes Yuina Kuroshima as Lan Fan, Ron Monroe as May, Kokoro Terada as Selim Bradley, Yuki Yamada as Kimblee, Kanata Hongo as Envy and Jun Fubuki as Pinako Rockbell.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Final Alchemy
original_title: 鋼の錬金術師 完結編 最後の錬成
tagline: Hope is Unbreakable
overview: The Elric brothers’ long and winding journey comes to a close in this epic finale, where they must face off against an unworldly, nationwide threat.
plot:
Fullmetal Alchemist: The Final Alchemy (Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Kanketsu-hen: Saigo no Rensei) is a 2022 Japanese live-action fantasy action film directed by Fumihiko Sori, who co-wrote the screenplay with Takeshi Miyamoto, based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga. It is the third film in the live-action series and the second half of a two-part finale following Fullmetal Alchemist: The Revenge of Scar. Produced by Oxybot and distributed by Warner Bros. Japan, it stars Ryosuke Yamada as Edward Elric, with Atomu Mizuishi as his brother Alphonse, Tsubasa Honda as Winry Rockbell, Dean Fujioka as Roy Mustang, Misako Renbutsu as Riza Hawkeye, Kanata Hongo as Envy, Yuina Kuroshima as Lan Fan, Mackenyu as Scar, Hiroshi Tachi as King Bradley, Kokoro Terada as Selim Bradley, Chiaki Kuriyama as Olivier Mira Armstrong, Yukie Nakama as Trisha Elric and Seiyo Uchino as both Van Hohenheim and the villain known as Father.

Edward escapes from inside the homunculus Gluttony and, at the Gate of Truth, finds Alphonse's real body, which refuses to leave without its soul. Mustang and Hawkeye discover that King Bradley is the homunculus Wrath and that the military's generals are complicit, while the brothers learn that Father, a being who resembles Hohenheim, plans to open the Gate using a nationwide transmutation circle drawn by wars the army has orchestrated. Ed travels to the northern fortress of Briggs to seek General Olivier Armstrong's help, and Al finds their father, who reveals his past as a slave whose blood created a homunculus in a flask; that creature sacrificed the people of the ancient kingdom of Xerxes to gain a body and immortality. The heroes, joined by Scar, Ling and his possessed alter ego Greed, descend beneath Central City for a final confrontation. Father absorbs the souls of the country but is thwarted by Hohenheim, and in the ensuing battle Al sacrifices himself to restore his brother's arm. Ed defeats Father, then gives up his own alchemy to bring Al back whole, and the brothers return home to Winry.

The two-part finale was announced in March 2022 as part of the manga's 20th anniversary. Filming was originally planned in Italy, like the first film, but because of the COVID-19 pandemic it took place on an open set built in Kyonan, Chiba Prefecture. The Final Alchemy was released in Japanese theaters on 24 June 2022, five weeks after The Revenge of Scar, and became available worldwide on Netflix on 24 September 2022.

title: The Chalk Line
overview: After a couple finds a traumatized child of unknown origins, wife Paula must decipher the girl's strange behaviors to unlock her identity and dark past.
plot:
The Chalk Line (Spanish: Jaula, meaning "Cage") is a 2022 Spanish mystery psychological thriller film directed by Ignacio Tatay in his feature debut and co-written by Tatay and Isabel Peña. Elena Anaya stars as a woman who takes in a mysterious young girl, with Pablo Molinero and Carlos Santos. It was released theatrically in Spain in September 2022.

Paula and her husband, Simón, live in an exclusive neighborhood of villas outside the city. Driving home one night, they find a little girl wandering alone in the middle of the road and take her to the hospital. She will not speak, and the only clue to her identity is that she responds to the name Clara. When no family can be found, her doctor suggests that a home environment might help, and Paula, who has bonded with the girl, persuades Simón to foster her temporarily. Clara will move only within boundaries chalked on the floor, so the couple draw lines throughout the house for her, and she reacts with terror when one is threatened, crying a strange word, "buma."

When a friend of Paula's swallows a shard of glass during breakfast, Simón suspects Clara put it there, and Clara is taken back to the hospital. Paula discovers that Clara understands German and realizes that "buma" means Buhmann, the bogeyman. Soon after, Paula herself chokes on a piece of glass, and Clara vanishes from the house, though she has never been seen to cross a chalk line. Paula becomes consumed by the search, alienating her friends and husband, who reveals that he knows she has been secretly undergoing fertility treatments. The police suspect her of instability after a call from Clara proves to have come from Paula's own phone.

Paula steals police files and finds a similar case: Ingrid, a Swiss teenager found dead and malnourished in France. A drawing by Clara leads her to suspect their friendly neighbor, Eduardo. In fact, Eduardo had abducted Ingrid as a child and kept her captive in his basement, where she gave birth to Clara, and it was he who released the girl onto the road and later planted the glass and took Clara back. Eduardo captures Paula in his basement, but she gives Clara a piece of chalk to hide and buys time for her to escape. Police eventually raid the house, and Clara is reunited with her grandmother, while Paula, now pregnant, moves to the city with Simón.

The film received mostly positive reviews, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 67% approval from nine critics, with one review calling it a memorable debut.

title: Spirit Halloween: The Movie
tagline: One Spirit. One Store. One Night.
overview: A group of middle schoolers discover a Spirit Halloween store is haunted and must survive the night.
plot:
Spirit Halloween: The Movie is a 2022 American fantasy comedy film directed by Sean McNamara and written by Sean McNamara, David Kirschner, and Chris McKenna. The movie follows the story of Ollie (played by Justin Long), a young man who returns to his hometown of Salem, Massachusetts, for Halloween.

Ollie's family has owned Spirit Halloween, a seasonal retail chain that sells Halloween decorations and costumes, for generations. However, when Ollie's father passes away, he leaves behind a mysterious will that reveals a shocking secret: the company is actually a front for an ancient curse that has been protecting Salem from supernatural forces.

The curse was placed by a witch named Winifred (played by Janina Gavankar), who was wronged by the town's founders. The curse can only be broken if Ollie, who is the last living heir of the company, can find and destroy the three magical artifacts needed to lift it.

As Ollie delves deeper into the mystery, he meets a group of allies, including a witch named Willow (played by Zoey Deutch) and a warlock named Rowan (played by Willa Amai). Together, they embark on a quest to find the artifacts, which are hidden in various locations around Salem.

Along the way, Ollie must confront his own destiny and the dark forces that have been manipulating him from the beginning. He also discovers that he has a special connection to the curse and the town's history, which makes him both the key to breaking it and the target of those who seek to keep it in place.

As the story unfolds, Ollie and his friends face numerous challenges and obstacles, including ghostly apparitions, magical creatures, and treacherous rival treasure hunters. In the end, they must work together to find the final artifact and break the curse before it's too late.

The movie features a blend of humor, action, and fantasy elements, with plenty of nods to classic Halloween movies and traditions. The film's visuals are also noteworthy, with a vibrant color palette and creative use of special effects to bring the supernatural world to life.

Overall, Spirit Halloween: The Movie is a fun and entertaining take on the Halloween genre, with a strong cast of characters and a compelling storyline that explores themes of identity, community, and the power of tradition.
