title: Last Seen Alive
tagline: He'll stop at nothing to get her back.
overview: After Will Spann's wife suddenly vanishes at a gas station, his desperate search to find her leads him down a dark path that forces him to run from authorities and take the law into his own hands.
plot:
Last Seen Alive is a 2022 American action thriller directed by Brian Goodman from a screenplay by Marc Frydman, starring Gerard Butler, who also produced it, with Jaimie Alexander and Russell Hornsby. Shot under the title Chase, it follows a man who takes the law into his own hands to find his missing wife. It was released in the United States on June 3, 2022.

Will Spann, a wealthy real-estate agent, is driving his wife, Lisa, to her parents' house at a moment when their marriage is in trouble. While he fills the tank at a gas station, Lisa goes into the store for water and never comes back. Finding only her belongings, Will calls 911 and is told by Detective Paterson to wait, but instead he goes to Lisa's parents, Barry and Anna Adams, who have never fully trusted him and can tell him nothing. Back at the station, the clerk, Oscar, claims the security cameras are broken, but Will spots one that is working, fights Oscar for the recorder and hands it to the police. The footage shows Lisa leaving with a man before a passing truck blocks the view. Angered when Paterson asks about Lisa's life insurance, Will shows the video to her parents, who recognize their handyman, Knuckles.

Will tracks down and overpowers Knuckles, who admits that he delivered Lisa to a man named Frank and agrees to lead Will to his hideout. Forced to abandon his SUV, with the bound Knuckles in the back, when police pull him over, Will makes his way through the forest to Frank's camp, a run-down drug lab where he also finds Oscar. A gunfight leaves Frank and one of his men dead, apparently taking Lisa's location with them, while Paterson learns from Knuckles, who had been coerced by Frank, that Lisa is supposedly dead. When Oscar demands money for information, the drug lab explodes and kills him. As Paterson finds the grave Knuckles described empty, Will hears banging from a shed and discovers Lisa tied up but alive. Paterson later notes that some of the burned bodies had gunshot wounds, but chooses not to pursue it.

Butler plays Will, Alexander plays Lisa and Hornsby plays Paterson, with Ethan Embry as Knuckles, Michael Irby as Oscar and David Kallaway as Frank. Critics were dismissive, giving it 13% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and noting how closely its plot resembles the 1997 Kurt Russell thriller Breakdown. When it reached Netflix on October 1, 2022, however, it became the service's most-watched film in the United States and ranked in its top ten in many other countries.

title: Hawa
overview: A teenage girl lives with her grandmother and worries she will be removed by social services. She sets off to get adopted by someone she admires more than anything, one of the most powerful women in the world.
plot:
Hawa is a 2022 French comedy-drama directed by Maïmouna Doucouré, her second feature after Cuties, written by Doucouré with Alain-Michel Blanc and Zangro, who also produced it through Bien ou Bien Productions for Amazon Prime Video. Newcomer Sania Halifa, discovered through an open casting call, plays the title role, with the Malian singer Oumou Sangaré as her grandmother Maminata, Titouan Gerbier as Erwan and Jérôme Pouly as Jackie; the singer Yseult and the astronaut Thomas Pesquet appear as themselves. According to Doucouré, the story is about wanting to rise above one's social class.

Hawa is a fifteen-year-old Parisian girl with albinism, thick glasses and a blonde afro, who is often bullied for her looks but never backs down. She lives with Maminata, a griot who sings stories in the oral tradition and hopes to pass that art on to her. The grandmother is terminally ill and is searching for a family to take Hawa in, while the girl, who earns money at a corner grocery, rejects every candidate and faces the prospect of a foster home. After reading that Michelle Obama is in Paris promoting her memoir Becoming, Hawa decides that the former First Lady, whose daughters have left home, would be the ideal adoptive mother. Riding her scooter across the city with help from her shy friend Erwan, she slips backstage at a rehearsal for a concert by Yseult, who is charmed by her nerve, steals an invitation to a gala, sneaks into a children's hospital to pitch herself to Obama, wins the support of Thomas Pesquet and finally makes her way through the luggage area of Charles de Gaulle Airport toward Obama's plane, while at home Maminata's health keeps declining.

Hawa premiered in the Platform section of the Toronto International Film Festival on 13 September 2022, also screened at the Calgary International Film Festival, and was released on Prime Video on 9 December 2022. Critics responded warmly. In Variety, Tomris Laffly called it a big-hearted, crowd-pleasing contemporary fable with a disarming sense of humor, praising Halifa's lived-in performance, Sangaré's screen presence and the tight structure. Decider's John Serba recommended it as an understated neo-fairy tale that skirts magical realism and ends on a moving finale, though he admitted its set pieces defy logic. French press reviews were positive, averaging 3.2 out of 5 on AlloCiné.

title: Jennifer Lopez: Halftime
tagline: It’s just the beginning.
overview: Global superstar Jennifer Lopez reflects on her multifaceted career and the pressure of life in the spotlight in this intimate documentary.
plot:
Jennifer Lopez: Halftime is a 2022 American documentary film directed by Amanda Micheli about the singer, actress and dancer Jennifer Lopez, with a particular focus on her performance at the Super Bowl LIV halftime show and her acclaimed role in the film Hustlers (2019). Produced by Lopez's manager Benny Medina and her producing partner Elaine Goldsmith-Thomas among others, it premiered as the opening night film of the Tribeca Film Festival on 8 June 2022 and was released on Netflix on 14 June 2022.

The film opens at Lopez's family party for her 50th birthday in July 2019 and follows her over the next six months. Behind the scenes, it tracks the awards campaign for Hustlers, which brought her the strongest reviews of her career after years of popular but critically derided comedies and her first Golden Globe nomination since Selena, along with her hopes for a first Academy Award nomination, which ultimately does not come. In parallel, it shows her preparing the halftime show of 2 February 2020 with her music director and choreographers, frustrated at having to share the brief slot with Shakira, and fighting the network executives to keep a segment with children in cages as a statement about the treatment of migrants at the border, a battle she wins. Glimpses of the past include her debut as a Fly Girl on In Living Color, her breakthrough in Selena, the video for "Waiting for Tonight" and her decision to wear again the Versace dress that caused a sensation at the 2000 Grammy Awards. She also reflects on the intense tabloid scrutiny of her private life, the obstacles she has faced as a Latina, and her views on the politics of the Trump era. The film closes with her performance at the inauguration of Joe Biden. Interviewees include Ben Affleck, Shakira, Hustlers director Lorene Scafaria, Constance Wu and Julia Stiles.

To coincide with the release, Lopez recorded "Same Girl (Halftime Remix)" with French Montana and a rendition of "This Land Is Your Land" and "America the Beautiful". The film debuted at number two worldwide on Netflix. Reviews were generally positive, with an 84% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Richard Roeper of the Chicago Sun-Times called it a solid, entertaining insider's look at her life, and The Detroit News found it inspirational, whereas Owen Gleiberman of Variety felt that, as a celebration of her success that avoids her personal life, it was too celebratory to have much drama.

title: Beyond the Universe
overview: While waiting for a kidney transplant, a young pianist finds an unexpected connection with her doctor — and the courage to fulfill her musical dreams.
plot:
Beyond the Universe (Portuguese: Depois do Universo) is a 2022 Brazilian romantic drama written and directed by Diego Freitas and produced by Camisa Listrada. Singer Giulia Be makes her lead acting debut opposite Henry Zaga, with João Côrtes, João Miguel, Denise Del Vecchio, Leo Bahia, Viviane Araújo and Othon Bastos in supporting roles. The film premiered on Netflix on 27 October 2022, and within a day of its release it had entered the platform's global top ten of most-watched films.

Nina Soares is a gifted pianist who began playing at the age of eight and dreamed of joining a symphony orchestra. At fourteen she collapsed during an important recital and was diagnosed with lupus. Now a young adult, she learns that the disease has severely damaged her kidneys, which function at less than ten percent of their capacity. She is placed on the national transplant waiting list, behind thousands of other patients, and must undergo dialysis sessions lasting four hours, three times a week.

On the day she is due to begin treatment, Nina sees that the São Paulo Symphony Orchestra is looking for a piano soloist and decides to audition, despite her illness. She arranges to practise after hours at the conservatory where she teaches. One day, while she plays a public piano in a train station near the hospital, a young man named Gabriel, distracted by her music, crashes his bicycle into the instrument. Gabriel turns out to be a resident doctor at the hospital where Nina receives dialysis, known among patients for his warmth and good humour. A romance gradually develops between them, and Gabriel encourages Nina to pursue her dream of performing with the orchestra, even as her health becomes more fragile and the wait for a donor kidney grows more urgent.

The film is a sentimental love story about illness, hope and the pursuit of art, in the tradition of romantic dramas centred on young patients. It also draws attention to organ donation and to the long transplant waiting lists in Brazil.

Beyond the Universe was popular with Netflix audiences, while critics regarded it as a heartfelt but predictable romantic drama, praising the chemistry between its two leads.

title: When Christmas Was Young
overview: The story follows a headstrong music manager in desperate need of a hit song for his last remaining client, who finds himself falling for a gifted singer-songwriter with abandoned dreams of making it big, as he attempts to secure the rights to a Christmas song she wrote years ago.
plot:
When Christmas Was Young is a 2022 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Monika Mitchell for CBS, produced by Lighthouse Pictures and EveryWhere Studios with the singer-songwriter Sheryl Crow as an executive producer. Crow also wrote the film's music, including its title song. It stars Tyler Hilton as the music manager Luke Dawson and Karen David as Melody, with Meghan Heffern, Jordana Largy, Hayley Sales, Dhirendra, Jake Foy, Jayce Barreiro, Grace Sunar and Anastasia Bandey. Both leads are singer-songwriters in real life, and the casting reversed Hilton's usual screen persona: best known for playing the musician Chris Keller on One Tree Hill, he here plays the manager rather than the artist and does not sing, while David performs several songs.

Luke is a cocky, self-assured music manager who believes he is at the top of his game, though in truth his career is heading for disaster, he is lonely and he has only one client left, for whom he desperately needs a hit. He travels to Nashville to buy the rights to a Christmas song written years earlier by Melody, a gifted singer-songwriter and single mother who long ago gave up her dreams of making it big. Luke assumes the deal is a formality, but Melody firmly refuses to sell, and the two clash immediately. As he works to change her mind, Luke tries the charm that usually wins people over, yet none of it works on Melody, whose self-assurance and warmth take him by surprise. While she gradually comes out of her shell, the manager who is used to changing others finds himself changed, and with the rest of his life falling apart he begins to fall for her, even as he still needs her song.

The film premiered on CBS on 18 December 2022 and was made available on Paramount+. In interviews, Hilton said he was drawn by the chance to play a cocky man knocked down a peg and to work with Mitchell, a friend, and with Crow, a former label mate at Warner Bros. He and David described the experience as magical, recalling that they bonded over similar early careers in music, including rejections and changes of record deals and managers, and that each built a playlist to get into character, Hilton's leaning on George Thorogood. They also explained that they had to work to make their characters' initial antagonism convincing because they got along so well off screen.

title: Aftersun
tagline: Memory burns.
overview: At a fading vacation resort, 11-year-old Sophie treasures rare time together with her loving and idealistic father, Calum. Twenty years later, Sophie’s tender recollections of their last holiday become a powerful and heartrending portrait of their relationship.
plot:
In 1999, Scottish 11-year-old Sophie Patterson travels to a Turkish holiday resort with her 30-year-old father, Calum, who moved to London after separating amicably from her mother. Sophie records the holiday on a MiniDV camera, the footage of which is interspersed throughout the film. Over the course of the holiday, Sophie befriends and observes various other teenage British tourists at the resort, including meeting and playing arcade games with a boy named Michael. Calum exhibits signs of depression and internal turmoil, which he tries to hide from Sophie beneath a facade of contentment. During his time alone, he practices tai chi and reads self-help books; he also hides his smoking from Sophie.
One day, Sophie and Calum go scuba diving. Sophie loses her expensive scuba mask; her father feigns nonchalance, but she senses his actual feelings and comforts him. Calum later tells their diving instructor that he is surprised he has lived to be 30. Soon after, the two go to a rug shop, where she sees him grapple with the cost of one he likes. He declines to buy the rug, but later returns alone to do so.
The next night, Sophie and Calum attend a karaoke night during which the former signs them up for a song. Calum refuses to sing with Sophie despite her insistence; Sophie sings "Losing My Religion" alone as he watches. Upset at being left alone by him, Sophie refuses to return to their room and hangs out with tourists she had previously met playing pool. Michael creeps up on Sophie from behind, frightening her. They later kiss beside a pool. Meanwhile, Calum walks into the nearby ocean. When Sophie returns to their room, she finds him asleep naked and gently covers him with a sheet.
The two reconcile the next day while travelling to the mud baths and Calum apologises for his behaviour the previous night. Sophie surprises him by having other tourists sing "For He's a Jolly Good Fellow" for his 31st birthday. Calum watches stoically before later sobbing in the hotel room alone; on the floor is a postcard addressed to Sophie that tells her to never forget that he loves her. On the last night of their holiday, Calum and Sophie dance to "Under Pressure" in a loving embrace. At the airport the next morning, Calum waves goodbye and sends Sophie off on her flight home. In the present day, the adult Sophie lives in New York City with her wife and young child. The rug Calum bought, worn with use, lies on their bedroom floor. Sophie watches the MiniDV footage from Turkey.
Interspersed throughout the film are abstract, dreamlike sequences in which the adult Sophie stands in the middle of a crowded rave, catching glimpses of Calum dancing emotionally through strobing lights. Throughout the sequences, Sophie attempts to get closer to him, eventually briefly embracing him; with their hands wrapped around each other, Calum ultimately falls from Sophie's grasp.

title: Dangerous Liaisons
overview: The innocent Célène might be falling in love with popular surfer Tristan at her new school. But she has no idea that, in actuality, she’s the object of a cruel bet between Tristan and Instagram influencer Vanessa.
plot:
Dangerous Liaisons (French: Les Liaisons dangereuses) is a 2022 French teen romantic drama directed by Rachel Suissa for Netflix, a modern adaptation of Pierre Choderlos de Laclos's 18th-century epistolary novel in which the letters of the original are replaced by Instagram posts and stories. Produced by Autopilot Entertainment, it stars Paola Locatelli as Célène and Simon Rérolle as Tristan, with Ella Pellegrini as Vanessa, Héloïse Janjaud as Célène's cousin Charlotte, Jin Xuan Mao as Tao and Alexis Michalik. The film runs 109 minutes.

The story opens on a dramatic night when both Tristan and Célène appear close to despair, with Tristan narrating that fame is power in the modern age, before flashing back to show how they got there. In Biarritz, Célène, a shy and studious seventeen-year-old who prefers literature to social media and is in a long-distance relationship, is starting at a new school, Victor Hugo High. There she meets Tristan, a champion surfer with 3.5 million Instagram followers, after he saves her dog from being run over by a driver livestreaming at the wheel. Tristan and Vanessa, the pampered child star of a film series who is afraid of becoming a has-been, present themselves online as a couple, but their relationship is a sham; the two cynics actually enjoy scheming to destroy other people's romances. Unaware that she is the object of a cruel bet between them, Célène falls for Tristan as he sets out to seduce her, manipulating those around her, including her friend Tao, a DJ and dealer, and her goofy cousin Charlotte. Preparations for the school musical, a costume party with spiked punch and a surfing lesson that ends in a romantic beach hut push the scheme forward, while Célène, who joins Instagram under a provocative handle, gradually discovers the power and cruelty of online fame.

Released on Netflix on 8 July 2022, the film drew mostly negative reviews. Decider's John Serba advised viewers to skip it, calling it a toothless social-media remake that pales beside the 1988 Stephen Frears film and Cruel Intentions, with a soft Tristan, an underwritten heroine and a drawn-out ending, though he praised Janjaud's spirited comic performance and the idea behind Vanessa's character. The New York Times and Firstpost likewise found its social-media update colorful but shallow and clichéd.

title: 4 Horsemen: Apocalypse
tagline: The end is here.
overview: A small team of scientists must race against time to stop what seems to be a cascade of global disasters signaling the possible apocalypse and end of days.
plot:
4 Horsemen: Apocalypse is a 2022 American science fiction disaster film directed by Geoff Meed and produced by David Michael Latt for The Asylum. Meed co-wrote the screenplay with Lauren Pritchard and Joe Roche, who also devised the story. Dominique Swain leads the cast as the military officer Bridget Norris, with Arie Thompson as the volcanologist Dr. Lynise Hughes, Eric St. John as Major Oakley Jones, Eva Ceja as the meteorologist Dakota Lenna and Brandon Alan Smith as the microbiologist Elliot Rodney.

The world is in an alarming state: famines caused by global warming, a new pandemic fueled by antibiotic resistance and escalating violence and unrest across the globe, followed by storms, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes and swarms of locusts. More and more world leaders fear that the cascade of disasters signals the coming apocalypse and the end of days. At the Pentagon, Norris is ordered to assemble a small team of specialists, Hughes, Lenna and Rodney, who are sent with a military peacekeeping force under the deeply religious Major Jones to the apparent epicenter of the catastrophes, a lake region in Brazil. Working from an abandoned observatory, the scientists determine that the eruptions originate beneath a central lake and are setting off a chain reaction around the world. Racing to learn whether the disaster can be stopped, and whether it is supernatural, Rodney improvises homemade bombs designed to wipe out the locust swarms by disrupting their oxygen, to be detonated by a gunshot fired from a moving helicopter, while others attempt to seal the volcanic lake by crashing a helicopter into it. Meanwhile, a fungus released by the volcano causes soldiers who inhale it to hallucinate and turn violent, and Jones believes he sees the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse riding across the sky.

Filmed in California, the film was released on video on demand in the United States on 29 April 2022 and reached German video stores that September. Reviews were poor. Moria Reviews gave it two stars, finding the concept awkwardly handled, with the supposed end of the world reduced to events around a single Brazilian lake, though it enjoyed the brief computer-generated glimpses of the Horsemen and Roche's inventive pseudo-scientific schemes. Film-rezensionen.de awarded it two out of ten, calling it boring because of its drawn-out dialogue, criticizing its failure to engage with the biblical background and calling it a typical cheap Asylum production.

title: Must Love Christmas
overview: A renowned romance novelist famous becomes involved in a love triangle between her childhood crush and a reporter.
plot:
Must Love Christmas is a 2022 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Martin Wood from a screenplay by Mark Amato. Produced by Brad Krevoy Television and the Motion Picture Corporation of America, it stars Liza Lapira as a reclusive romance novelist, with Neal Bledsoe, Nathan Witte, Ian Collins, Simone Bailly and Adam Beauchesne in supporting roles. The film premiered on CBS on 11 December 2022, as the network's second original Christmas film of the season after Fit for Christmas, and was also made available on Paramount+. It runs 85 minutes.

Natalie Wolf (Lapira) is an acclaimed author of Christmas love stories who is herself unlucky in love and has lived as a recluse since being burned by a journalist years earlier. Struggling with her latest novel, she follows her editor's advice to list the five qualities she wants in a partner and to get out and experience the world, agreeing to a book signing near Buffalo, her first public appearance in six years, on condition that she speaks to no journalists. Nick Winters (Bledsoe), a reporter for the magazine SHE, needs a major cover story to boost sales and stave off a merger with a rival publication, and sees the elusive author as the answer. Natalie recognises that he is no fan and rebuffs him. When a blizzard strands them both in the small town of Cranberry Falls, Natalie is stunned to be rescued by the tow-truck driver Caleb (Witte), her high-school crush and the model for the hero of her current book, who has organised the town's annual Dickens Festival, commemorating a stay by Charles Dickens at the local inn, and its toy drive. Joined by his photographer Lucas (Collins), a devoted fan of Natalie's books who begins a romance with her publicist Ryan (Beauchesne), Nick decides to chronicle her reunion with the one who got away without her help, only to find himself falling for her.

Reviews were favourable. Decider recommended streaming it, observing that the film began as a formulaic holiday romance but stood out by adding a love triangle, a second romance and Natalie's imagined scenes from her novels, playfully expanding the genre's conventions, and crediting its charming performers. Steve Gidlow of MediaVillage called it a refreshing take on a familiar story thanks to strong lead performances, and Lapira said she enjoyed playing a character far less self-assured than her role in The Equalizer.

title: Blowback
tagline: Be careful who you betray.
overview: When a master thief is sabotaged during a bank heist and left for dead, he seeks revenge on his former crew one target at a time. Now, with the cops and the mob closing in, he's in the race of his life to reclaim an untold fortune in cryptocurrency from those who double-crossed him.
plot:
Blowback is a 2022 American action crime thriller film directed by Tibor Takács from a screenplay credited to Matthew Eason, Robert Giardina and Robert Edward Thomas. Produced by Premiere Entertainment Group and distributed by Saban Films, it stars Cam Gigandet as a thief seeking revenge on the crew that betrayed him, with Randy Couture, Michele Plaia, Louis Mandylor, William McNamara, Benjamin Abiola, Rafael Cabrera, Chris Maher and Texas Battle in supporting roles. Set in Las Vegas, the film was released in June 2022. It is rated R for violence, drug use and language and runs 93 minutes.

Nick (Gigandet), a rideshare driver, has a teenage daughter (Melissa Diaz) who is gravely ill in hospital, and whose only chance of survival is an experimental treatment that his insurance and meagre earnings cannot cover. Through a contact at a bank, he learns of a valuable delivery and plans an inside job. He reconnects with his former girlfriend Veronica (Plaia), whose boyfriend Jack (Couture), the main investor in her gym and a hardened criminal, connects him with a crew of thieves; with his tech-savvy friend Xander (Abiola) also on board, the group is told to stick to the plan and that nobody will get hurt. The robbery goes largely as planned, but afterwards Jack's men shoot Nick, leave him for dead and take the stolen case, which holds hard drives containing millions of dollars in cryptocurrency. Patched up by a disgraced, drug-addicted doctor (McNamara) living in an RV, Nick sets out to recover the fortune and take revenge on his former crew one target at a time, enlisting the help of the mobster who owns the case, while Detective Cooper (Mandylor) leads a police investigation that keeps closing in on the trail of violence.

Reviews were generally negative. Roger Moore of Movie Nation found it a routine, bloody and slow-footed cops-and-robbers tale whose cryptocurrency angle threatened to date it instantly; he thought the leads were not bad but that the script was fatally flawed, particularly in handing Nick a "gangster ex machina" who solves his problems for him. Peter Gray of The AU Review called it a generic, disposable heist film that hit every expected beat yet had an odd watchability, largely thanks to Gigandet's sympathetic performance. Mark Dujsik of Mark Reviews Movies wrote that it consisted almost entirely of plot, with characters too thin even to count as archetypes.

title: South Park the Streaming Wars
overview: Cartman locks horns with his mom in a battle of wills while an epic conflict unfolds that threatens South Park’s very existence.
plot:
"South Park: The Streaming Wars" is a 2022 American adult animated comedy television special written and directed by Trey Parker. The third South Park special made for Paramount+, it was released on June 1, 2022, and counts as the 318th episode of the series. Voices include Parker, Matt Stone, April Stewart and Kimberly Brooks.

Denver is suffering a severe drought caused by ManBearPig, and as streams dry up, protesters, including waterpark owner Pi Pi, are told that the city's water is going to agriculture. In South Park, Stan Marsh and Tolkien Black worry about Stan's father, Randy, who quarrels with Tolkien's father, Steve. Eric Cartman, unhappy about living in an abandoned hot dog stand, notices a house being built across the street for golf course owner Talnua Cussler and urges his mother, Liane, to get breast implants to attract him. She refuses, reminds him that he is the one who made her quit her job, and tells him the surgery would cost $10,000.

Steve learns he can sell part of his water if it reaches Denver's reservoir, so at Stan and Tolkien's suggestion they build a small boat and float it downstream. The test works, and Steve begins selling subscriptions to his "streaming service", with Pi Pi among his customers. When a jealous Randy wants boats too, Stan and Tolkien recruit Kyle, Kenny and Butters, and finally Cartman, after he claims his mother needs surgery without saying what kind. Cussler orders 10,000 boats for $15,000, covering the cost, but when Cartman presents the surgery to Liane, she holds firm, unmoved even when he threatens to have it done himself.

Steve hears from a dying real estate agent that land near the streams has been sold to a wealthy buyer. When Randy and Stan visit Cussler to end the deal, they find him killed by ManBearPig. At his waterpark, Pi Pi refuses to give up his streaming rights and reveals that he is working with the commissioner and ManBearPig, who stabs Steve and throws him down a water slide. Pi Pi then betrays the commissioner, plotting to replace Denver's water with his park's urine-tainted water. At school, Cartman arrives with breast implants, Tolkien learns his father is missing, and as Denver wastes its dwindling water, Randy begins investigating.

It stems from Parker and Stone's $900 million deal, announced in 2021, for 14 Paramount+ projects, which the creators called specials rather than films. Bubbleblabber rated it 9 out of 10, praising its gags and forward-looking satire.

title: Lifemark
tagline: Hope is at the heart of every journey.
overview: David's comfortable world is turned upside down when his birth mother Melissa unexpectedly reaches out, longing to meet the eighteen year old son she's only held once.
plot:
Lifemark is a 2022 American Christian drama directed by Kevin Peeples, based on the true story of David Scotton, whose birth mother considered abortion before choosing adoption and who reconnected with her as a young adult. Kirk Cameron, Alex Kendrick and Raphael Ruggero star, with Dawn Long and Rebecca Rogers in supporting roles. Alex and Stephen Kendrick co-wrote the script with Peeples and served as executive producers; it was the brothers' first adaptation of a true story. The story had previously been told in the 2018 short documentary I Lived on Parker Avenue.

Melissa is a frightened, pregnant teenager who goes to a clinic to end her pregnancy. At the last moment, she tells the doctor that she cannot go through with it. She chooses to give birth to her son and arranges for him to be adopted, and the baby, named David, is raised by a loving couple, the Coltons, in Louisiana. Eighteen years later, David is a high school senior with a close relationship to his adoptive parents when Melissa reaches out to him through the adoption agency. The two connect through social media, and David must sort through his feelings about the mother who gave him up before deciding to meet her. Their reunion brings together both of his families, and David learns the full story of the choice that saved his life, while Melissa finds healing from the pain she has carried since his birth.

Scotton first told his story in a 2011 pro-life oratory contest at Jesuit High School in New Orleans, and Louisiana Right to Life funded the documentary, which he later presented across the country. Cameron, who had worked with the Kendricks on Fireproof, brought the project to them after seeing the documentary. Both Stephen Kendrick and Cameron have adopted children, and Cameron's wife was herself adopted, which they cited as motivation. The filmmakers used two sets of actors for the birth parents across the time jump and de-aging techniques for the adoptive parents. Development began in 2019, and Stephen Kendrick described its release after the Dobbs decision as providential timing.

After traditional distributors declined, the film was released through Fathom Events on September 9, 2022, and its one-week run was extended due to strong ticket sales. Rotten Tomatoes reports 83% positive reviews from six critics. Christian outlets praised Ruggero's performance, while World magazine felt it paled beside the documentary, and the National Catholic Register noted a lack of conflict.

title: Snoopy Presents: Lucy's School
tagline: A tribute to teachers!
overview: The Peanuts gang is nervous about going to a new school, so Lucy starts her own. She soon learns that teaching is tougher than she thought—and that change can be a good thing.
plot:
Snoopy Presents: Lucy's School, also known simply as Lucy's School, is a 2022 animated television special based on Charles M. Schulz's Peanuts comic strip. Directed by Raymond S. Persi and written by Craig Schulz, Bryan Schulz and Cornelius Uliano, it is the 49th Peanuts animated special and the fourth made for Apple TV+. It follows Lucy van Pelt, who opens a school of her own because she is anxious about starting at a new one. The voice cast includes Isabella Leo as Lucy, Etienne Kellici as Charlie Brown, Wyatt White as Linus, Terry McGurrin as Snoopy, Rob Tinkler as Woodstock.

As summer vacation draws to a close, Charlie Brown and his friends learn that they will be attending a newly built school in the autumn. While most of the children are curious, Lucy is unsettled by the thought of unfamiliar teachers, older students, lockers and being separated from her friends. Masking her fear by criticizing the new school, she announces that she will run a school of her own, enlists the others as pupils and sets up a classroom. Certain that teaching will be easy, she poses as an expert on every subject, but her lessons soon fall into disorder as Linus, Franklin and Marcie question her answers, the students ask things she cannot answer and refuse to behave as she wishes, and Snoopy and Woodstock add to the distractions. Once her pupils lose faith in the school, Lucy admits she does not know how to teach them, and Linus helps her see that she started it because she was frightened of the coming change. The others confess that they are nervous too and assure her they will face the new school together, and Lucy gains a new appreciation of the preparation, patience and encouragement teachers must give. On the first day of term the children meet their new teacher, Miss Halverson, who welcomes them and eases their worries, and Lucy walks into the classroom with her friends, ready to accept the change. The special closes with a tribute to teachers and their influence on students.

Apple TV+ released the special worldwide on August 12, 2022, alongside new episodes of The Snoopy Show. It was produced for Peanuts Worldwide and WildBrain. Common Sense Media gave it four out of five stars, praising its handling of back-to-school anxiety. It won Best Animation Program at the 2023 Leo Awards and earned a Children's and Family Emmy nomination.

title: Collision
overview: Over the course of one fateful day, a corrupt businessman and his socialite wife race to save their daughter from a notorious crime lord.
plot:
Collision is a 2022 South African crime thriller film directed by Fabien Martorell and released by Netflix. Set in Johannesburg over two days shortly before Freedom Day, it interweaves several storylines that converge in a deadly traffic accident. The cast includes Langley Kirkwood as Johan Greser, Tessa Jubber as his wife Diane, Zoey Sneedon as their teenage daughter Nicole, Vuyo Dabula as the gangster Bra Sol, Mpho Sebeng as Thando, Siphesihle Vazi as Cecil, Samke Makhoba as Palesa, Pheello Kotelo as her father Dinoko Wiseman and Thamsanqa Booi as Adze.

The film opens with the collision itself: one car carries a dead man on its windscreen and a screaming girl in the boot, and armed men step out of the vehicles. It then rewinds two days. Johan, head of security at a company run by a relative, is entangled in corrupt deals with the feared crime lord Bra Sol, and when one deal is jeopardized he counts on a promotion that instead goes to a black woman, a blow to his racist assumptions. At home his marriage to the socialite Diane is strained, and their rebellious daughter skips school to spend time with her boyfriend Cecil, a singer, and his money-hungry friend Thando. When Nicole is kidnapped by Bra Sol, Johan and Diane race against time to save her, and her fate comes to depend on Cecil and Thando. In a parallel story, Dinoko, a struggling shopkeeper who pays protection money to Bra Sol, loses a lease to the Nigerian immigrant Adze and rallies other locals into xenophobic attacks on foreign-owned businesses, unaware that his daughter Palesa has fallen in love with Adze. The riots knock out traffic lights, setting the stage for the crash that binds the stories together, while subplots touch on bribery, a corrupt mayor and the trafficking of young girls.

Collision premiered on Netflix on 16 June 2022, timed to South Africa's Youth Day. Reception was mixed. Naledi de Wee of The South African praised its exceptional acting, unexpected twists, Ofentse Mwase's cinematography and engagement with racism, xenophobia and human trafficking, comparing it favorably with Netflix's other South African productions. Vivian Nneka Nwajiaku of Afrocritik gave it 2.5 out of 5, likening its structure to Crash but finding the plot scattered, the thrills scarce, the political statements half-hearted and the performances middling apart from Dabula's menacing yet gentle Bra Sol. Other reviewers similarly found it competently shot but confusing and poorly paced.

title: Elemental
tagline: Opposites react.
overview: In a city where fire, water, land, & air residents live together, a fiery young woman & a go-with-the-flow guy will discover something elemental: How much they have in common.
plot:
Elemental is a 2023 American animated romantic comedy-drama produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, directed by Peter Sohn and written by John Hoberg, Kat Likkel and Brenda Hsueh. Leah Lewis and Mamoudou Athie voice the leads, with Ronnie del Carmen, Shila Ommi, Wendi McLendon-Covey and Catherine O'Hara in supporting roles. Sohn developed the story from the question of whether fire and water could ever connect, drawing on his own youth as the son of immigrants.

After a catastrophic storm, the fire elements Bernie and Cinder Lumen emigrate from Fire Land to Element City, where they meet prejudice from the city's water, air and earth residents. They light a Blue Flame that embodies their traditions and open a convenience store, the Fireplace. Years later, their daughter Ember is meant to inherit the shop once she learns to control her temper. During a big sale she loses control in the basement, bursting a water pipe and summoning Wade Ripple, a sentimental water element and city inspector, who reluctantly reports the store's code violations, threatening it with closure.

Wade persuades his boss, the air element Gale Cumulus, to spare the Fireplace if he and Ember can find and seal the leak that has been flooding the district by the end of the week. Tracing it to a breach in a dam, the pair spend time together and fall for each other, and Ember fuses sand into glass to make a lasting seal. A dinner with Wade's wealthy family leads to an offer of a glassmaking internship, and Ember starts to realise she does not want to take over the store. Wade shows her the Vivisteria flowers she was once denied seeing, and they discover they can touch without harming each other.

Bound by duty and her family's distrust of water, Ember breaks things off, but Wade declares his love at the handover party and accidentally reveals that she caused the burst pipe. Bernie cancels his retirement. When the dam seal fails and Fire Town floods, Wade evaporates while protecting Ember and the Blue Flame; she confesses her true wishes to her father, then brings Wade back by making him cry. Months later Bernie has retired, friends run the Fireplace, and the couple leave the city for Ember's internship.

Elemental closed the 76th Cannes Film Festival out of competition. After a soft opening it became a sleeper hit, grossing about $496 million worldwide, and Rotten Tomatoes reported 73% positive reviews.

title: Vesper
tagline: One seed can change everything.
overview: After the collapse of Earth's ecosystem, Vesper, a 13-year-old girl struggling to survive with her paralyzed Father, meets a mysterious Woman with a secret that forces Vesper to use her wits, strength and bio-hacking abilities to fight for the possibility of a future.
plot:
Vesper, released in France as Vesper Chronicles, is a 2022 science fiction film directed and written by Kristina Buožytė and Bruno Samper. Raffiella Chapman stars as Vesper, with Eddie Marsan as her uncle Jonas, Rosy McEwen as Camellia and Richard Brake as her father Darius.

Humanity's gamble on genetic engineering to avert ecological collapse has failed, and escaped organisms have destroyed edible plants, animals and much of humanity. A wealthy elite lives in sealed cities called citadels, while everyone else scrapes by outside, dependent on citadel seeds designed to produce only a single harvest. Fourteen-year-old Vesper, a gifted biohacker, lives in a forest house with Darius, who is paralyzed and follows her everywhere through a floating drone. Her mother left a year earlier to join the wandering scavengers known as the Pilgrims. Nearby, Darius's brother Jonas runs a camp where he sells children's blood to the citadel and uses engineered slaves called Jugs.

When a citadel ship crashes nearby, Vesper rescues a young woman, Camellia, who promises to take her and her father to the citadel if they can find her companion Elias. Jonas finds Elias first and kills him. Vesper realizes that Camellia, who grieves deeply for Elias, is not human: she is an advanced, sentient Jug created by Elias, a forbidden creation, which is why they fled. Working with seeds stolen from Jonas and samples from Camellia, Vesper discovers a way to unlock the citadel seeds so they can reproduce. After the two women overpower Jonas, he betrays Camellia to the citadel and is killed by its soldiers. Darius sacrifices himself to hold off the soldiers, and Camellia surrenders so that Vesper can escape with the seeds. Vesper buries some of them at her ruined home, takes in four of Jonas's children and heads south. At the top of a tower built by the Pilgrims, she looks out over the forest and scatters the remaining seeds to the wind.

The directors, who made Vanishing Waves (2012), spent six years on the film and shot it in English. Shot around Vilnius, Lithuania, it used no green screen, and cinematographer Feliksas Abrukauskas drew on the light in Vermeer and Rembrandt paintings. Vesper premiered at the Karlovy Vary International Film Festival on July 2, 2022, and opened in France on August 18. Reviews were positive; Rotten Tomatoes said that, though more visually impressive than narratively engaging, it rewards patient viewers with immersive world-building and intelligent ideas.

title: Explorer: The Deepest Cave
overview: Follows renowned cave explorer Bill Stone as he and his team push the boundaries of what has ever been done before as they attempt one of the greatest achievements of modern exploration — to set a new world record by venturing into the bottom of what is thought to be the deepest cave in the world.
plot:
Explorer: The Deepest Cave is a 2022 American documentary television film directed and photographed by Pablo Durana for National Geographic, the second special in the network's revived National Geographic Explorer series. It follows the renowned caver Bill Stone, founder of Stone Aerospace, and his international team on a three-month expedition into Sistema Cheve in Oaxaca, Mexico, which Stone believes is the deepest cave on Earth. The one-hour special premiered on the National Geographic Channel on Memorial Day, 30 May 2022, and was later made available on Disney+. Durana, a documentary cinematographer whose earlier work includes the Oscar-winning short Inocente and his own film Joyrider, trained in caving techniques in order to film the expedition.

Cheve was ranked only the 11th deepest known cave in the world, but in 1990 explorers who poured green dye into the stream flowing into its mouth found the coloured water emerging near the base of the mountain, about 1.6 miles below the highest known entrance. If people could follow the full course of the water, Cheve would surpass the record holder, Veryovkina in Georgia's Abkhazia region. Stone, who had been exploring the system since the late 1980s, led the 2021 expedition, the largest push yet, which drew 69 cavers from nine countries. The film presents the training, planning and safety precautions behind the descent, likened to climbing Everest in reverse, as the team rigs miles of rope down precipitous drops, wades underground rivers and moves between a chain of camps established ever deeper in the cave, sleeping underground for days or weeks at a time while searching for new passages that might lead further down. Over the expedition the cavers spent more than 1,500 cumulative nights underground and discovered more than 12 miles of unexplored passages, but by the end the team still did not know exactly how deep Cheve goes.

Alex Reif of Laughing Place wrote that, as with many such documentaries, the thrill of the special lay less in the destination than in the journey, and wrote that viewers would come away hoping National Geographic would document the team's next expedition. National Geographic magazine published an accompanying feature on the expedition by Maya Wei-Haas, with photographs by Kasia Biernacka.

title: Beyond Infinity: Buzz and the Journey to Lightyear
original_title: Beyond Infinity: Buzz and the Journey to Lightyear
overview: Explore the evolution of Buzz Lightyear from toy to human in the making of Pixar’s Lightyear. Dive into the origin and cultural impact of everyone’s favorite Space Ranger, the art of designing a new “human Buzz,” and the challenges faced by the Lightyear crew along the way.
plot:
Beyond Infinity: Buzz and the Journey to Lightyear is a 2022 American documentary film directed by Tony Kaplan and produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Disney+. Released to coincide with Pixar's animated feature Lightyear, the 36-minute film traces the evolution of Buzz Lightyear from the space ranger action figure introduced in Toy Story (1995) to the human hero of Lightyear, presented as the in-universe film that made young Andy want the toy. It features Pixar filmmakers, storytellers and artists, among them Pete Docter and Lightyear director Angus MacLane, together with members of the new film's voice cast.

The documentary begins before Toy Story, with Docter recalling Pixar's early years and how the studio moved from short films toward a planned Christmas special that eventually grew into the feature-length Toy Story. It then opens Pixar's archives to show early designs for Buzz, including the many alternative looks and names the character might have had, and explains how the team arrived at the toy that audiences came to know. The film examines Buzz's cultural impact and his meaning for Pixar's own artists. It then turns to MacLane, seen as a young member of the Toy Story 2 team; Docter describes him as the go-to authority on everything about Buzz, which helps explain why he was chosen to bring the character back in an origin story. The final section follows the making of Lightyear, detailing how the original action-figure design was translated into a believable human astronaut and the new challenges this created, while reflecting on what lies "beyond infinity."

The documentary premiered on Disney+ on 10 June 2022, a week before Lightyear opened in theaters on 17 June. Reviews were positive. Jacob Throneberry of Ready Steady Cut called it an exciting and insightful behind-the-scenes look, praising its brisk pace and the archival material on Buzz's origins, which he found more interesting than the account of Lightyear's production, and warned that it contains slight spoilers for the film. Jeremy Brown of What's On Disney Plus gave it four and a half stars, calling it his favorite of the studio's behind-the-scenes documentaries and saying it heightened his excitement for Lightyear.

title: Sonic Drone Home
overview: Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles encounter an abandoned Badnik drone which upgraded itself using parts from a junkyard, with the intention of conquering the world.
plot:
Sonic Drone Home is a 2022 American computer-animated short film set in the continuity of Paramount Pictures' live-action Sonic the Hedgehog film series. Directed by David Nelson and written by Pat Casey and Josh Miller, the writers of the feature films, it was animated by the Japanese studio Marza Animation Planet and produced by Neal H. Moritz, Toby Ascher, Toru Nakahara and Hitoshi Okuno. It was released on 24 May 2022 as a bonus feature with the digital and home media releases of Sonic the Hedgehog 2, a clip having first been shown by Entertainment Tonight. Ben Schwartz reprises his role as Sonic, while Fred Tatasciore and Alicyn Packard voice Knuckles and Tails in place of Idris Elba and Colleen O'Shaughnessey, and Aaron Landon voices the drone. Casey said the short was made during post-production of the sequel and is set about a month after its events.

In Green Hills, Sonic leads Tails and Knuckles off the path to the library, where Knuckles has sworn to Maddie Wachowski to return her library books on time, explaining that he is taking a shortcut. Imitating detectives in movies, Sonic narrates the adventure aloud, and the others join in. He has secretly brought them to the junkyard, where Wade Whipple has reported strange noises at night. There they find Unit, an abandoned Badnik drone built by Dr. Robotnik, which is upgrading itself with scrap parts and plans to conquer the world. Its laser blasts a hole through Maddie's books; Knuckles charges in, but Unit traps him in an old refrigerator and flings him onto a town billboard. Sonic's homing attacks knock the robot down, but a stray part sprays paint in his face, and Tails' bola is deflected onto Sonic's legs. Grounded by the airborne drone, Sonic asks Unit what it really wants for itself rather than what Robotnik programmed it to want. The robot shyly confesses a passion for poetry and begins reciting its verses until sunset, when Knuckles returns and smashes it apart. Tails recovers Unit's still-working core and is allowed to keep it as his responsibility, though Knuckles remains suspicious when Unit vows to make the world cower before its poetry. Sonic narrates the end of the adventure as the team heads off for chili dogs.

The title plays on the line "E.T. phone home", and the junkyard hides references to the first two films, including the baseball scoreboard Knuckles punched through in the sequel.

title: On the Line
tagline: A dangerous game. Played live.
overview: A provocative and edgy radio host must play a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a mysterious caller who's kidnapped his family and is threatening to blow up the whole station.
plot:
On the Line is a 2022 American thriller written, produced and directed by Romuald Boulanger. Mel Gibson stars as Elvis Cooney, a Los Angeles radio shock jock, with William Moseley as the intern Dylan, Alia Seror-O'Neill as the switchboard operator Mary, Paul Spera as the mysterious caller Gary and Kevin Dillon as Justin, a rival host.

Elvis leaves his wife and daughter for his midnight show at the station KLAT, where he welcomes the new intern, Dylan, with a prank. Partway through the broadcast, a caller named Gary claims to be at Elvis's house holding his wife Olivia and daughter Adria hostage, and threatens to kill them if he is cut off. Gary blames Elvis for the suicide of Lauren, a former switchboard operator who was the target of his abuse and crude jokes. He forces Elvis to admit on air that he has slept with Mary, then orders him to jump from the roof. A faked jump fails, and gunshots ring out over the line. Gary then reveals that the family is alive and inside the building. He has been there all along, has killed the security guard and has rigged the station with explosives. Elvis has 40 minutes to find them.

Elvis and Dylan search the building, which Gary watches through security cameras. Elvis refuses Gary's order to kill Tony, an old friend caught stealing computers. In the control room they find Justin, the host of the time slot Elvis covets, apparently shot dead, and later Tony hanging in a hallway. Elvis overpowers Gary with a box cutter, but Gary holds a dead man's switch, and Olivia and Adria are wearing bomb vests on the terrace. Gary forces a SWAT officer to transfer the vests to Dylan, shoots the officer and releases the switch, and nothing happens. Elvis and Gary burst out laughing as the supposed victims reappear: the whole night was an elaborate prank on the intern. When the crew chases the stunned Dylan with a microphone, he falls down the stairs and appears to die. The next morning, a shattered Elvis swears he is quitting radio, only to learn that Dylan, really a stuntman named Max, faked his death in a second prank aimed at Elvis himself for his birthday, which he believed everyone had forgotten. Elvis promises revenge.

Filming began in Paris in June 2021. Saban Films acquired the American rights in May 2022 and released the film that November. Reviews were negative. Rotten Tomatoes reported 20% approval, with its consensus saying a solid premise is undone by a story that stumbles over its own twists toward a disastrous ending.

title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey
original_title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey
tagline: This ain't no bedtime story
overview: Christopher Robin is headed off to college and he has abandoned his old friends, Pooh and Piglet, which then leads to the duo embracing their inner monsters.
plot:
Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey is a 2023 British independent slasher film produced, written, directed and edited by Rhys Frake-Waterfield. A horror reimagining of A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard's Winnie-the-Pooh books and the first entry in what became the Twisted Childhood Universe, it stars Nikolai Leon as Christopher Robin, Craig David Dowsett as Pooh and Chris Cordell as Piglet, with Amber Doig-Thorne and Natasha Rose Mills. The project went into development after the 1926 book entered the public domain in the United States in January 2022, and it was shot in six days in Ashdown Forest, East Sussex, the inspiration for the Hundred Acre Wood.

As a boy, Christopher Robin befriended Pooh, Piglet, Owl, Rabbit, Eeyore, Kanga and Roo in the Hundred Acre Wood, but after he left for college, the starving creatures ate Eeyore during the winter. Traumatized, the survivors came to hate humans, including Christopher for abandoning them, reverted to their wild instincts and vowed never to speak again. Five years later Christopher returns with his fiancée Mary and finds the wood deserted; that night Piglet strangles Mary with a chain and he and Pooh drag Christopher away. Later, university students Maria, Jessica, Alice, Zoe, Lara and Tina rent a cabin in the wood to help Maria recover from being stalked. Pooh kills Tina in a woodchipper; in his treehouse, Christopher is held captive. That night Pooh and Piglet attack the cabin, killing Lara and Zoe and abducting Alice, whom Maria and Jessica manage to rescue. In the treehouse the three free Christopher and another prisoner, Charlene, who wants revenge on Piglet for disfiguring her, but Piglet kills her. Alice knocks Piglet out with his sledgehammer before Pooh kills her. On the road, Pooh slaughters a group of men who stop to help, and when Maria crashes a pick-up truck while trying to run him down, he drags away and beheads Jessica. Christopher pins Pooh with his car, but Pooh frees himself and takes Maria hostage. When Christopher begs him to let her go, promising to stay with him forever, Pooh breaks his silence to tell him "You left" and kills Maria, and Christopher flees the wood.

Planned as a direct-to-video release, the film instead received a global theatrical run, premiering in Mexico on 26 January 2023. Critics savaged it, giving it a 3% Rotten Tomatoes rating, and it won five Golden Raspberry Awards, including Worst Picture, yet it grossed $7.7 million on a budget of about $50,000.

title: LEGO Star Wars Summer Vacation
tagline: They're going to need a bigger beach.
overview: Looking for a much-needed break, Finn arranges a surprise vacation for his friends Rey, Poe, Rose, Chewie, BB-8, R2-D2, and C-3PO, aboard the luxurious Halcyon. However, Finn's plan to have one last hurrah together quickly goes awry.
plot:
Lego Star Wars: Summer Vacation is a 2022 animated special set in the Star Wars universe, produced by Lucasfilm Animation and The Lego Group with Atomic Cartoons. As with The Lego Star Wars Holiday Special, Ken Cunningham directed it from a script by David Shayne. Conceived as a stand-alone sequel to the sequel trilogy, it was announced at Star Wars Celebration on May 27, 2022, and premiered on Disney+ on August 5, 2022.

Some time after the events of The Rise of Skywalker, Finn, Rey, Poe, Chewbacca, BB-8, R2-D2 and C-3PO set off for a relaxing break aboard Lando Calrissian's luxury starcruiser, the Halcyon. Separated from his friends, Finn is visited by a series of Force ghosts, each of whom recounts a summer adventure from the past. Obi-Wan Kenobi describes how, as a young man in a Hawaiian shirt, he infiltrated Jabba the Hutt's palace on Tatooine with Lt. Valeria to steal coaxium. Meant only to distract Jabba, he instead ended up performing a song, "Gamorrean Girls", with Jabba's dancer Sy Snootles.

Anakin Skywalker's ghost then recalls taking Emperor Palpatine on an Empire Day outing, in his time as Darth Vader after the events of Revenge of the Sith, to the planet Scarif, where the original Death Star plans were kept. Finally, Princess Leia's ghost tells of a family trip she and Han Solo took with their young son, Ben, before he began his Jedi training under Luke Skywalker. Ben is unimpressed by a visit to Mimban, where Han first met Chewbacca, so Han tries to win him over by taking him to the forest moon of Endor, site of the famous battle. There they meet resort owner Wick Cooper, on whose daughter Ben has a crush, and a show-off who taunts Ben for his height. After an escapade in the Millennium Falcon, and after dropping Wick's daughter off, Han, Leia, Chewbacca and the droids deliver Ben to Luke's Jedi academy.

The special received mostly favorable notices, with an 88% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes from eight reviews. Collider's Maggie Lovitt gave it an A, praising its self-aware play with familiar franchise clichés as ideal summer viewing, while IGN's Tara Bennett rated it 7 out of 10 and felt it brought the trilogy of specials built around the sequel characters to an emotional and funny conclusion. CineMovie gave it a B+, but The Times awarded a single star and dismissed it as another failure.

title: V for Vengeance
overview: After learning that their younger sibling escaped an earlier kidnapping attempt that also killed their parents, two estranged sisters must join forces to rescue her from a group of bloodthirsty vampires. Out for revenge and control of a vampirism vaccine, Thorn and his band of the undead soon learn that they messed with the wrong family.
plot:
V for Vengeance is a 2022 American action horror film marking the directorial debut of Kelly Halihan, from a screenplay by Peter Moore Smith and Steven Paul. Produced by Paul and Scott Karol for SP Media Group and released by Paramount, it stars Jocelyn Hudon as Emma and Grace Van Dien as Scarlett, with Pauline Dyer as Kate, Sean Maguire as Thorn, Alix Villaret as Tatiana, Christopher Russell as Marcus, Graham Greene as the vampire hunter Bullseye, Michael P. Northey as Frank, Trevor Lerner and Julie Lynn Mortensen. It was filmed in Vancouver, British Columbia, and runs 85 minutes.

Emma and Scarlett are adoptive sisters and rebel vampires who feed only on the wicked; unhindered by sunlight but vulnerable to silver and stakes, Emma hitches rides on country roads to lure predatory men. As children the girls lost their adoptive parents when vampires attacked the family home, and they were taken in by the vampire Thorn, while their younger sister Kate was hidden by their mother and believed dead. In fact she was rescued and raised by the hunter Bullseye. The sisters, estranged after falling out over a man, are reunited when Scarlett tracks Emma down and, after a fight, tells her that Kate is alive. The three share a rare blood type, which their parents had been using to develop a vaccine against vampirism, and Kate has now completed it. Thorn, who ordered the attack on their parents, wants revenge and control of the vaccine and sends his followers after Kate, forcing the sisters to join forces to protect her. Emma becomes involved with Marcus, a bounty hunter with a past connection to Scarlett, who later turns against them, while Frank, an agent of Federal Vampire Control, crosses their path, and the conflict builds to a final battle with Thorn and his band of undead.

The film was released on video on demand and digital platforms on 7 June 2022 and was poorly received. Jim Morazzini of Nerdly gave it 2 out of 5, calling it a checklist of horror and revenge clichés whose fight scenes improved as it went on, with Greene's brief appearance a highlight, though he found it professionally filmed. Ade Smith of Movies & Mania likened it to a slick pilot for a television series and judged it entertaining but vapid, while the Taliesin Meets the Vampires blog rated it 4 out of 10, citing plot holes and weak action.

title: Maneater
tagline: 200 teeth. 0 chance.
overview: A group of friends on vacation in a seeming island paradise are stalked by an unrelenting great white after an accident leaves them stranded and left for dead.
plot:
Maneater is a 2022 American horror thriller directed by Justin Lee and starring Nicky Whelan as Jessie, Shane West as Will, Trace Adkins as Harlan, Branscombe Richmond as Sheriff Kua and Jeff Fahey as Professor Hoffman, with Porscha Coleman, Zoe Cipres, Kelly Lynn Reiter, Alex Farnham and Ed Morrone. It belongs to the long tradition of killer-shark films, pitting a group of vacationers and a grieving father against a great white shark terrorizing a tropical island.

A huge great white shark has been attacking people in the waters around a group of islands. Among its victims is Jennifer, the adult daughter of Harlan, a widower, who is killed while surfing alone. Harlan is left with almost nothing of her to bury and becomes consumed by the desire for revenge. Soon afterward, the shark strikes again, snatching a young man in mid-air as he jumps from a popular cliff into a lagoon.

Meanwhile, Jessie joins her friends on a boat trip to the islands, guided by Captain Wally and his wife Beth. While the group spends the night camping on a small island, the shark kills Wally and Beth on their boat. The next morning Ty, who had cut his hand and been warned to stay out of the water, goes for a swim with Emma, and both are killed. When Will tries to row back to the boat to find out what has happened, the shark overturns his dinghy, and the attempt to save him costs more lives. Stranded and dwindling in number, the survivors call for help on the radio, and their plea reaches Harlan, who comes to find them. Jessie and Harlan must then face the shark, which has become trapped in a shallow bay at low tide.

The film draws on the conventions of Jaws and its many imitators, combining scenic island locations with a revenge story centered on Adkins's grieving father.

Maneater was released in August 2022. Critics were largely negative: Starburst gave it two stars out of five and called it one for shark completists only, IGN rated it 3 out of 10, and Common Sense Media described it as abysmally bad.

title: American Carnage
tagline: No one escapes the daily grind.
overview: After a governor issues an executive order to arrest the children of undocumented immigrants, the detained youth are offered an opportunity to have their charges dropped by volunteering to provide care to the elderly. Once inside the elder care facility, however, they discover more twisted secrets than they could have possibly imagined.
plot:
American Carnage is a 2022 American comedy horror film directed by Diego Hallivis, who wrote it with his brother Julio Hallivis. It stars Jorge Lendeborg Jr., Jenna Ortega, Allen Maldonado and Eric Dane, with Brett Cullen as a state governor. Conceived as a satire of United States immigration politics with a message in favour of immigrant rights, it takes its title from a phrase in Donald Trump's first inaugural address. The film was released in theatres and on demand on 15 July 2022.

JP (Lendeborg), a cheerful young Latino, works a dead-end job at the local Lady Liberty's burger joint, while his sister Lily (Yumarie Morales) has won a place at Columbia University. During her celebration, agents of Immigration and Customs Enforcement raid the house. Governor Harper Finn (Cullen), seeking conservative votes for his re-election, has issued an executive order to arrest not only undocumented immigrants but also their children and JP and his sister are taken into detention. In the holding camp JP is offered a deal: if he volunteers to work as a carer at the Owl Cove retirement home, his charges will be dropped. He starts the job alongside the petty criminal Big Mac (Maldonado), the tough activist Camila (Ortega), the asthmatic conspiracy theorist Chris (Jorge Diaz) and Micah (Bella Ortiz), an Argentine who looks surprisingly white. The residents are strangely apathetic but prone to sudden fits of rage, and one elderly woman keeps trying to warn JP about something. When Chris vanishes after an escape attempt, leaving his inhaler behind, JP digs deeper. He discovers that residents and carers alike are being dosed with hormones that make their flesh tender, with the side effects of dementia and rapid ageing, so that the detainees can be ground into meat for the governor's burger chain; the old woman who tried to warn him is Lily. Micah turns out to be a plant spying on the carers. JP and his friends lead a revolt with the residents, the scheme is exposed, and Finn flees.

Reviews were mixed, with about 58% of 24 critics positive on Rotten Tomatoes. Many compared it to Get Out: Leigh Monson of The A.V. Club gave it a B, saying it falls short of that film but translates issues facing Hispanic Americans into a horror scenario well worth getting into, and Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times called it lively and impassioned. IGN's Matt Donato found it bogged down, while German reviewers felt the shift from realistic satire to crude horror fantasy weakened it.

title: Heart Parade
overview: A careerist from Warsaw, who does not like dogs, has to go to Kraków for professional reasons, where she meets a charming widower, his son and their four-legged pet.
plot:
Heart Parade (Polish: Parada serc) is a 2022 Polish romantic comedy film directed by Filip Zylber from a screenplay by Wiktor Piątkowski, Natalia Matuszek and Marianna Pochroń, produced by Endemol Polska and released by Netflix. Anna Próchniak stars as Magda Grot, a Warsaw television executive, with Michał Czernecki as the widower Krzysztof and Iwo Rajski as his son Karol. The supporting cast includes Piotr Rogucki as Wiktor, Monika Krzywkowska as Zula, Katarzyna Zielińska as Irenka and Leszek Piskorz as the professor. The cinematography is by Malte Rosenfeld and the music by Paweł Lucewicz.

Magda is a headstrong careerist who has organized her whole life around her job and keeps every aspect of it under control, except for one weakness: a dislike of dachshunds rooted in a childhood trauma. On the very day she is due to be promoted, her boss asks her to look after her dachshund for the afternoon. Magda reluctantly agrees, but the dog falls ill, and her boss, blaming her, cancels the promotion and fires her. Hoping to win back her job by proving that she is in fact a dachshund lover, Magda learns of a dachshund parade held in Kraków and travels there to take part. In the city she rents a room from Krzysztof, a young widower who shares an apartment with his son Karol and their dachshund Trombone, without telling them that she has entered their lives for professional reasons. Despite her reservations, she gradually warms to the family, the dog included, and over the following days a connection grows between her and Krzysztof. As the parade approaches, Magda must choose between the career she has been fighting to restore and the promise of a new life.

Heart Parade was released on Netflix on 15 June 2022. Reviews were mixed to negative. Alex Wiggan of It's a Stampede! called it a bright, breezy and whimsical film with splashes of humor that simply sets out to entertain, praising Próchniak's authority and likeability, Rajski's ease as Karol and the attractive views of Kraków, while acknowledging its well-worn story and obvious outcome. Daniel Hart of Ready Steady Cut found it a meandering romantic comedy with little spark, crediting the lead actress's performance but criticizing the lack of chemistry between Magda and Krzysztof and the boredom of its third act.

title: Girl at the Window
tagline: Danger is closer than you think.
overview: A troubled teenage girl who’s struggling to cope with the accidental death of her father suspects that the mysterious killer stalking her hometown is not only her neighbour but her mother’s new romantic interest.
plot:
Girl at the Window is a 2022 Australian thriller horror film directed by Mark Hartley from a screenplay by Terence Hammond and Nicolette Minster. Produced by Antony I. Ginnane, a key figure of the Ozploitation era who had previously worked with Hartley on Patrick (2013), through F.G. Film Productions, it stars Ella Newton as a grieving teenager and Radha Mitchell as her mother, with Vince Colosimo, James Mackay, Jackson Gallagher, Andrew S. Gilbert and Sharon Johal in supporting roles. The film was shot in Melbourne during the COVID-19 lockdowns and opened in Australian cinemas on 18 August 2022. Rated MA, it runs 84 minutes.

A serial killer dubbed "the Clockwork Killer" by the local media is terrorising a small country town in Victoria, preying on young couples within a three-day pattern by killing the young man and abducting the young woman; the film opens with a teenager in a photo booth and the sudden appearance of a naked, one-eyed corpse behind her. Amy Poynton (Newton), a deeply unhappy teenager, has moved with her newly widowed mother Barbara (Mitchell) to a house on the town's outskirts after the accidental death of her father, whom she still mourns. She resents Barbara's decision to date their working-class neighbour, Chris Mancini (Colosimo), and grows suspicious of him: he is constantly tearing down and rebuilding his house, keeps a large shed locked, takes his van out in the early hours without headlights and turns up uninvited in their home. After sneaking out to peer through his windows, Amy becomes convinced that he is the killer and recruits her school friend Lian to play detective with her, drawing the attention of the real murderer and making themselves targets.

The film received mixed to negative reviews. Sandra Hall of The Sydney Morning Herald gave it two stars, observing that it was a throwback to the Ozploitation films Hartley had celebrated in his 2008 documentary Not Quite Hollywood, but found it so clunky that credibility became its first casualty, with ridiculous choices by its young sleuths, a thankless, tin-eared role for Mitchell and little energy beyond a gruesome scene involving an eyeball. title: Virgin Forest
overview: A photographer is tasked to take a photo of a rare flower thriving in the mountain, but he discovers women trapped in a hidden brothel for illegal loggers.
plot:
Virgin Forest is a 2022 Filipino erotic thriller directed by Brillante Mendoza and produced and distributed by Viva Films with Center Stage Productions. It stars Sid Lucero as Francis and Angeli Khang as Angela, with Vince Rillon as Roger, Kat Dovey as Karla, Rob Guinto as Gina, Alma Moreno as Minda, Allan Paule as Mang Canor and Micaella Raz as the leader of the forest spirits, or diwata.

Francis, a photojournalist and father of two, is hired by the mayor of the town of Dolores to photograph the giant rafflesia, the flower with the largest blooms in the world, which grows deep in the mountains. He sets off into the jungle with a local guide, Roger. When they stop in Roger's village, Francis sees a resident accuse Roger of abducting his daughter, a charge Roger denies. In the forest they meet Gina, a naked, terrified woman who seeks Roger's protection; he rebuffs her and tells Francis she is mad. At night Francis repeatedly dreams of erotic encounters with diwata who beg him to save them. The next morning they find the bloody body of a hunter they had met, then stumble upon illegal loggers and a desperate young woman, Angela, who pleads with Roger for help. Instead, he drags her back to a hidden compound in the jungle, a tavern and brothel run by Minda, and the loggers decide that Francis, who now knows their secret, must be eliminated. Locked up with Francis, Angela tells him that Roger promised her and her sister Karla jobs but sold them as sex slaves, the same fate that befell his former girlfriend Gina. With Gina's help, they escape and free Karla, but the loggers pursue them through the forest, and Karla is shot. The hunters meet their own deaths in a fall and in snake attacks, and Roger is later killed by the father of one of the girls he trafficked. Back in Dolores, Angela confronts her grandmother, who sold the sisters, and Francis and his journalist wife expose the trafficking and illegal logging, leading to the arrest of the mayor and his accomplices. The film suggests that a forest spirit was behind the men's deaths.

Principal photography took place in 2022 in Batangas, Bukidnon and Quezon. A teaser was released on 30 May 2022, and the film premiered on the streaming service Vivamax on 24 June 2022. It was later released on home video in Germany by Busch Media Group.

title: Fall
tagline: Fear reaches new heights.
overview: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. But after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now Becky and Hunter’s expert climbing skills will be put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights
plot:
Fall is a 2022 survival psychological thriller directed by Scott Mann, who wrote it with Jonathan Frank. It stars Grace Caroline Currey, Virginia Gardner, Mason Gooding and Jeffrey Dean Morgan, and follows two best friends stranded atop a 2,000-foot television broadcast tower.

While climbing a mountain with her friend Shiloh Hunter, Becky Connor watches her husband, Dan, fall to his death after a bat startles him. A year later, Becky has quit climbing and contemplates suicide, and she is estranged from her father, James. Near the anniversary, Shiloh persuades her to climb the decommissioned B-67 TV tower in the desert before its demolition and scatter Dan's ashes from the summit. The two ascend rusted ladders to a tiny platform at the top, where Shiloh films for her YouTube channel. As they start down, the ladder collapses, leaving them stranded far above the next intact section, with Becky's thigh cut and their backpack, holding water and a small drone, lying on a dish below.

Their phones have no signal near the dish, so Shiloh drops hers in a shoe, hoping a message to her followers will get through. They fail to attract a passing man and his dog, and when they fire a flare at night, two men camping nearby steal Shiloh's car instead of helping. Becky notices a tattoo on Shiloh's ankle matching Dan's code for "I love you", and Shiloh confesses to a four-month affair with him before the wedding. Shiloh lowers herself on the rope to retrieve the backpack, and Becky hauls her back. Using power from the tower's warning light, Becky charges the drone and sends it toward a motel with a plea for help, but a truck destroys it. Delirious, she realizes that Shiloh actually fell to her death onto the dish while retrieving the bag, and that she has been hallucinating her ever since. After killing and eating a vulture that attacked her, Becky climbs down to the dish, places her phone with a message to her father inside Shiloh's shoe and pushes the body off the tower so it cushions the phone's fall. The message sends, James summons rescuers, and father and daughter reconcile.

Mann conceived the idea while filming at height on another project and shot the film in IMAX in California's Mojave Desert. Lionsgate released it on August 12, 2022, and it grossed about $21.8 million against a $3 million budget. Reviews were generally positive, at 80% on Rotten Tomatoes and 62 on Metacritic, with praise for the two leads and criticism of the visual effects and script.
